Arakhin 6a:16-6b:7: Tanu rabbanan: "sela zo litzdaka" — ad shello bata leyad gabbay, muttar leshannotah; mishshebbata leyad gabbay, asur leshannotah.
Ini? veha rabbi yannay yazef ufara! shane rabbi yannay, denicha lehu laaniyyim dechamma dimshahe measse umayyte lehu.

Tanu rabbanan: yisrael shehitnaddev menora o ner levet hakkeneset — asur leshannotah. savar rabbi chiyyay bar abba lememar: la shena lidvar harshut vela shena lidvar mitzva. amar leh rav amme: hachi amar rabbi yochanan — lo shanu ella lidvar harshut, aval lidvar mitzva muttar leshannotah.
Middeamar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: goy shehitnaddev menora o ner levet hakkeneset, ad shello nishtakka shem bealeha — asur leshannotah, mishshennishtakka shem bealeha — muttar leshannotah.
Lemay? ilema lidvar harshut, may irya goy? afillu yisrael name!
Ella lidvar mitzva, vetama degoy hu defae, aval yisrael dela pae — shappir dame.

Shaazrak tayyaya innaddav sheraga leve chenishta derav yehuda, shanneyeh rachava veikkefed rava. ikka deamri: shanneyeh rava veikkefed rachava, veikka deamri: shanneyuy chazzane defumebdita, veikkefed rachava veikkefed rabba.
Man deshanneyeh savar dela shechiach, uman deikkefed savar zimnin demikkere veate.
Beitzah 15b:4-16b:7: Gemara mena hane mille? amar shemuel, deamar kera: "zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho", zochrehu — meacher shebba lehashekicho.
May tama? amar rava: keday sheyyivror mana yafa lashshabbat umana yafa leyom tov.
Rav ashe amar: kede sheyyomru en ofin miyyom tov lashshabbat, kal vachomer miyyom tov lechol.

Tenan: ose tavshil meerev yom tov vesomech alav lashshabbat. bishlama lerav ashe deamar kede sheyyomru en ofin miyyom tov lashshabbat, hayeynu demeerev yom tov — in, beyom tov — la. ella lerava, may irya meerev yom tov? afillu beyom tov name!
In hachi name, ella gezera shemma yifsha.

Vetanna mayyte la mehacha: "et asher tofu efu veet asher tevashshelu bashshelu", mikkan amar rabbi eliezer: en ofin ella al haafuy, veen mevashshelin ella al hamevushshal. mikkan samchu chachamim leeruve tavshilin min hattora.

Tanu rabbanan: maase berabbi eliezer shehaya yoshev vedoresh kol hayyom kullo behilchot yom tov. yatzta kat rishona, amar: hallalu baale fittasin. kat sheniyya, amar: hallalu baale chaviyyot. kat shelishit, amar: hallalu baale chaddin.
Kat reviit, amar: hallalu baale leginin. kat chamishit, amar: hallalu baale chosot. hitchilu kat shishshit latzet, amar: hallalu baale meera.
Natan enav battalmidim, hitchilu penehem mishtannin. amar lahem: banay, lo lachem ani omer, ella lehallalu sheyyatzu, shemmannichim chayye olam veoskim bechayye shaa.
Bishat petiratan, amar lahem: "lechu ichlu mashmannim ushetu mamtakkim veshilchu manot leen nachon lo ki kadosh hayyom laadonenu veal teatzevu ki chedvat Adonai hi mauzzechem".
Amar mar: shemmannichin chayye olam veoskin bechayye shaa — veha simchat yom tov mitzva hi! rabbi eliezer letameh, deamar: simchat yom tov reshut.
Detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: en lo laadam beyom tov, ella o ochel veshote, o yoshev veshone. rabbi yehoshua omer, challekehu: chetzyo laAdonai, vechetzyo lachem.

Amar rabbi yochanan: ushenehem mikra echad darshu. katuv echad omer: "atzeret laAdonai elohecha", vechatuv echad omer: "atzeret tihye lachem". ha ketzad? rabbi eliezer savar: o kullo laAdonai, o kullo lachem. verabbi yehoshua savar: challekehu, chetzyo laAdonai vechetzyo lachem.

May "leen nachon lo"? amar rav chisda: lemi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin. ikka deamri: mi shello haya lo lehanniach eruve tavshilin, aval mi shehaya lo lehanniach eruve tavshilin velo hinniach — poshea hu.

May "ki chedvat Adonai hi mauzzechem"? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer berabbi shimon: amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: banay, levu alay, vekaddeshu kedushshat hayyom, vehaaminu bi vaani porea.
Veamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi eliezer berabbi shimon: harotze sheyyitkayyeymu nechasav — yitta bahen eder, shenneemar: "addir bammarom Adonai".
I name adra kishmeh, kidamri inashe: may adra — dekayyma ledare dare. tanya name hachi: sade sheyyesh bah eder enah nigzelet veenah nechmeset, uferoteha mishtammerin.
Tane rav tachlifa achu deravnay chozaa:

Kol mezonotav shel adam ketzuvim lo merosh hashshana vead yom hakkippurim, chutz mehotzaat shabbatot vehotzaat yom tov vehotzaat banav letalmud tora, sheim pachat — pochatin lo, veim hosif — mosifin lo.

Amar rabbi avahu, may keraa: "tiku vachodesh shofar (bakkese) leyom chaggenu", ezehu chag shehachodesh mitkasse bo — heve omer ze rosh hashshana, uchetiv: "ki chok leyisrael hu mishpat lelohe yaakov".
May mashma dehay "chok" lishshana dimzone hu, dichtiv: "veachlu et chukkam asher natan lahem paro". mar zutera amar, mehacha: "haterifeni lechem chukki".
Tanya: amru alav al shammay hazzaken, kol yamav haya ochel lichvod shabbat. matza behema naa, omer: zo lashshabbat. matza acheret naa hemenna — manniach et hashsheniyya veochel et harishona.

Aval hillel hazzaken — midda acheret hayta lo, shekkol maasav leshem shamayim, shenneemar: "baruch Adonai yom yom", tanya name hachi, bet shammay omrim: mechad shabbaych leshabbetaych, uvet hillel omrim: "baruch Adonai yom yom".
Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: hannoten mattana lachavero en tzarich lehodio, shenneemar: "umoshe lo yada ki karan or panav".

Metivi: "ladaat ki ani Adonai mekaddishchem", amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: moshe! mattana tova yesh li bevet genazay veshabbat shemah, vaani mevakkesh littenah leyisrael, lech vehodia otam. mikkan amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: hannoten pat letinok, tzarich lehodia leimmo.
La kashya: ha bemattana daavida leiggalloye, ha bemattana dela avida leiggalloye. shabbat name mattana daavida leiggalloye! mattan secharah la avida leiggalloye.

Amar mar, mikkan amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: hannoten pat letinok tzarich lehodia leimmo. may aved leh? shayef leh mishcha umale leh kuchela. vehaiddana dechayyshinan lichshafim, may? amar rav pappa: shayef leh meoto hammin.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: kol mitzvot shennatan lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael — natan lahem befarhesya, chutz mishshabbat shennatan lahem betzina, shenneemar: "beni uven bene yisrael ot hi leolam".
I hachi, la lianshu goyim ala? shabbat — odoe odinhu, mattan secharah — la odinhu. vei baet ema: mattan secharah name odinhu, neshama yetera — la odinhu.

Deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: neshama yetera noten hakkadosh baruch hu baadam erev shabbat, ulemotzae shabbat notlin otah hemennu, shenneemar: "shavat vayyinnafash", kevan sheshshavat vavy avda nefesh.
Ose adam tavshil meerev yom tov. amar abbaye: lo shanu ella tavshil, aval pat — la.

May shena pat dela? illema midde dimlappet baenan, ufat la melappeta — veha dayysa name dela melappeta, deamar rabbi zera: hane bavlae tafshae deachli nahama benahama. veamar rav nechumi bar zecharya mishshemeh deabbaye: mearvin bedayysa! ella: midde dela shechiach baenan, ufat shechicha, vedayysa la shechicha.

Ikka deamri, amar abbaye: lo shanu ella tavshil, aval pat — la. may tama? illema demidde dela shechiach baenan, ufat shechicha — veha dayysa la shechicha, veamar rav nechumi bar zecharya mishshemeh deabbaye: en mearvin bedayysa! ella: midde dimlappet baenan, ufat la melappeta, vedayysa name la melappeta. deamar rabbi zera: hane bavlae tafshae deachli nahama benahama.

Tane rabbi chiyyay: adashim shebbeshule kedera somech alehen mishshum eruve tavshilin. vehane mille deit behu kezayit. amar rav yitzchak bereh derav yehuda: shamnunit sheal gabbe hassakkin — gorro vesomech alav mishshum eruve tavshilin. vehane mille deit behu kezayit.
Amar rav assi amar rav: dagim ketannim meluchim en bahem mishshum bishshule goyim. amar rav yosef: veim tzelaan goy — somech alehem mishshum eruve tavshilin. vei avdinhu goy kasa deharsana — asur.
Peshita! mahu detema:
Haresana ikkar, ka mashma lan kimcha ikkar.

Amar rabbi abba: eruve tavshilin tzerichin kezayit. ibbaya lehu: kezayit echad lechullan, o dilma kezayit lechol echad veechad? ta shema, deamar rabbi abba amar rav: eruve tavshilin tzerichin kezayit ben leechad, ben lemea.
Tenan: achalo o sheavad — lo yevashshel alav battechilla, shiyyer mimmennu kol shehu — somech alav leshabbat. may kol shehu? lav af al gav delekka kezayit? la, deit beh kezayit.

Ta shema: tavshil — ze tzali, vaafillu kavush shaluk umevushshal, vekolyays haispenin shennatan alav chammin meerev yom tov — techillato vesofo en lo shiur. may lav, en lo shiur kelal? la, en lo shiur lemala, aval yesh lo shiur lematta.
Amar rav huna amar rav: eruve tavshilin tzerichin daat. peshita, daat manniach baenan; daat mi shehinnichu lo baenan, o la baenan?

Ta shema: daavu dishmuel mearev akkulla nehardea, rabbi amme verabbi assi mearvi akkulla teverya. machriz rabbi yaakov bar idi: mi shello hinniach eruve tavshilin, yavo veyismoch al shelli. vead kamma? amar rav nechumi bar zecharya mishshemeh deabbaye: ad techum shabbat.

Hahu samya dahava mesaddar matneyata kammeh demar shemuel, chazyeh dahava atziv, amar leh: ammay atzivat? amar leh: dela otivi eruve tavshilin. amar leh: semoch addidi. leshana chazyeh dahava atziv, amar leh: ammay atzivat? amar leh: dela otivi eruve tavshilin. amar leh: poshea at. lechulle alma shere, ledidach asir.
Berakhot 58a:13-15: Rabbi shela naggedeh lehahu gavra dival goya. azal achal beh kuretze be malka, amar: ikka chad gavra bihudae deka dayen dina bela haremana demalka. shaddar aleh peristeka. ki ata amri leh: may tama naggedteh lehay? amar lehu: deva al chamarta. amri leh: it lecha sahadi? amar lehu: in. ata eliyyahu iddemi leh keinish, veashed. amri leh: i hachi, bar ketala hu! amar lehu: anan miyyoma diglenan mearin let lan reshuta lemiktal. attun, may devaetun avidu beh.

Ad dimayyeyni beh bedina, petach rabbi shela vaamar: "lecha Adonai haggedulla vehaggevura vegomer". amri leh: may kaamrat? amar lehu, hachi kaamena: "berich rachamana deyahev malchuta beara keen malchuta dirkia, vihav lechu shuletana verachami dina". amaru: chabbiva aleh yekara demalchuta kulle hay! yahavi leh kulefa amaru leh: dun dina.

Ki hava nafek, amar leh hahu gavra: aved rachamana nissa leshakkare hachi? amar leh: rasha, lav chamare ikkeru? dichtiv: "asher besar chamorim besaram". chazyeh dekaazel lememra lehu dikrinhu chamare, amar: hay rodef hu. vehattora amra: im ba lehorgecha — hashekem lehorgo. machyeh bekulefa vekatleh.

Umitzchat nechoshet al-raglav vechidon nechoshet ben ketefav

Vayyelchu sheloshet bene-yishay haggedolim halchu achare-shaul lammilchama veshem ׀ sheloshet banav asher halchu bammilchama eliav habbechor umishnehu avinadav vehashshelishi shamma

Veshaul vehemma vechol-ish yisrael beemek haela nilchamim im-pelishtim {s}

Vattaaroch yisrael ufelishtim maaracha likrat maaracha

Vehu ׀ medabber immam vehinne ish habbenayim ole golyat happelishti shemo miggat (mimmaarot) [mimmaarchot] pelishtim vaydabber kaddevarim haelle vayyishma david
Vechol ish yisrael birotam et-haish vayyanusu mippanav vayyiru meod

Vayyomer david el-haanashim haomdim immo lemor ma-yease laish asher yakke et-happelishti hallaz vehesir cherpa meal yisrael ki mi happelishti hearel hazze ki cheref maarchot elohim chayyim

Vayyaamod vayyikra el-maarchot yisrael vayyomer lahem lamma tetzu laaroch milchama halo anochi happelishti veattem avadim leshaul beru-lachem ish veyered elay
Im-yuchal lehillachem itti vehikkani vehayinu lachem laavadim veim-ani uchal-lo vehikkitiv vihyitem lanu laavadim vaavadtem otanu
Vayyomer happelishti ani cherafti et-maarchot yisrael hayyom hazze tenu-li ish venillachama yachad
Mishnah Makhshirin 2:1-5:
Zeat battim, borot, shichin umearot, tehora. zeat haadam, tehora. shata mayim temein vehizzia, zeato tehora. ba vemayim sheuvim vehizzia, zeato temea. nistappeg veachar kach hizzia, zeato tehora: 
Merchatz temea, zeatah temea. utehora, bechi yuttan. habberecha shebbabbayit, habbayit mazzia mechamatah, im temea, zeat kol habbayit shemmechamat habberecha, temea: 
Shete verechot, achat tehora veachat temea, hammazzia karov lattemea, tame. karov lattehora, tahor. mechetza lemechetza, tame. barzel tame shebbelalo im barzel tahor, im rov min hattame, tame. veim rov min hattahor, tahor. mechetza lemechetza, tame. gisterayot sheyyisrael venachrim mattilin letochah, im rov min hattame, tame. veim rov min hattahor, tahor. mechetza lemechetza, tame. me shefichut sheyyardu alehen me geshamim, im rov min hattame, tame. veim rov min hattahor, tahor. mechetza lemechetza, tame. ematay, bizman shekkadmu me shefichut. aval im kadmu me geshamim, afillu chol shehen, leme shefichut, tame: 
Hattoref et gaggo vehamechabbes et kesuto veyardu alehen geshamim, im rov min hattame, tame. veim rov min hattahor, tahor. mechetza lemechetza, tame. rabbi yehuda omer, im hosifu lenattef: 
Ir sheyyisrael venachrim darim bah vehaya vah merchatz marchetzet beshabbat, im rov nachrim, rochetz miyyad. veim rov yisrael, yamtin kede sheyyechammu hachammin. mechetza lemechetza, yamtin kede sheyyechammu hachammin. rabbi yehuda omer, beambati ketanna, im yesh bah rashut, rochetz bah miyyad:
Mishnah Makhshirin 2:10-3:2:
Hammotze ferot badderech, im rov machnisin levattehen, patur. velimkor bashshuk, chayyav. mechetza lemechetza, demay. otzar sheyyisrael venachrim mattilin letocho, im rov nachrim, vadday. veim rov yisrael, demay. mechetza lemechetza, vadday, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, afillu chullam nachrim veyisrael echad mattil letocho, demay: 
Perot sheniyya sherabbu al shel shelishit, veshel shelishit al shel reviit, veshel reviit al shel chamishit, veshel chamishit al shel shishshit, veshel shishshit al shel sheviit, veshel sheviit al shel motzae sheviit, holchin achar harov. mechetza lemechetza, lehachamir: 
Sak shehu male ferot unetano al gav hannahar, o al pi habbor, o al maalot hammeara, veshaavu, kol sheshshaavu, bechi yuttan. rabbi yehuda omer, kol shehu cheneged hammayim, bechi yuttan. vechol sheeno cheneged hammayim, eno bechi yuttan: 
Chavit shehi melea ferot unetuna letoch hammashkin, o melea mashkin unetuna letoch happerot, veshaavu, kol sheshshaavu, bechi yuttan. beellu mashkim amru, bemayim uveyayin uvechometz. ushear kol hammashkin, tehorin. rabbi nechemya metaher bekitnit, sheen hakkitnit shoavet:
Mishnah Makhshirin 2:6-9:
Matza vah yarak nimkar, im rov nachrim, lokeach miyyad. veim rov yisrael, yamtin kede sheyyavou mimmakom karov. mechetza lemechetza, yamtin kede sheyyavou mimmakom karov. veim yesh bo rashut, lokeach miyyad: 
Matza vah tinok mushlach, im rov nachrim, nachri. veim rov yisrael, yisrael. mechetza lemechetza, yisrael. rabbi yehuda omer, holchin achar rov hammashlichin: 
Matza vah metzia, im rov nachrim, eno tzarich lehacheriz. veim rov yisrael, tzarich lehacheriz. mechetza lemechetza, tzarich lehacheriz. matza vah pat, holchin achar rov hannachtomin. veim hayta fat issa, holchim achar rov ochle fat issa. rabbi yehuda omer, im hayta fat kibbar, holchin achar rov ochle fat kibbar: 
Matza vah basar, holchin achar rov hattabbachim. im haya mevushshal, holchim achar rov ochle vasar mevushshal:
Mishnah Makhshirin 3:3-6:
Harode fat chamma unetanah al pi chavit shel yayin, rabbi meir metamme. rabbi yehuda metaher. rabbi yose metaher beshel chittim umetamme veshel seorim, mippene shehasseorim shoavot: 
Hamerabbetz et beto venatan bo chittim vetannu, im mechamat hammayim, bechi yuttan. veim mechamat hassela, enan bechi yuttan. hamechabbes et kesuto baareva, natan bah chittim vetannu, im mechamat hammayim, bechi yuttan. im mechamat atzman, enan bechi yuttan. hametannen bechol, hare ze vechi yuttan. maase veanshe hammachoz shehayu metinnin bechol, amru lahem chachamim, im kach heyitem osim, lo asitem tohora mimechem: 
Hametannen betit hannaguv, rabbi shimon omer, im yesh bo mashke tofeach, bechi yuttan. veim lav, eno bechi yuttan. hamerabbetz et garno, eno choshesh shemma natan bah chittim vetannu. hamelakket asavim keshehattal alehem, lehaten bahem chittim, enan bechi yuttan. im nitkavven lechach, hare ze vechi yuttan. hammolich chittin litchon veyardu alehen geshamim, im samach, bechi yuttan. rabbi yehuda omer, i efshar shello lismoach, ella im amad: 
Hayu zetav netunim baggag veyardu alehen geshamim, im samach, bechi yuttan. rabbi yehuda omer, i efshar shello lismoach, ella, im pakak et hatztzinnor o im chilchel letochan:
Mishnah Makhshirin 3:7-4:3:
Hachammarin shehayu ovrim bannahar venaflu sakkehem lammayim, im samchu, bechi yuttan. rabbi yehuda omer, i efshar shello lismoach, ella, im hafchu. hayu raglav meleot tit, vechen ragle vehemto, avar bannahar, im samach, bechi yuttan. rabbi yehuda omer, i efshar shello lismoach, ella, im amad vehediach. beadam uvivhema temea, leolam tame: 
Hammorid et haggalgallim veet kele habbakar bishat hakkadim lammayim bishvil sheyyachutzu, hare ze vechi yuttan. hammorid behema lishtot, hammayim haolim befiha, bechi yuttan. uveragleha, enan bechi yuttan. im chashav sheyyudechu ragleha, af haolin beragleha, bechi yuttan. bishat hayyachaf vehaddayish, leolam tame. horid cheresh shote vekatan, af al pi shechoshev sheyyudechu ragleha, enan bechi yuttan, sheyyesh lahen maase veen lahen machashava: 
Hashshoche lishtot, hammayim haolim befiv uvisfamo, bechi yuttan. bechatmo uverosho uvizkano, enan bechi yuttan. hamemalle bechavit, hammayim haolim achareha, uvachevel shehu mechunnan al tzavvarah, uvachevel shehu letzarkah, hare ze vechi yuttan. kamma hu tzarkah. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, tefach. netanah tachat hatztzinnor, enan bechi yuttan: 
Mi sheyyardu alav geshamim, afillu av hattuma, eno vechi yuttan. veim nier, bechi yuttan. amad tachat hatztzinnor lehaker o liddoach, betame, temein. uvetahor, bechi yuttan: 
Hakkofe keara al hakkotel bishvil shettudach, hare ze vechi yuttan. im bishvil shello yilke hakkotel, enan bechi yuttan:
Mishnah Makhshirin 4:4-7:
Chavit sheyyarad haddelef letochah, bet shammay omrim, yeshabber. bet hillel omrim, yeare. umodim shehu moshit et yado venotel perot mittochah, vehem tehorim: 
Areva sheyyarad haddelef letochah, hannittazin vehatztzafin enan bechi yuttan. netalah leshafchah, bet shammay omrim, bechi yuttan. bet hillel omrim, enan bechi yuttan. hinnichah sheyyered haddelef letochah, hannittazin vehatztzafin, bet shammay omrim, bechi yuttan. bet hillel omrim, enan bechi yuttan. netalah leshafchah, ellu vaellu modim shehen bechi yuttan. hammatbil et hakkelim vehamechabbes et kesuto bimara, hammayim haolim beyadav, bechi yuttan. beraglav, enan bechi yuttan. rabbi elazar omer, im i efshar lo sheyyered ella im ken nittannefu raglav, af haolin beraglav bechi yuttan: 
Kuppa shehi melea turmosin unetanuha letoch mikve, moshit yado venotel turmosin mittochah, vehem tehorim. heelam min hammayim, hannogim bakkuppa, temeim, ushear kol hatturmosim, tehorim. tzenon shebbammeara, nidda medichato vehu tahor. heelattu chol shehu min hammayim, tame: 
Perot shennaflu letoch ammat hammayim, pashat mi shehayu yadav temeot unetalan, yadav tehorot vehapperot tehorim. veim chashav sheyyudechu yadav, yadav tehorot vehapperot bechi yuttan:
Mishnah Megillah 1:1-3:
Megilla nikret beachad asar, bishnem asar, bishlosha asar, bearbaa asar, bachamishsha asar, lo fachot velo yoter. kerakkin hammukkafin choma mimot yehoshua bin nun, korin bachamishsha asar. kefarim vaayarot gedolot, korin bearbaa asar, ella shehakkefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa: 
Ketzad. chal lihyot yom arbaa asar bashsheni, kefarim vaayarot gedolot korin bo vayyom, umukkafot choma lemachar. chal lihyot bashshelishi o barvii, kefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa vaayarot gedolot korin bo vayyom, umukkafot choma lemachar. chal lihyot bachamishi, kefarim vaayarot gedolot korin bo vayyom, umukkafot choma lemachar. chal lihyot erev shabbat, kefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa, vaayarot gedolot umukkafot choma korin bo vayyom. chal lihyot beshabbat, kefarim vaayarot gedolot makdimin vekorin leyom hakkenisa, umukkafot choma lemachar. chal lihyot achar hashshabbat, kefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa, vaayarot gedolot korin bo vayyom, umukkafot choma lemachar: 
Ezo hi ir gedola, kol sheyyesh bah asara vatlanim. pachot mikkan, hare ze chefar. baellu amru makdimin velo meacharin. aval zeman atze chohanim vetisha veav, chagiga vehakehel, meacharin velo makdimin. af al pi sheamru makdimin velo meacharin, muttarin behesped uvetaaniyyot umattanot laevyonim. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, mekom shennichnasin besheni uvachamishi. aval mekom sheen nichnasin lo besheni velo vachamishi, en korin otah ella vizmannah:
Mishnah Megillah 1:4-7:
Karu et hammegilla baadar harishon venitabbera hashshana, korin otah baadar hashsheni, en ben adar harishon laadar hashsheni ella keriat hammegilla umattanot laevyonim: 
En ben yom tov leshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad. en ben shabbat leyom hakkippurim ella shezze zedono bide adam veze zedono becharet: 
En ben hammuddar hanaa mechavero lammuddar mimmennu maachol ella derisat haregel vechelim sheen osin bahen ochel nefesh. en ben nedarim lindavot ella shehannedarim chayyav beacharayutan, unedavot eno chayyav beacharayutan: 
En ben zav haroe shete reiyyot leroe shalosh ella karban. en ben metzora musgar limtzora muchlat ella feria uferima. en ben tahor mittoch hesger letahor mittoch hechlet ella tiglachat vetzipporim:
Mishnah Megillah 1:8-11:
En ben sefarim litfillin umezuzot ella shehassefarim nichtavin bechol lashon, utefillin umezuzot enan nichtavot ella ashshurit. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af bassefarim lo hittiru sheyyikkatvu ella yevanit: 
En ben kohen mashuach beshemen hammishcha limrubbe vegadim ella par habba al kol hammitzvot. en ben kohen meshammesh lechohen sheavar ella par yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa: 
En ben bama gedola levama ketanna ella fesachim. ze hakkelal, kol shehu niddar veniddav, karev babbama. vechol sheeno lo niddar velo niddav, eno karev babbama: 
En ben shilo lirushalayim ella shebbeshilo ochlim kadashim kallim umaaser sheni bechol haroe, uvirushalayim lifnim min hachoma. vechan vechan kadshe kadashim neechalim lifnim min hakkelaim. kedushshat shilo yesh achareha hetter, ukedushshat yerushalayim en achareha hetter:
Mishnah Ta'anit 3:4-7:
Vechen ir sheyyesh bah dever o mappolet, otah hair mitanna umatraat, vechol sevivoteha mitannot velo matriot. rabbi akiva omer, matriot velo mitannot. ezehu dever, ir hammotzia chamesh meot ragli, veyatzu mimmenna shelosha metim bishlosha yamim ze achar ze, hare ze dever. pachot mikkan, en ze dever: 
Al ellu matriin bechol makom, al hashshiddafon veal hayyerakon, al haarbe veal hechasil, veal hachayya raa veal hacherev, matriin aleha, mippene shehi makka mehallechet: 
Maase sheyyardu zekenim mirushalayim learehem, vegazru taanit al shennira chimlo fi tannur shiddafon beashkelon. veod gazru taanit al sheachlu zeevim shene tinokot beever hayyarden. rabbi yose omer, lo al sheachlu, ella al shennira: 
Al ellu matriin beshabbat, al ir shehikkifuha goyim o nahar, veal hassefina hammittarefet bayyam. rabbi yose omer, leezra velo litzaka. shimon hattimni omer, af al haddever, velo hodu lo chachamim:
Mishnah Ta'anit 3:8-4:2:
Al kol tzara shello tavo al hatztzibbur, matriin alehen, chutz merov geshamim. maase sheamru lo lechoni hameaggel, hitpallel sheyyerdu geshamim. amar lahem, tzeu vehachenisu tannure fesachim, bishvil shello yimmoku. hitpallel, velo yardu geshamim. me asa, ag uga veamad betochah, veamar lefanav, ribbono shel olam, banecha samu fenehem alay, sheani cheven bayit lefanecha. nishba ani veshimcha haggadol sheeni zaz mikkan, ad shetterachem al banecha. hitchilu geshamim menattefin. amar, lo chach shaalti, ella gishme vorot shichin umearot. hitchilu lered bezaaf. amar, lo chach shaalti, ella gishme ratzon, beracha unedava. yardu chetiknan, ad sheyyatzu yisrael mirushalayim lehar habbayit mippene haggeshamim. bau veamru lo, keshem shehitpalalta alehem sheyyerdu kach hitpallel sheyyelchu lahen. amar lahen, tzeu ureu im nimchet even hattoim. shalach lo shimon ben shatach, ilmale choni atta, gozrani alecha nidduy. aval ma eese lecha, sheatta mitchatte lifne hammakom veose lecha retzoncha keven shehu mitchatte al aviv veose lo retzono. vealecha hakkatuv omer (Mishlei 23), yismach avicha veimmecha vetagel yoladtecha: 
Hayu mitannin veyardu lahem geshamim kodem hanetz hachamma, lo yashlimu. leachar hanetz hachamma, yashlimu. rabbi eliezer omer, kodem chatzot lo yashlimu, leachar chatzot yashlimu. maase sheggazru taanit belod, veyardu lahem geshamim kodem chatzot. amar lahem rabbi tarfon, tzeu veichlu ushetu vaasu yom tov. veyatzu veachlu veshatu veasu yom tov, uvau ben haarbayim vekaru hallel haggadol: 
Bishlosha ferakim bashshana kohanim nosin et kappehen arba peamim bayyom, bashshacharit, bammusaf uvammincha uvinilat shearim, battaaniyyot uvammaamadot uveyom hakkippurim: 
Ellu hen maamadot, lefi shenneemar (Bamidbar 28), tzav et bene yisrael veamarta alehem et karbani lachmi, vechi heach karbano shel adam karev, vehu eno omed al gabbav, hitkinu neviim harishonim esrim vearba mishmarot. al kol mishmar umishmar haya maamad birushalayim shel kohanim, shel leviyyim, veshel yisreelim. higgia zeman hammishmar laalot, kohanim uleviyyim olim lirushalayim, veyisrael shebbeoto mishmar mitkannesin learehen vekorin bemaase vereshit:
Mishnah Ta'anit 4:3-7:
Veanshe hammaamad hayu mitannin arbaa yamim bashshavua, miyyom sheni vead yom chamishi. velo hayu mitannin erev shabbat, mippene chevod hashshabbat. velo veechad bashshabbat, kede shello yetzu mimmenucha vaoneg ligia vetaanit veyamutu. bayyom harishon, bereshit, viyhi rakia. bashsheni, yehi rakia, veyikkavu hammayim. bashshelishi, yikkavu hammayim, viyhi meorot. barvii, yehi meorot, veyishretzu hammayim. bachamishi, yishretzu hammayim, vetotze haaretz. bashshishshi, totze haaretz, vaychullu hashshamayim. parasha gedola, korin otah bishnayim, vehakketanna beyachid, bashshacharit uvammusaf. uvammincha nichnasin vekorin al pihen, kekorin et shema. erev shabbat bammincha lo hayu nichnasin, mippene chevod hashshabbat: 
Kol yom sheyyesh bo hallel, en bo maamad bashshacharit. karban musaf, en bo vanneila. karban etzim, en bo vammincha, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo ven azzay, kach haya rabbi yehoshua shone, karban musaf, en bo vammincha. karban etzim, en bo vanneila. chazar rabbi akiva lihyot shone cheven azzay: 
Zeman atze chohanim vehaam, tisha. beechad benisan, bene arach ben yehuda. beesrim betammuz, bene david ben yehuda. bachamishsha veav, bene farosh ben yehuda. beshiva vo, bene yonadav ben rechav. baasara vo, bene senaa ven binyamin. bachamishsha asar bo, bene zattu ven yehuda, veimmahem kohanim uleviyyim vechol mi shettaa veshivto, uvene gonve eli bene kotze ketziot. beesrim bo, bene fachat moav ben yehuda. beesrim beelul, bene adin ben yehuda. beechad betevet shavu vene farosh sheniyya. beechad betevet lo haya vo maamad, shehaya vo hallel vekarban musaf vekarban etzim: 
Chamishsha devarim eru et avotenu beshiva asar betammuz vachamishsha betisha veav. beshiva asar betammuz nishtabberu halluchot, uvatal hattamid, vehuvkea hair, vesaraf appostomos et hattora, veheemid tzelem bahechol. betisha veav nigzar al avotenu shello yikkansu laaretz, vecharav habbayit barishona uvashsheniyya, venilkeda vetar, venechresha hair. mishshennichnas av, memaatin besimcha: 
Shabbat shechal tisha veav lihyot betochah, asur millesapper umillechabbes, uvachamishi muttarin mippene chevod hashshabbat. erev tisha veav lo yochal adam shene tavshilin, lo yochal basar velo yishte yayin. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, yeshanne. rabbi yehuda mechayyev bichfiyyat hammitta, velo hodu lo chachamim:
Mishnah Ta'anit 4:8: Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, lo hayu yamim tovim leyisrael kachamishsha asar beav ucheyom hakkippurim, shebbahen benot yerushalayim yotzot bichle lavan sheulin, shello levayyesh et mi sheen lo. kol hakkelim teunin tevila. uvenot yerushalayim yotzot vecholot bakkeramim. ume hayu omrot, bachur, sa na enecha uree, ma atta vorer lach. al titten enecha vannoy, ten enecha vammishpacha. sheker hachen vehevel hayyofi, ishsha yirat Adonai hi tithallal (Mishlei lo). veomer, tenu lah mipperi yadeha, vihalluha vashshearim maaseha. vechen hu omer, tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo baatara sheittera lo immo beyom chatunnato uveyom simchat libbo (Shir hashshirim 3). beyom chatunnato, ze mattan tora. uveyom simchat libbo, ze binyan bet hammikdash, sheyyibbane vimhera veyamenu. amen:
Mishnah Zevachim 10:1-5:
Kol hattadir mechavero, kodem et chavero. hattemidim kodmim lammusafin, musefe shabbat kodmin lemusefe rosh chodesh, musefe rosh chodesh kodmin lemusefe rosh hashshana, shenneemar (Bamidbar 28), millevad olat habboker asher leolat hattamid taasu et elle: 
Vechol hamekuddash mechavero, kodem et chavero. dam chattat kodem ledam ola, mippene shehu meratztze. evre ola kodmin leemure chattat, mippene shehen kalil laishshim. chattat kodemet leasham, mippene sheddamah nittan al arba keranot veal hayyesod. asham kodem letoda uleel nazir, mippene shehu kadshe kadashim. hattoda veel nazir kodmin lishlamim, mippene shehen neechalin leyom echad, uteunim lachem. shelamim kodmin livchor, mippene shehem teunin mattan arba, usemicha unnesachim utenufat chaze vashok: 
Habbechor kodem lammaaser mippene shekkedushshato merechem, veneechol lakkohanim. hammaaser kodem laofot, mippene shehu zevach veyesh bo kadshe kadashim, damo veemurav: 
Haofot kodmin lammenachot, mippene shehen mine damim. minchat chote kodemet leminchat nedava, mippene shehi vaa al chet. chattat haof kodemet leolat haof. vechen behekdeshah: 
Kol hachattaot shebbattora, kodmot laashamot, chutz measham metzora, mippene shehu va al yede hechsher. kol haashamot shebbattora bain bene shetayim uvain bechesef shekalim, chutz measham nazir vaasham metzora, shehen bain bene shenatan veenan bain bechesef shekalim:
Mishnah Zevachim 7:5-8:2:
Malak bismol, o vallayla, shachat chullin bifnim, vekadashim bachutz, enan metammein bevet habbelia. malak besakkin, malak chullin bifnim, vekadashim bachutz, torin shello higgia zemannan, uvene yona sheavar zemannan, sheyyavash gappa, veshennismet enah, veshenniktea raglah, metamme vevet habbelia. ze hakkelal, kol shehaya fesulah bakkodesh, enah metammea vevet habbelia. lo haya fesulah bakkodesh, metammea vevet habbelia. vechol happesulim shemmalku, melikatan pesula, veenan metammeot bevet habbelia: 
Malak venimtza terefa, rabbi meir omer, enah metammea vevet habbelia. rabbi yehuda omer, metammea vevet habbelia. amar rabbi meir, ma im nivlat behema, shehi metammea vemagga uvemassa, shechitatah metaheret et terefatah mittumatah, nivlat haof sheenah metammea vemagga uvemassa, eno din shettehe shechitatah metaheret et terefatah mittumatah. ma matzinu vishchitatah, shehi machshartah baachila, umetaheret et terefatah mittumatah, af melikatah, shehi machshartah baachila, tetaher et terefatah mittumatah. rabbi yose omer, dayyah kenivlat behema, shechitatah metahartah, aval lo melikatah: 
Kol hazzevachim shennitarvu vechattaot hammetot, o veshor hanniskal, afillu echad beribbo, yamutu chullam. nitarvu veshor shenneevda vo avera, o shehemit et haadam al pi ed echad, o al pi habbealim, berovea, uvenirba, uvemuktze, uveneevad, uveetnan, uvimchir, uvechilayim, uvitrefa, uveyotze dofen, yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru veyavi vidme hayyafe shebbahen meoto hammin. nitarev bechullin temimim, yimmachru hachullin litzriche oto hammin: 
Kadashim bekadashim min bemino, ze yikrav leshem mi shehu veze yikrav leshem mi shehu. kadashim bekadashim, min besheeno mino, yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru, veyavi vidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze, uvidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze, veyafsid hammotar mibbeto. nitarvu vivchor uvemaaser, yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyeachlu kivchor uchemaaser. hakkol yecholin lehitarev, chutz min hachattat umin haasham:
Mishnah Zevachim 8:12-9:3:
Chattat shekkibbel damah bishne chosot, yatza achad mehen lachutz, happenimi kasher. nichnas achad mehen lifnim, rabbi yose haggelili machshir bachitzon, vachachamim poslin. amar rabbi yose haggelili, ma im bemakom shehammachashava foselet, bachutz, lo asa et hameshoar kayotze, mekom sheen hammachashava foselet, bifnim, eno din shello naase et hameshoar kannichnas. nichnas lechapper, af al pi shello chipper, pasul, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi shimon omer, ad sheyyechapper. rabbi yehuda omer, im hichnis shogeg, kasher. kol haddamim happesulin shennittenu al gabbe hammizbeach, lo hirtza hatztzitz ella al hattame, shehatztzitz meratztze al hattame, veeno meratztze al hayyotze: 
Hammizbeach mekaddesh et harauy lo. rabbi yehoshua omer, kol harauy laishshim, im ala lo yered, shenneemar (Vayikra 6), hiv haola al mokda al hammizbeach. ma ola shehi reuya laishshim, im alta lo tered, af kol davar shehu rauy laishshim, im ala lo yered. rabban gamliel omer, kol harauy lammizbeach, im ala lo yered, shenneemar, hiv haola al mokda al hammizbeach. ma ola shehi reuya lammizbeach im alta lo tered, af kol davar shehu rauy lammizbeach im ala lo yered. en ben divre rabban gamliel ledivre rabbi yehoshua ella haddam vehannesachim, sherabban gamliel omer lo yerdu, verabbi yehoshua omer yeredu. rabbi shimon omer, hazzevach kasher vehannesachim pesulim, hannesachim kesherin vehazzevach pasul, afillu ze vaze pesulin, hazzevach lo yered, vehannesachim yeredu: 
Veellu im alu, lo yerdu. hallan, vehattame, vehayyotze, vehannishchat chutz lizmanno, vechutz limkomo, veshekkibbelu fesulim, vezarku et damo. rabbi yehuda omer, shennishchata vallayla, veshennishpach damah, vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim, im alta, tered. rabbi shimon omer, lo tered, shehaya rabbi shimon omer, kol sheppesulo vakkodesh, hakkodesh mekabbelo. lo haya fesulo vakkodesh, en hakkodesh mekabbelo: 
Ellu lo haya fesulan bakkodesh, harovea, vehannirba, vehammuktze, vehanneevad, vehaetnan, vehammechir, vehakkilayim, vehatterefa, vehayyotze dofen, uvaale mumin. rabbi akiva machshir bevaale mumin. rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer, doche haya abba et baale mumin meal gabbe hammizbeach:
Mishnah Zevachim 8:3-7:
Asham shennitarev bishlamim, yiru ad sheyyistaavu. rabbi shimon omer, shenehem yishshachatu vatztzafon, veyeachlu chechamur shebbahen. amru lo, en meviin kadashim levet happesul. nitarvu chatichot bachatichot, kadshe kadashim bekadashim kallim, hanneechalin leyom echad banneechalim lishne yamim, yeachlu chechamur shebbahen: 
Evre chattat shennitarvu veevre ola, rabbi eliezer omer, yitten lemalan, veroe ani et besar hachattat milmalan keillu hu etzim. vachachamim omrim, teubbar tzuratan veyetze levet hasserefa: 
Evarin beevre vaale mumin, rabbi eliezer omer, im karev rosh achad mehen, yikrevu chol harashin. karo shel achad mehen, yikrevu chol hakkeraayim. vachachamim omrim, afillu karvu chullam chutz meachad mehen, yetze levet hasserefa: 
Dam shennitarev bemayim, im yesh bo mare dam, kasher. nitarev beyayin, roin oto cheillu hu mayim. nitarev bedam behema o vedam chayya, roin oto cheillu hu mayim. rabbi yehuda omer, en dam mevattel dam: 
Nitarev bedam pesulin, yishshafech laamma. bedam tamtzit, yishshafech laamma. rabbi eliezer machshir. im lo nimlach venatan, kasher:
Mishnah Zevachim 8:8-11:
Dam temimim bedam baale mumim, yishshafech laamma. kos bechosot, rabbi eliezer omer, karav kos echad, yikrevu chol hakkosot. vachachamim omrim, afillu karvu chullam chutz meachad mehen, yishshafech laamma: 
Hannittanin lematta shennitarvu vannittanin lemala, rabbi eliezer omer, yitten lemala, veroe ani et hattachtonim lemala keillu hen mayim, veyachazor veyitten lematta. vachachamim omrim, yishshafchu laamma. veim lo nimlach venatan, kasher: 
Hannittanin mattana achat shennitarvu vannittanin bemattana achat, yinnatnu mattana echat. mattan arba bemattan arba, yinnatnu bemattan arba. mattan arba bemattana achat, rabbi eliezer omer, yinnatnu vemattan arba. rabbi yehoshua omer, yinnatnu vemattana echat. amar lo rabbi eliezer, vahare hu over al bal tigra. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, vahare hu over al bal tosif. amar lo rabbi eliezer, lo neemar bal tosif ella cheshehu veatzmo. amar lo rabbi yehoshua, lo neemar bal tigra ella cheshehu veatzmo. veod amar rabbi yehoshua, keshennatatta, avarta al bal tosif veasita maase veyadecha. ucheshello natatta, avarta al bal tigra velo asita maase veyadecha: 
Hannittanin bifnim shennitarvu im hannittanin bachutz, yishshafchu laamma. natan bachutz vechazar venatan bifnim, kasher. bifnim vechazar venatan bachutz, rabbi akiva fosel, vachachamim machshirim. shehaya rabbi akiva omer, kol haddamim shennichnesu lechapper bahechol, pesulin. vachachamim omrim, chattat bilvad. rabbi eliezer omer, af haasham, shenneemar (Vayikra 7) kachattat kaasham:
Mishnah Zevachim 9:4-7:
Keshem sheim alu lo yerdu, kach im yardu lo yaalu. vechullan shealu chayyim lerosh hammizbeach, yeredu. ola shealta chayya lerosh hammizbeach, tered. shechatah berosh hammizbeach, yafshit vinattach bimkomah: 
Veellu im alu yerdu, besar kadshe kadashim, uvesar kadashim kallim, umotar haomer, ushete hallechem, velechem happanim, usheyare menachot, vehakketoret. hatztzemer shebberashe chevasim, vehassear shebbizkan teyashim, vehaatzamot, vehaggidim, vehakkarnayim, vehattelafayim, bizman shehen mechubbarin, yaalu, shenneemar (Vayikra 1), vehiktir hakkohen et hakkol hammizbecha. parshu, lo yaalu, shenneemar (Devarim 12), veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam: 
Vechullam sheppaku meal gabbe hammizbeach, lo yachazir. vechen gachelet sheppaka meal gabbe hammizbeach. evarim sheppaku meal gabbe hammizbeach, kodem lachatzot, yachazir, umoalin bahen. leachar chatzot, lo yachazir, veen moalin bahen: 
Keshem shehammizbeach mekaddesh et harauy lo kach hakkevesh mekaddesh. keshem shehammizbeach vehakkevesh mekaddeshin et harauy lahen, kach hakkelim mekaddeshim. kele hallach mekaddeshin et hallach, umiddot hayyavesh mekaddeshot et hayyavesh. en kele hallach mekaddeshim et hayyavesh, velo middot hayyavesh mekaddeshot et hallach. kele hakkodesh shennikkevu, im osim hem meen melachtan shehayu osin vehem shelemim, mekaddeshin. veim lav, en mekaddeshim. vechullan en mekaddeshim ella vakkodesh:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 3:10-12: Orez shebbishshelo o sheasa mimmennu pat battechilla mevarech alav bore mine mezonot ulevassof bore nefashot. uvilvad shello yehe meorav im davar acher ella orez levaddo. aval pat dochan o pat shel shear mine kitnit battechilla mevarech shehakkol ulevassof bore nefashot rabbot:

Kol shemmevarchin alav battechilla hammotzi mevarchin leacharav bassof birkat hammazon kesidrah arba berachot. vechol shemmevarchin alav battechilla bore mine mezonot mevarchin bassof leacharav beracha achat meen shalosh chutz min haorez:

Bamme devarim amurim sheachal mikkezayit ulemala aval achal pachot mikkezayit ben min happat ben mishshear ochlin. vehashshote pachot merviit ben min hayyayin ben mishshear mashkin. mevarech battechilla beracha haruya leoto hammin ulevassof eno mevarech kelal:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 3:8-9: Happat sheppatat otah pittim uvishlah bikdera o lashah bemarak. im yesh bappetitin kezayit o shenikkar shehen pat velo nishtanna tzuratah mevarech aleha battechilla hammotzi. veim en bahen kezayit o sheubbera tzurat happat babbishshul mevarech aleha battechilla bore mine mezonot:

Issa shenneefet bakkarka kemo shehaarviyyim shochne hammidbarot ofim hoil veen aleha tzurat pat mevarech aleha battechilla bore mine mezonot. veim kava mezono aleha mevarech hammotzi. vechen issa shellashah bidvash o beshemen o bechalav o sheerev bah mine tavlin vaafaah vehi hannikret pat habbaa bechisnin af al pi shehu pat mevarech aleha bore mine mezonot. veim kava seuddato aleha mevarech hammotzi:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 4:1-2: Kol hamevarech birkat hammazon o beracha achat meen shalosh tzarich levarech otah bammakom sheachal. achal keshehu mehallech yoshev bemakom sheppasak vivarech. achal keshehu omed yoshev bimkomo vivarech. shachach levarech birkat hammazon venizkar kodem sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav mevarech bammakom shennizkar. veim haya mezid chozer limkomo umevarech. veim berech bammakom shennizkar yatza yede chovato. vechen im berech keshehu omed o keshehu mehallech yatza yede chovato. ulechattechilla lo yevarech birkat hammazon velo beracha shemmeen shalosh ella keshehu yoshev uvammakom sheachal:

Mi shennistappek lo im berech hammotzi o lo berech hammotzi eno chozer umevarech mippene sheeno min hattora. shachach levarech hammotzi. im nizkar ad shello gamar seuddato chozer umevarech veim nizkar leachar sheggamar eno chozer umevarech:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 4:3-5: Haya ochel bevayit ze ufasak seuddato vehalach levayit acher. o shehaya ochel ukeraahu chavero ledabber immo veyatza lo lefetach beto vechazar hoil veshinna mekomo tzarich levarech lemafrea al ma sheachal vechozer umevarech battechilla hammotzi veachar kach yigmor seuddato:

Chaverim shehayu yoshvim leechol veyatzu likrat chatan o likrat kalla. im hinnichu sham zaken o chole chozrin limkoman vegomrin seuddatan veenan tzerichin levarech sheniyya. veim lo hinnichu sham adam keshehen yotzin tzerichin beracha lemafrea ucheshehen chozrin tzerichin beracha lechattechilla:

Vechen im hayu mesubbin bishtiyya o leechol perot. shekkol hameshanne mekomo hare pasak achilato ulefichach mevarech lemafrea al ma sheachal vechozer umevarech sheniyya lechattechilla al ma shehu tzarich leechol. vehameshanne mekomo mippinna lefinna bevayit echad eno tzarich lachazor ulevarech. achal bemizrachah shel teena uva leechol bemaaravah tzarich lachazor ulevarech:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 4:5-7: Vechen im hayu mesubbin bishtiyya o leechol perot. shekkol hameshanne mekomo hare pasak achilato ulefichach mevarech lemafrea al ma sheachal vechozer umevarech sheniyya lechattechilla al ma shehu tzarich leechol. vehameshanne mekomo mippinna lefinna bevayit echad eno tzarich lachazor ulevarech. achal bemizrachah shel teena uva leechol bemaaravah tzarich lachazor ulevarech:

Berech al happat patar et happarperet sheochlin bahen happat mimmine hattavshil uferot vechayyotze bahen. aval im berech al happarperet lo patar et happat. berech al maase kedera patar et hattavshil berech al hattavshil lo patar et maase kedera:

Gamar belibbo milleechol o millishtot veachar kach nimlach leechol o lishtot af al pi shello shinna mekomo chozer umevarech. veim lo gamar belibbo ella dato lachazor leechol velishtot afillu pasak kol hayyom kullo eno tzarich levarech shenit:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 10:10-11:
Hakkorea kede litpor shete tefirot al menat litpor shete tefirot chayyav. aval hakkorea lehafesidah patur mippene shehu mekalkel. hakkorea bachamato o al met shehu chayyav likroa alav chayyav mippene shemmeyashshev et dato bedavar ze veyanuach yitzro vehoil vachamato shochechet bedavar ze hare hu kimtakken vechayyav. vehappoteach bet hatztzavvar beshabbat chayyav: 
Hamedabbek neyarot o orot bekolan shel sofrim vechayyotze bo hare ze toledet tofer vechayyav. vechen hamefarek neyarot devukin o orot devukin velo nitkavven lekalkel bilvad hare ze toledet korea vechayyav:
Niddah 25b:11-18: Hammappelet sandal vechulei. tanu rabbanan: sandal dome laddag shel yam, mittechillato valad hu, ella shennirtzaf. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: sandal dome lallashon shel shor haggadol. mishshum rabbotenu heidu: sandal tzarich tzurat panim.

Amar rav yehuda, amar shemuel: halacha, sandal tzarich tzurat panim. amar rav adda, amar rav yosef, amar rabbi yitzchak: sandal tzarich tzurat panim, vaafillu meachorav. mashal leadam shessatar et chavero, vehechzir panav laachorav.
Bime rabbi yannay, bikkeshu letaher et hassandal sheen lo tzurat panim. amar lahem rabbi yannay: tihartem et havvevladot!

Vehatanya: mishshum rabbotenu heidu: sandal tzarich tzurat panim! amar rav bivi bar abbaye amar rabbi yochanan: meeduto shel rabbi nechuneya nishnet mishna zo. amar rabbi zeera: zecha ba rav bivi bishmateh, daana vehu havena yatvin kammeh derabbi yochanan ki amra leha shemata, ukedam ihu vaamar uzecha ba.
Lamma hizkiru sandal, vahalo en sandal sheen immo valad?
I deityelida nekeva bahadeh — hachi name, hacha bemay askinan — deityelid zachar bahadeh.
Mahu detema: hoil veamar rav yitzchak bar amme, ishsha mazraat techilla — yoledet zachar, ish mazria techilla — yoledet nekeva, middeha zachar — ha name zachar.
Ka mashma lan: ema shenehem hizriu bevat achat, hay zachar vehay nekeva.

Shevuot 38b:3-6: Anasta ufittita et bitti kulei. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi yochanan: may tama derabbi shimon? hoil veikkar kenas hu tovea.

Amar rava: mashal derabbi shimon, lema haddavar dome? leadam sheamar lachavero: "ten li chittin useorin vechussemin sheyyesh li beyadcha", amar lo: "shevua sheen lecha beyadi chittin"; veishtechach dechittin hu delet leh, ha seorin vechussemin it leh – defatur; dechi ishteva achittin – akkusheta mishteva.

Amar leh abbaye: mi dame?! hatam – bechittin ka chafar leh, bisorin vechussemin la ka chafar leh. hacha – bechulla milleta hu deka chafar leh! ha la damya ella leomer lachavero: "ten li chittin useorin vechussemin sheyyesh li beyadcha", "shevua sheen lecha beyadi kelal"; veishtechach chittin hu delet leh, ha seorin vechussemin it leh – demichayyayv!

Ella ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: ledivre rabban shimon – kenas hu tovea, velo boshet ufegam; ledivre chachamim – af boshet ufegam hu tovea. bemay ka mippalgi? amar rav pappa, rabbi shimon savar: la shavek inish midde dekitz, vetava midde dela kitz. verabbanan savri: la shavek midde dechi mode beh la mippetar, vetava midde dechi mode beh mippetar.
Sotah 38b:3-14: Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: minnayin shehakkadosh baruch hu mitavve levirkat kohanim — shenneemar: "vesamu et shemi al bene yisrael vaani avarchem". veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol kohen shemmevarech — mitbarech, vesheeno mevarech — en mitbarech, shenneemar: "vaavarcha mevarchecha".
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol kohen sheeno ole ladduchan — over bishlosha ase: "ko tevarchu", "amor lahem", "vesamu et shemi".
Rav amar: choshshin shemma ben gerusha o ben chalutza hu.
Vela peligi, ha — desalek lifrakim, ha — dela salek lifrakim.

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol kohen sheeno ole baavoda, shuv eno ole, shenneemar: "vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayvarchem vayyered measot hachattat vehaola vehashshelamim", ma lehallan — baavoda, af kan — baavoda.

Ini? veha rabbi amme verabbi assi salki! rabbi amme verabbi assi meikkara havo akri karayyhu, mimta la hava matu hatam. vechidtane rabbi oshaya: lo shanu, ella shello akar et raglav, aval akar et raglav — ole.
Utenan name — im havetachato shennose et kappav vechozer litfillato — rashshay. vehavenan ba: ha la akar? ella denad pureta, hacha name deakar pureta.
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: en notnin kos shel beracha levarech ella letov ayin, shenneemar: "tov ayin hu yevorach ki natan millachmo laddal", al tikre "yevorach" ella "yevarech".
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: minnayin sheafillu ofot makkirin betzare haayin — shenneemar: "ki chinnam mezora harashet beene kol baal kanaf".

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hannehene mitztzare haayin over belav — shenneemar: "al tilcham et lechem ra ayin vegomer ki kemo shaar benafsho ken hu echol ushete yomar lach vegomer". rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: over bishne lavin, "al tilcham", "veal titav".
Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: en egla arufa baa ella bishvil tzare haayin,

Shenneemar: "veanu veamru yadenu lo shafchu et haddam hazze". vechi al libbenu alta shezzikne bet din shofche damim hem? ella, lo ba leyadenu ufetarnuhu, velo reinuhu vehinnachnuhu. lo ba leyadenu ufetarnuhu belo mezonot, lo reinuhu vehinnachnuhu belo levayay.
Zohar, Emor 1: (Vayikra 21:1) vayyomer Adonai el moshe emor el hakkohanim bene aharon veamarta alehem lenefesh lo yittamma beammav. amar ribbi yose, may tama da lokovel da, dichtiv leella, veish o ishsha ki yihye vahem ov o yiddeoni mot yumatu, vesamich leh emor el hakkohanim. ella (mashma) kevan deazhar lehu leyisrael, lekaddesha lehu becholla, azhar lehu lechahane lekaddesha lon, vechen lalviyyim. lechahane minnayin. dichtiv emor el hakkohanim. lelevae minnayin. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 18:26) veel haleviyyim tedabber veamarta alehem. begin deyishtakkechun kullehu zakkain kaddishin dachyayn.

Emor el hakkohanim bene aharon, may tama hacha bene aharon, vechi la yedana divne aharon ninhu. ella bene aharon, vela bene levi, deaharon dehu sheruta dechol kahane dealma, deveh itree kudesha berich hu mikkolla, begin lemebad shelama bealma, uvegin deaharon archoy saliku leh lehay, dechol yomoy deaharon hava mishtaddal leasgaa shelama bealma. uvegin deorchoy kach, salik leh kudesha berich hu lehay, lemeal shelama befamalya dilella, uvegin kach emor el hakkohanim bene aharon.

Emor el hakkohanim bene aharon veamarta alehem. ribbi yehuda patach, (Tehillim 31:20) ma rav tuvecha asher tzafanta lireecha vegomer. ma rav tuvecha, kama illaa veyakkira, hahu nehora illaa deikre tov, dichtiv vayyar elohim et haor ki tov. veda hu or haganuz, deveh avid kudesha berich hu tav bealma, vela mana leh bechol yoma, begin deveh mitkayyem alma, vekaim aleh. asher tzafanta lireecha, ditnan, nehora illaa aved kudesha berich hu kad bara alma, veganiz leh letzaddikayya lezimna deate. hada hu dichtiv, asher tzafanta lireecha.

Paalta lachosim bach. paalta, bezimna deitbere alma, hahu nehora hava kaim venahir meresha dealma lesayyfe dealma. kad istakkal kudesha berich hu, leinnun chayyayvin dizminin lekayyeyma bealma, ganiz leh lehahu nehora, dichtiv (iyyov 38:15) veyimmana mershaim oram. vezammin leanhara letzaddikayyay lealma deate, veda hu asher tzafanta lireecha, uchetiv (Malachi 3:20) vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka umarpe bichnafeha.
Zohar, Nasso 4:22-59: Ribbi yitzchak veribbi yehuda havo azle meusha lelud, amar ribbi yehuda (yitzchak) nema millin deorayyta venezil. patach ribbi yehuda (sefer acher yitzchak) veamar, (Shemot 21:33) ki yiftach ish bor o ki yichre ish bor vegomer. ma ketiv batreh, baal habbor yeshallem vegomer. uma al da kach, man degarim leavasha alma bechovoy al achat kamma vechamma. ella tavvavhna deaf al gav deavish alma, amay it leh teshuva, kema dichtiv ish o isha ki yaasu vegomer vehitvaddu et chattatam veheshiv.

Ella vadday da mehaneya lehu, begin deavid teshuva, kivyachol hu avid leh mammash. deha ma defagim leella, atkin leh, uvema bitshuva. dichtiv ish o ishsha ki yaasu vegomer, vehitvaddu et chattatam veheshiv, uteshuva atkin kolla, atkin leella, atkin letatta, atkin legarmeh, atkin lechol alma.

Patach ribbi yitzchak (sefer acher yehuda) abbatreh veamar, (Devarim 4:30) batztzar lecha umetzaucha kol haddevarim haelle vegomer. batztzar lecha, mikkan ditshuva mealleya mikkolla, ad la yishre dina bealma. devatar dishre dina takkif cheleh man yabar leh mealma visallek leh. deha kevan deshari dina, la istelik ad deyishtelim. batar deishtelim, veavad teshuva, atkin almin kullehu. mashma, dichtiv umetzaucha kol haddevarim haelle beacharit hayyamim, uchetiv veshavta ad Adonai elohecha vegomer. ki el rachum Adonai elohecha vegomer.

Beacharit hayyamim, may ikka hacha. ella leachlela keneset yisrael, deihi begaluta, veishtechachat beaku dilhon, vela shavkat lon lealmin. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu af al gav deashre dina bealma, bae deyahadrun yisrael bitshuva, leotava lehu behay alma, uvealma deate, velet lacha man dekaim kamme teshuva.

Ta chaze, afillu keneset yisrael, teshuva ikre. vei tema (teshuva) illaa (sefer acher mealleya) (nusach acher veet illaa) mikkol atar la shechiach, ella da ikre teshuva, kad ahdar rachame lekavlaha, vehi tavat al kol innun ochlosin veyanka lon. uteshuva mealya, kad itmesar nafsha legabbah, venatil lah bezimna deihi bitshuva, keden kolla ittakkan leella vetatta, veittakkan hu, vechol alma.

Chayyayva chad bealma, kilkula dechamma acharanin begineh. vavy lachayyayva, vavy lishviveh. ta chaze, yona, begin dela baa lemehach bishlichuta demareh, kama bene nasha havo itavidu begineh beyamma, ad dechullehu ahadru aloy, vedainu leh bedina beyamma, ucheden ishtezivu kullehu, vekudesha berich hu chas aleh levatar, vesheziv kama ochlosin bealma. ematay. kad ahdar lemareh miggo akteh. hada hu dichtiv, (Yona 2:3) karati mitztzara li el Adonai vayyaaneni. uchetiv, (Tehillim 118:5) min hammetzar karati yah anani vamerchav yah vegomer.

Raya mehemna pikkuda da, hi mitztzevat teshuva. veda ihi bina. uvaavonotenu middecharav be makdesha, la ishtear lanu ella vidduy devarim levad, veda malchut. umay bina. ben yah. vehay ben, 6 ihu vadday. vechol man dechazar betiyyuveta, keillu chazar at Adonai leat 6, deihu ben yah, veishtelim beh Adonai. veda ihu teshuva, tashuv Adonai vadday legabbe 6.

Deat Adonai vadday ihu vidduy devarim, veraza demilla, (Hoshea 14:3) kechu immachem devarim veshuvu el Adonai imru elav vegomer uneshallema parim sefatenu. devadday kad bar nash ihu chote, garim leitrachaka Adonai meat 6. deistellak ben yah, da Yahu, meat Adonai. uvegin da itcharav be makdesha, veitrachaku yisrael mittamman, veitgelu bene amamya. uvegin da, kol man deavid teshuva, garim leachzera Adonai leat 6, ufurekana beda talyay. uvegin da hakkol taluy bitshuva. dechach amru kadmae, kol hakkitztzim kalu, veen haddavar taluy ella bitshuva, deihu shelimu dishmeh.

Veal da (yechezkel 20:14) vaeese lemaan shemi. veod (Yeshayahu 48:11) lemaani lemaani eese. veim lav chazrin, ana aamid lon malka, shekashin gezirotav mishshel paro, veyachzerun al karchayyeyhu. hada hu dichtiv veshavta ad Adonai elohecha, ad Adonai vadday.

Uteshuva da itkeriat chayyim, (Mishlei 4:23) ki mimmennu totztzeot chayyim, deinnun nishmatin deyisrael. veihu hevel denafak veal befuma debar nash, belo amal uvelo yegia. Adonai dibbehibbaram. vealah ittemar, (Devarim 8:3) ki al kol motztza pi Adonai yichye haadam. vehi al resheh debar nash. ala ittemar, (Bamidbar 12:8) utemunat Adonai yabbit. (Tehillim 39:7) ach betztzelem yithallech ish.
Uvegin deihi al resheh debar nash, asir leh lebar nash lemezal 4 ammot begiluy deresha, deem hi istalakat meal resheh debar nash, miyyad istelaku chayyim minneh.

Vei tema dechach sharya al umin dealma, af al gav dela itbere behon shemaya veara vechol toladin divhon. la sharya vadday, demoshe baa mikudesha berich hu, dela tishre shechina al umin dealma, veyahiv leh. havla dekayyeyma al umin dealma mean nafka. o al chayyayvayya deinnun erev rav meuravin im yisrael. ella vadday let kol appayay shavin, afillu yisrael lav innun shavyan, kol shekken acharanin.

Ella vadday al hay diyyukena deat Adonai ukemuha, mattana tova yish li bevet genazay veshabbat shemah. vechad hay sharya al yisrael, let lon yegia vela shibud. uva nefesh amela vigea (Shemot 31:17) shavat vayyinnafash.

Denefesh achara it al resheh debar nash, deitkeriat eved. veihu diyyukena al bar nash. veihi eved demalka, dimnanea kol evarin debar nash, lemezal bearchin tavin, ulekayyeyma behon 248 pikudin, lesharya alayyhu Adonai dibbehibbaram, dechach salik hibbaram lermch.

Udeyukena achara al resheh, deitkeriat yira, veda 10. vealayyhu ittemar, (Bereshit 1:27) vayyivra elohim et haadam betztzalmo betztzelem elohim. teren diukenin tavin, deinnun dechar venukeba. dechar missitra deat 10. nukeba missitra deat Adonai.

Uteren atvavn attearin leh lebar nash lattora velammitztzeva. 10 yira, veda ihi al resheh debar nash, uminah yeul dechilu lelibba debar nash, lemidchal mekudesha berich hu, ulenatra garmeh dela yevar al pikudin dela taase. Adonai ahava al resheh debar nash, uminneh al rechimu dekudesha berich hu, al 248 evarin dileh, lekayyeyma behon pikudin daase. 6 ihi al resheh debar nash, uminneh yiul al puma debar nash milulin leolfa beorayyta.

Uvehay kechu immachem devarim veshuvu el Adonai. uvehay diyhe bechon hayyira vehaahava vehattora yitchazir Adonai deihu bina teshuva, 6 tashuv legabbe Adonai, deihu ovada divreshit. veihi 32 elohim. veyishtelim yedod uva yehe lechon nayycha mikkolla, uvah shavat vayyinnafash.

Uvah yitkelil 20, uvegin da vaychullu: shelimu decholla. bah, itbere kol alma, vealah kayymin shemaya veara veyamma vechol biryayn deitberun, dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, baAdonai beraam. veim hi itrachakat mealma afillu riga, kolla itcharev veitbatel, vela havi kiuma bealma.

Hay Adonai la tezil miggufa, uvah kayyma vechad hi tezil minneh, hu sam hammavt tete vetishre aleh, detitkere tumea, nevela, pesula, malach hammavt, choshech, afella, vesharya al gufa debar nash. uvehahu zimna itkere bar nash met. veraza demilla, (yechezkel 18:32) ki lo echpotz bemot hammet neum Adonai elohim vehashivu vichyu.

Kol pikudin daase, dahavo atidin lesharya bermch evarin dileh, kullehu mitabbelin aleh. veraza demilla, (Yeshayahu 57:18) derachav raiti veerpaehu vegomer. velaavelav. may velaavelav. illen 248 evarin, deka mitabbelin aleh, deinnun diyyukena illaa desharya al resheh, devah sharya havaya. dichma deit (vayyishlach 165, Shemot 106 amud bet) diyyukena tava al tzaddik, umanhig leh lechol ovadin tavin, lezakkaa leh lealma deate. kach it diyyukena bisha, al resha dechayyayvayya, leanhaga lon beovadin bishin, deyartun gehinnam. uvegin da it hevel veit hevel, it hevel tav, deittemar beh, (Devarim 8:3) ki al kol motztza fi Adonai yichye haadam. veit hevel bish, deittemar beh (Kohelet 2:26) gam ze hevel ureut ruach.

Veta chaze beovadin debar nash ishtemoda partztzufa, deihi aleh, ufartztzufa deanpoy. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 3:9) hakkarat penehem anta bam. bediyyukena, ishtemoda partztzufa dechayya desharya aleh, im hu aryi, o shor o nesher, o adam. mehammerkava dekudesha berich hu ushechinteh. o mehammerkava demalach sar happanim. o mehammerkava bisha desamael. o mehammerkava dearba yesodin dealma. velet behon la hayitztzer tov, vela hayitztzer hara, ella kivirin dealma. uvegin da kama havalim it bivne nasha, kol chad lemineh. veraza demilla, (Bereshit 1:24) totztze haaretz nefesh chayya leminah. uvegin da, bemmidda sheadam moded bah moddin lo. uvechol partztzufa it memana aleh.

Ta chazi, leshit yome bereshit, lechol chad it leh partztzufeh, dehahu darga deanhig leh, vela tishkach yom delet beh tov. veaf al gav divyoma tinyayna la it beh tov, beyoma telitaa tishkach leh. uvegin da ittemar beh tere zimne tov.

Vechol yoma it leh gader millevar, dela yiul kol bar nash lehahu tov. kegon choshech dechasse linhora. detishkach beyoma kadmaa or, vetishkach beh choshech. bechol yoma tishkach netira. veinnun netirin innun, kegon kotztzim lakkerem. veit netirin acharanin, kegon nechashim veakrabbim userafim, venatrin hahu tov, dela yiul tamman delav ihu rauy lemeal. vei lav, kol chayyayvayya havo alin berazin deorayyta.

Uvegin da man deihu chayayva, veyiul leminda razin deorayyta, kama malache chabbala deitkeriu choshech vaafela, nechashim veakrabbim chevat bara itkeriu, umevalbelin machashavteh, dela yiul laatar delav dileh.

Aval man deihu tov, kol illen netirin innun lememreh, vekategor neesa sanegor, veyialun (leh) letov haganuz, veyemrun leh marana, ha bar nash tov vetztzaddik yere shamayim, bae leaala kodamach, amar lanu, (Tehillim 118:19) pitchu li shaare tzedek avo vam ode yah. hahu tov haganuz yimma lon, pitchu leh behay tara deitkere ahava, o behay tara deihi teshuva. kol tzaddik yiul kefum darga dileh, veraza demilla (Yeshayahu 26:2) pitchu shearim veyavo goy tzaddik vegomer.

Kean tzarich leahaddera al petach hatteshuva. vechi mikkamma minin ihu teshuva deavdin bene nasha, kullehu tavin, aval lav kol appayay shavin. it bar nash deihu rasha gamur kol yamav, veihu over al kama pikudin dela taase, umitcharet umode alayyhu, ulevatar ken la aved la tav vela bish. leda vadday yimchol leh kudesha berich hu, aval la deyizke litshuva illaa. it bar nash levatar deyetuv mechataav, umitkapper leh, ihu azil bederech mitztzeva, umitassek bechol kocho bidchilu urechimu dekudesha berich hu. da zache litshuva tattaa, deitkere Adonai. veda ihu teshuva tattaa.

Veit bar nash levatar demitcharet mechovoy, veyavid teshuva, veyitasak beorayyta bidchilu urechimu dekudesha berich hu, vela al menat lekabbel peras. da zache leat 6, veihu ben yah, veal shemeh itkere bina, veda garim detashuv 6 legabbe Adonai. umillat teshuva kach hi, tashuv 6 laAdonai.

Uleolam la sharya Adonai bevar nash, velo 6, bela dechilu uvela rechimu, deinnun yah, yira veahava karenan leh vadday. umittamman ityeyhivu hattora vehammitztzeva deinnun ben uvat. uvegin deyisrael mekayyeymin hattora vehammitztzeva, itkeriu banim lekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem.

Hannistarot: yira veahava, deinnun bemocha velibba. bachalala degufa. uveresha. vehanniglot: hattora vehammitztzeva, deinnun begufa uveresha levar. veraza demilla hachi hu vadday, dei bar nash dachil lekudesha berich hu, o rachim leh, da la yada bar nash achara, begin deihu milla dela itgalya ella beno leven kono.

Aval bar nash demitasak beorayyta, veazil befikkudin daase, da itgalya lechol bar nash, begin dekudesha berich hu aved leh puma beitgalya, leitasseka beorayyta, veayynin leistakkela bah, veudenin lemishma bah. veavid kudesha berich hu bebar nash, yedin veraglin vegufa, lemebad behon pikudin dease.

Im ken chotama lemay nafka minneh. (Bereshit 2:7) vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim, da ihi diyyukena deal bar nash, deittemar beh (Bereshit 28:12) vayachalom vehinne sullam. sullam vadday ihi nishmat chayyim, kurseyay leshem Adonai deihu hayyira vehaahava hattora vehammitztzeva uva sharya, vehay kurseyay, minnah gezurot kol nishmatin deyisrael, veihi diyyukena al resha debar nash.

Vehinne malache elohim olim veyordim bo. illen havalim desallekin venafkin begufa, behay sullam. ihu chad, sheviaa decholla. veihu mutztzav artztza, teren. verosho maggia hashshamayma, telat. vehinne malache elohim olim, tere. veyordim tere. innun lokovel 4 ruchot vehashshamayim vehaaretz. veraza, demilla (Kohelet 1:2) havel havalim amar kohelet havel havalim hakkol havel. innun shiva, lokovel kuresyay, deihu hassullam, vehashshamayim vehaaretz, ved yesodin dealma, veinnun shiva. lokovel shiva yome bereshit. it kol biryayn dishmayya, veyamma, veara. kegon chayot ofot behemot dagim, vechamma toladin detalyayn minneh.

Uvegin decholla itbere behay tzulema, deal kol yisrael deihi tzaddik, ittemar behon (Bereshit 9:2) umoraachem vechittechem yihye al kol chayyat haaretz veal kol of hashshamayim vegomer. veda memallel al bene nasha, deinnun metilin lechevan bara, veliviran, uleofin, ulenune yamma. deit bar nash demazzaleh shor, umazzaleh aryi, umazzaleh nesher, umazzaleh adam.

Vechol illen, lamma mitpachadin mehay diyyukena deinnun mittamman itberiu. ella mishshum deshem Adonai sharya aleh. raza demilla, (Devarim 28:10) verau kol amme haaretz vegomer. vechol man defagim ovadoy, itpegim diyyukeneh. veshem Adonai la sharya baatar pagim, uvehahu pegimu sharya choshech, begin pegimu desihara desharya beh chashocha. vehay bar nash kema deihu pagim diyyukeneh, kach itpegim ihu letatta, o itavid illem, o cheresh, o suma, o chigger. begin diyyehe rashim leella vetatta.

Vehahu choshech sharya bifgimu dileh, umiyyad ishtemodan beh dargin kaddishin, deinnun cheloy dekudesha berich hu, umitrachakin minneh, dichvar yadin divhahu pegimu la sharya malka. uvegin da cheloy demalka mitrachakin minneh, dechayyaylin demalka la sharyayn, vela mitkarvan, ella beatar demalka sharya, dechach innun mitnahagin abbatreh, keevarin batar gufa.

Uvehahu atar deshare hahu choshech, kama malache chabbala, deitkeriu nechashim veakrabbim, mitkarvin leh, veyahavin leh kama neshichin, veillen innun yissurin. vei it leh mamona deovadin tavin deavid, itmaatun minneh. veech itmaatun minneh, ella kol zechut denachit leh milella, yahiv leh leillen malache chabbala, uvatlin minneh yisurin. vei leh leh zechu, vela chova leella, ella kolla letatta, bechol zechu deavid nachit leh mamonin, veumin dealma mitkarvin leh, lokovel malache chabbala, veyahiv lon mamona, veishteziv minnayyhu.

Uvegin da havo yisrael mekarvin laazazil, legabbe hahu choshech. veshivim parim, lokovel shivim umin, lekayyeyma kera, (Mishlei 25:21) im raev sonaacha haachilehu lachem veim tzame hashekehu mayim. umiyyad dehadrin betiyyuveta, itabbar hahu choshech mehahu pegimu, veyishtelim. veraza demilla, (Shmuel b 12:13) gam Adonai heevir chatatcha lo tamut. umiyyad ithaddar beh shema daAdonai, veitterae (nusach acher vaytarepay) beh, meinnun neshichin deyisurin, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 6:10) veshav verafa lo. uminnayin deithaddar kudesha berich hu miyyad dehadar betiyyuveta veishtelim hahu pegimu. hada hu dichtiv, (Malachi 3:7) shuvu elay veashuva alechem.

Veda ihu bitshuva gemura, degarim leahaddera bina deihu 20, legabbe Adonai deihi malchut. deazla menaddeda min kinaha, deihi hahi diyyukena, demitkatrin bah kol pikudin. uvah mitkatrin eser sefiran. kad bar nash aved pikkuda chada vela yattir, veavid lah bidchilu urechimu dekudesha berich hu. beginah sharyayn aleh 10 sefiran. vechol man dekiyyem pikkuda chad kadka yaut, keillu mekayyem 248 pikkudin daase, delet pikkuda delav ihu kelila mikkullehu 248. (ad kan raya mehemana).
Zohar, Vayakhel 16: Tzelota deshabbeta, deamma kaddisha, telat tzelotin ishtechachu behay yoma, lokovel telat shabbate, veukemuha, vechullehu chad. kevan dealu amma kaddisha leve kenishta, asir leishtaddela afillu betzorech be kenishta, ella bemille tushebchan utzelota, veorayyta, vechadka chaze lon.

Uman (206 amud alef, emor 105 amud alef) deishtaddal bemillin acharanin, uvemillin dealma, da ihu bar nash deka mechallel shabbeta, let leh chulaka beamma deyisrael. teren malachin memanan al da, beyoma deshabbeta, veinnun shavu yedehon al resheh, veamre, vavy liflanyya, delet leh chulaka bekudesha berich hu. veal da, bae leishtaddela bitzlota uveshirin uvetushebchan demarehon, uleishtaddela beorayyta.

Hay yoma, ihu yoma denishmatin, deitattera hahu tzerora denishmatin. (betushebchan demarehon) begin kach meshabbeche betushebchan tushbachta denishmeta, vehayeynu (138 amud alef) nishmat kol chay tevarech et shimcha Adonai elohenu veruach kol basar vechulei. velet tushebachta ella besitra denishmeta verucha, vehay yoma, kayyeyma berucha venishmeta, velav degufa.

Tushebachta dedarga achara illaa, raza deyoma, shimsha kaddisha deihu nehora dimama, hayeynu yotzer or. raza dinhora denahir, deminneh itzenan venaharin kol innun chayyaylin, retichin, vechochavayya umazzale, vechol innun deshaltin al alma.
Tushebachta dealma deate beyoma da, hayeynu el adon. vetushebachta da, ihu beraza deesrin uteren atvavn illain kaddishin, demitatteran baavahan uvirticha illaa kaddisha.

Atvavn (hakedama 3 amud bet) zeirin, innun esrin uteren atvavn, deinnun bealma tattaa, deinnun el baruch gedol dea vechulei, vela it ben teva latteva, revavcha achara, ella at reshima bechol teva veteva. (132 amud bet) uvealma illaa, it revavcha, vesitrin kaddishin, ben at leat. veda ihu, tushebachta al tushebachta, deatvavn illain deyoma sheviaa, (204 amud alef) ka meshabbach veamar lemalka illaa yotzer bereshit.

Kad tushebachta da salleka leella, shitin retichin illain dekaamaran, mizdammenin venatle lehay tushebachta meamma kaddisha, vesalke lah leitattera ba, bechamma retichin illain, di memanan, vechol innun tzaddikayyay divginta deeden, kullehu mitatterin betushebachta da, vechol innun retichin, vechol innun nishmatin detzaddikayyay, kullehu sallekin betushebachta da, ad raza dechuresyyay.

Kad mata lechuresyay kaddisha, tushebachta da dechol yisrael, kayyeyma tamman, ad zimna dekamre kedushsha illaa demusaf. ucheden silluka diltatta leella, leitachada kolla leella leella, lemeheve kolla chad. da ihi tushebachta, desalleka al kullehu tushebchan.

Mikkan ulehala, siddura ditzlota dishar yome, ad yismach moshe vechulei, chedvavta dedarga illaa, ikkara daavahan, dechadde behahu adva dileh, kad salik kuresyyay legabbeh, venatil lah, umitchabberan kachada. veda ihu chedva deorayyta illaa dilella, tora shebbichtav. dechadde beorayyta diltatta, tora shebbeal pe, veitchabbaru da beda.
Kevan deitchabbaru kachada, bae bar nash leachlela behahu chedva leamma kaddisha, yismechu vemalchutach shomre shabbat vechulei, elohenu velohe avotenu retze na vimnuchatenu.
Zohar, Vayechi 40: Ribbi yose patach veamar, (Tehillim 2:11) ivdu et Adonai beyira vegilu birada, uchetiv, (Tehillim 100:2) ivdu et Adonai besimcha bou lefanav birnana. ta chaze, kol bar nash deate lemiflach leh lekudesha berich hu, betzafra uvefanya bae lemiflach leh lekudesha berich hu.

Betzafra kad salik nehora, veitaruta distar yemina itar bealma, keden bae bar nash leitkashshera bimina dekudesha berich hu, ulemiflach kammeh befulechana ditzlota. begin ditzlota achsin tukefa leela, veamshich birchan meumeka illaa lechullehu almin, umittamman amshich birchan letattae. veishtakkechu illain vetattain mitbarchan, behahu pulechana ditzlota.

Pulechana ditzlota, deka bae bar nash lemiflach kamme kudesha berich hu, (Shemot 29 amud alef) besimcha uvirnana leachlala lichneset yisrael benayyhu, ulevatar leyaychada yichuda kedka chaze. dichtiv, (Tehillim 100:3) deu ki Adonai hu elohim, da raza deyichuda beraza defulechana.

Veim kol da, bae bar nash lemiflach kammeh dekudesha berich hu bechedva, uleachazaa chedva befulechaneh, veillen teren simcha urenana, lokovel teren illen, teren tzelotin, teren kurebanin leyoma lokovel teren illen, deinun simcha urenana. simcha betzafra, urenana beramsha. veal da, (Bamidbar 28:4) et hakkeves echad taase babboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim.

Veal da, tzelota dearvit reshut ihi, begin dehahi shata mechallek tarpa lechol chelaha, v lav shata leadkara (nusach acher leitbarcha) ella lemehav mezona. bimama hi mitbarechet mitteren sitrin illen, betzafra uveramsha miggo simcha urenana, uvelelya palig birchan lecholla kedka chaze, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vegomer.
Zohar, Vayikra 35: Amar ribbi yose, (Vayikra 18:7) ketiv ervat avicha veervat immecha lo tegalle. uchetiv, immecha hi lo tegalle ervatah. vetanenan immecha hi vadday. ha im gilla eryaytah, leman bae leatava lah, vday letakkena. may degalle.
Detanya kad sagya yitzra bisha bebar nash, la saggi ella beinnun eryayn, vechullehu chove achidan behahu erya. uchetiv lo tegalle. kad ittakkan, ittakkan lokovel hahu degalle, vda ikre teshuva.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, kol chove alma achidan (sefer acher da) beda, ad deimma itgalya beginehon. vechad ihi itgalya, kol innun benin itgalleyayn (beginah). uchetiv (Devarim 22:6) lo tikkach haem al habbanim. vechad ittakkan alma letatta, ittakkan kolla, ad desalleka tikkuna leimma kaddisha, umittakna, veitkasseya mimma deitgalya. uvegin kach ketiv, (Tehillim 32:1) ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa, ucheden ikre teshuva, teshuva vadday. ucheden yom hakkippurim itkere, kema dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:30) mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu.

Amar ribbi yehuda ematay itkere teshuva. kad imma mitkasya vekayyeyma bechedva al benin, dichtiv, (Tehillim 113:9) em habbanim semecha. vetavat bekiyyuma uman dehava sagir, tav leatreh. vechullehu tavin chad lechad, umitbarchan kol chad vechad, ucheden itkere teshuva (shelemata), teshuva setam leachlela kolla.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, kad mitkeshar alma, kuleh mitkeshar kachada. ketiv (Tehillim 108:5) ki gadol meal shamayim chasdecha. meal shamayim, desalleka leella meatar deikre shamayim. umay ihu. da ihi imma. vehayeynu deikre teshuva.

Ribbi yehuda amar, dayyka dichtiv meal shamayim. ilmale ketiv al shamayim, mashma hahu atar dekayyeyma al shamayim, vela yattir. kevan deamar meal shamayim, mashma hahu atar dekayyeyma al hashshamayim leella leella. (sefer acher umay ihi ema, vehayeynu deikre teshuva.)

Detana, behahu zimna demitkashran ovadin letatta, veimma bechedvavta, itgalleya attika kaddisha, vetav nehora lizer anpin, ucheden kolla bechedvavta, kolla bishlimu, kolla ishtechachu bevirkan, verachamin zimnin, vealmin kullehu bechedvavta, hada hu dichtiv, (Micha 7:19) yashuv yerachamenu yichbosh avonotenu. man yashuv. yashuv attika kaddisha leitgalyay bizera, yashuv leitgalyay dehava satim bekadmita, vecholla itkere teshuva.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kolla bichlal, kolla setam. uchetiv (Devarim 13:18) lemaan yashuv Adonai mecharon appo venatan lecha rachamim. amar ribbi yitzchak, kolla hu vadday, veha okimna mille kammeh derabbi shimon.
Zohar, Vayikra 38:269-273: Tu patach veamar, (Mishlei 16:28-29) ish tahpuchot yeshallach madon venirgan mafrid alluf. ish tahpuchot yeshallach madon, kema deamaran, chayyayvayya avde pegimu leella. venirgan mafrid alluf, mafrid alufo shel olam, veda kudesha berich hu.

Davar acher ish tahpuchot yeshallach madon. mahu yeshallach. yeshallach leinnun netian. madon: deyankan missitra dedina. venirgan mafrid alluf, kema deamaran, chayyayvayya avdin pegimu leella. mafrid: deyichuda la ishtechach, mafrid, lematronita mimmalka. ulemalka mimmatronita. uvegin kach la ikre echad, deechad la ikre, ella kad innun beziuuga chada. vavy leinnun chayyayvayya deavdin piruda leella. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, deinnun mekayyman kiuma dilella, vezakkain innun marehon ditshuva detayyvin kolla leatrayyhu.

Veal da tanenan, atar devaale teshuva yatve, tzaddikim gemurim la yatve beh. may tama. ella innun ittakanu baatar illaa, baatar deshakyu deginta mishtechach mittamman. veda hu teshuva. veal da ikrun baale teshuva. veillen ittakanu baatar ochora, deikre tzaddik.

Veal da illen yatvin baatar illaa, veillen yatvin baatar zutera. may tama. illen tayyvin mayya leatrayyhu, meatar illaa denahara amika, ad hahu atar deikre tzaddik. vetzaddikim gemurim, nagdin lon mehahu atar deinnun yatve, lehay alma. val da illen illain villen tattain. zakkaa chulakehon demare teshuva. vzakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, divginehon alma mitkayyeyma.

Hada hu dichtiv vhaya ki yechota vashem vegomer. ma ketiv leella, o matza aveda vechichesh bah vegomer, deha begin da istallak kudesha berich hu mikkolla. kivyachol kudesha berich hu la ishtechach bekiyyumeh, deha keneset yisrael itparsha meatraha, hada hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 7:28) avda haemuna. (35, 191) may emuna. da keneset yisrael. kema deat amer (Tehillim 92:3) viemunatcha ballelot. avda haemuna kema deat amer (Yirmeyahu 9:11) al ma avda haaretz, vecholla chad. vha okimna avda, vla neevedet, vla avuda. kegavvna da, (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatzaddik avad, avud, o neevad, la ketiv, ella avad. hada hu dichtiv avda haemuna, begin kach veheshiv et haggezela o et haaveda vegomer.

rashi: Leish acher. en ze ben zugo shel rishon, hu hotzi reshaa mittoch beto veze hichnisah (sham):
Meaz appecha. mishshaa sheatta koes:
targum: Ant dechil ant hu elaha uman yekum kodamach meidan deyitkof rugezach:

rashi: Ki yimmatze. beedim vehateraa, vechen kol "yimmatze" shebbattora:
Vehitammer bo. eno chayyav ad sheyyishtammesh bo:

Ki kaasher yakum vegomer. lefi feshuto zehu mashmao: ki anusa hi uvechazka amad aleha, keadam haomed al chavero lehargo. verabbotenu darshu vo hare ze va lelammed venimtza lamed vechulei (sanhedrin 73):
Lo yavo ammoni. lo yissa yisreelit:
ohc: Lo yavo ammoni vegomer al devar vegomer. kashe amro asher lo kiddemu, vahalo matzinu sheamar hakkatuv (Devarim 2:29) "kaasher asu li bene esav vegomer vehammoavim", ufershu rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Rashi sham) shechozer lemaamar "ochel bakkesef". 2, achar shehem sachru alehem bilam lekallelam, ma makom lachush al shello kiddemu ballechem. veulay sheamar al devar vegomer lehair sheal sibba zo bilvad yitchayyev haddin leharechikam shello yavou bakkahal. uferush "kiddemu" hi lehotzi doron lesaed libbam ballechem vechulei, shehem chayyavim laasot ken mikkol haummot, keal kol haggemulot asher gemalam avraham avinu alav hashshalom, ki ma shemmachru lahem lechem umayim haya lahanaatam shel moav, gam lefattotam lehappilam baarayot, vehu ma sheddikdek hakkatuv lomar lo kiddemu etchem perush, lahanaatchem.

Od yitbaaru hakketuvim al pi divrehem zichronam livracha bivamot daf 76, sheamru: mena hane mile shemmoavit mutteret? amar rabbi yochanan vechulei, dekaamar kera vegomer. amar leh avner: tanina "moavi" velo moavit. amar lo doeg: ella meatta "mamzer" vechulei "mitzri" velo mitzrit? shane hacha dimfaresh tama "al devar" vegomer, darko shel ish vechulei veen darkah vechulei, haya lahem lekaddem vechulei venashim likrat nashim. bau leachruze aleh, miyyad, "vaamasa" vegomer, melammed shechagar charbo vechulei, veamar: kol mi sheeno shomea halacha zo yiddaker bacherev, mekubbelani mippi bet dino shel shemuel – "moavi" velo moavit. mikkol makom kashya, tirgema "kol kevudda vat melech penima". ketannae: "ammoni" velo ammonit, "moavi" velo moavit – divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi shimon omer: "al devar asher lo" vegomer, darko shel ish lekaddem vechulei, ad kan leshonam. vechatvu hattosafot bedibbur hammatchil "ketannae" veze leshonam: veim tomar, lerabbi yehuda tikshe leh mitzri, veomer rabbenu yitzchak degabbe ammoni umoavi haya lo lekatztzer velichtov ammon umoav, hilkach it lan lemidrash dilmaet ammonit umoavit, aval mitzri im haya kotev mitzrayim haya maarich, vehay dechatav adomi velo chatav edom, aggav mitzri katav adomi, ad kan leshono.

Veen divre hattosafot nirim, ki lo matzinu sheyyomar hakkatuv lashon battechilla aggav ma sheatid lomar acharav, uma gam bemakom sheyyesh litot bahalachot. veod, bishlama im chalukat mitzri atzmah haya tzarich hakkatuv lichtov "mitzri", yesh makom lomar sheshshinna hakkatuv beshellefaneha ledabber kayyotze bah, veim mitzri atzmah lo dibber hakkatuv kahogen, shehaya tzarich lichtov "mitzrim" lichlol mitzrit, ella sheanu omrim shello ratza lehaarich, ech nomar sheamar "adomi" aggav "mitzri" shemmitzri gufah aleha ani dan?

Velavo leomek haddavar yesh lehair bedivre avner, lamma achaz hachevel bishne rashin? mittechilla amar diyyuk "moavi" kisvarat rabbi yehuda, vechazar latet taam "al devar asher lo kiddemu" vegomer kisvarat rabbi shimon, ki mimmashmaut hallashon muchach shekkesheamar taam sheni lo chazar bo mittaam harishon. vehassevara notenet ken, sheim lo chen lamma amar avner taam shessetirato betziddo? bishlama lerabbi yehuda ledivre hattosafot, hagam shehikshenu alehem, lisvaratam miha amar devarav mittaam sheamru, ella avner hare gilla dato bema shechazar mikkusheyat "mitzri" sheeno sover lechallek kemo shechilleku hattosafot.

Achen nire ki kavvanat avner lisvarat rabbi yochanan hi, sheddoresh meamro "moavi" umeamro "al devar asher" vegomer, shezzulat "al devar" yesh listor hadderasha mimmitzri". vetaam "al devar asher" vegomer levad, im haya omer "moav veammon", hagam sheomer "al devar" vegomer hayinu omrim, hagam shehattaam eno tzodek ella baanashim, baa haggezera al kullo keachat. veod, shehannashim baim gam ken mizzera pasul, shehem hazzecharim sheasurin, uvechayyotze baze en anu holchim ella achar haav, dichtiv (Bamidbar 1:2) "lemishpechotam levet avotam". veim amar "ammoni umoavi" velo haya lanu taam "al devar", hayinu omrim sheamar "moavi" kemo sheamar "mitzri" vaadomi", umishshenehem doresh velo ammonit velo moavit.

Velaze amar avner shene teamim hannizkarim, umachloket rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon hi al ze hadderech, ki rabbi yehuda sover detaam "moavi" levad yitchayyev lomar velo moavit, umaamar "al devar" eno mechayyeveni lo lerabbot velo lemaet kaasher avaer hattaam, vetaam "mitzri" veadomi" mishshum shehattaam shennatan hakkatuv mechayyeveni lichlol gam mitzrit vaadomit shekkol kach hem achim haanashim kannashim, gam gerut haaretz shehayinu vah shavim bah anashim venashim, velo chash hakkatuv lomar mitzri vaadomi kevan sheen makom litot kannizkar, velo savar kerabbi shimon lehochiach meamro "al devar", o mittaam shekkatavnu beferush divre avner o mittaam sheyyesh lachush lidchiyyato shel doeg.

Uma shettirgema baggemara "kol kevudda" (tehillim 45:14), yesh letzadded velomar efshar shello amar "kol kevudda vat melech penima" ella davka bichvudda, lo bezona, achar sheanu roin maaseha maase chatzufot, gala kavod mehem vechazar haddin lomar haya lahem lekaddem vechulei venashim lenashim. veyesh panim lomar sheen lehavi reaya mehafekaratam liznut mishshene teamim: 1 anusim hayu mitztzad shehifkirum haanashim, 2 hattora lo takpid alehem lamma lo asu davar sheen derech eretz lenashim laasoto mishshum "kol kevudda", hagam shehem zilzelu beatzman bedavar acher. umeatta haddevarim shekulim veen hochacha meal davar, vehochiach middikduk ammoni umoavi.
