Verabbi shimon sover behacheraa ki leolam yeshnam betaanat "kol kevudda" (tehillim 45:14) ufeturim mehakedamat hallechem, vedarshinan taam hakkatuv. ulederech ze yitbaer amram baggemara "ketannae" shechozer al maamar "kol kevudda vat melech penima" velaze semachah lah, ki lefi perushenu kol ikkar machloktam shel rabbi yehuda verabbi shimon enah ella im yeamer alehem taanat "kol kevudda" o lo.

Nimtzeta omer shalosh sevarot beaggada zo: lefi shemuat rabbi yochanan doresh meamro "moavi" umeamro "al devar", velisvarat rabbi yehuda meamro "ammoni" levad, velisvarat rabbi shimon ikkar hadderasha hu meamro "al devar".

Umeatta bishlama ledivre rabbi shimon, gam lishmuato shel rabbi yochanan yesh taam nachon lemaamar al devar, ella lisvarat rabbi yehuda sheeno doresh ella mittevat ammoni umoavi, kusheyatenu bimkomah omedet, lamma hutzrach lomar hakkatuv al devar. veyityashshev kemo shekkatavnu bitchillat hainyan.

Shuv amadti el tochen inyan ze veraiti sheen taana al hannekevot lekaddem lenashim, ki hagga atzmecha sheyyirtzu belibbam lekaddem, hayachol yuchelu asot belo reshut baalehen? uma gam birot baalehen oyvim lahem, anusim hem hagam shello yekaddemu otam. umeatta en taanat "asher lo kiddemu" ella al hazzecharim, veamad haddin "ammoni" velo ammonit, "moavi" velo moavit. vetaanat doeg taanat min, uchemo sheamar achiyya hashshiloni kesheamru lefanav kusheya zo, hefirah veamar "minaa", kaamur bammidrash (midrash Shmuel 22).

rashi: Ki tetze lammilchama. bemilchemet harshut hakkatuv medabber, shebbemilchemet eretz yisrael en lomar veshavita shivyo, shehare chevar neemar (Devarim 20) lo techayye kol neshama:
Veshavita shivyo. lerabbot kenaanim shebbetochah veaappi shehem mishiva ummot (sifre; sota 35):
ohc: Ki tetze lammilchama al oyvecha vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar kol ze, shello haya tzarich lomar ella "ki tire bashshivya eshet" vegomer? od, achar sheamar "ki tetze lammilchama" lo haya tzarich lomar "al oyvecha". veulay ki lefi shebba hakkatuv lehattir yefat toar sheasura shello bishat milchama, gam lehattir kadle dachazire (chullin 17.) ushear issurin, chash hakkatuv shebbitziat yisrael lammilchama raglehem lara yarutzu kede sheyyehanu middevar issur. laze ba hakkatuv vehitna veamar ki tetze – tihye yetziatcha lammilchama lehinnakem meoyvecha shehem oyve Adonai, al derech amro (Tehillim 139:21) "halo mesanecha Adonai esna vegomer leoyvim hayu li". letaam ze tihye yetziatcha, veim taase chen – "unetano Adonai elohecha beyadecha veshavita shivyo". umizze atta lamed shezzulat ken, im tihye yetziatcha letaam acher vehattaam muvan mimma sheamar bainyan, eno muvtach sheyyittenehu Adonai beyado.

Veshavita shivyo. mitzva, kede shello yerae kimzalzel bemattenat melech, o nitkavven leesor yefat toar kol od shello shavu shivyo, shello yomar adam kevan shehuttera li echtefenna veolichenna veevalenna, talmud lomar veshavita shivyo veraita bashshivya perush keshettishbe otah vetihye shellecha im raita bashshivya vegomer. vetaam amro shivyo velo amar oto, rabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (sifre) shehakkatuv medabber bemilchemet reshut, vedikdek lomar shivyo afillu hu mehakkenaani shenneemar bo (Devarim 20:16) "lo techayye kol neshama":

Od yirtze, lefi shenneemar "unetano Adonai vegomer beyadecha", laze kesheamar veshavita gamar omer shivyo, perush ma sheshshavuy veomed lefanecha. od ramaz shehagam shettihye atta begeder shivyo lefi erech hammishtaer lallochem venilcham, af al pi chen "veshavita". umizze enecha techezena ki Adonai hu hannotno lefanecha, velo kochacha veotzem yadcha ose chayil.
Vehaya habben habbechor vegomer. amar hakkatuv bederech vaddait, al derech amro (Bereshit 29:31) "vayyar Adonai ki senua lea", ki Adonai yire benishbere lev lesamcham.

rashi: Ad derosh achicha. vechi taale al datecha sheyyittenehu lo kodem sheyyidreshehu? ella darshehu shello yehe rammay (bava metzia 27; 80 sifre):
Vahashevoto lo. shettehe vo hashava, shello yochal bevetcha kede damav vetitbaem mimmennu. mikkan amru, kol davar sheose veochel yaase veyochal vesheeno ose veochel yimmacher (bava metzia 28):
Veamad. baamida (sifre):
Veamar. bilshon hakkodesh, veaf hi devareha bilshon hakkodesh (yevamot 106; sifre):
Vedavid holech. haya holech vashav tamid meetzel shaul levet aviv:
targum: Vedavid azal vetav milvat shaul lemire yat ana daavuhi bet lechem:

rashi: Ki timmaes. keshettimmaes, peamim shekkoes aleha meat:
targum: Are cheitta shevika veaykat ruach arach shechinta dayya ucheittat ulemin deitrachakat amar elahayich:

rashi: Veshielu vedarshu mecharvotehem. hakkol yishalu alehem: ma nihyeta bifloni ufeloni? mittoch kol chureba sheyyatza alehem:

Vedarshu. mashma: meet acherim, shehare nakud chataf kamatz, vechen veshielu. mippi acherim hu mashma, sheyyishalu acherim alehem. veyesh liftor veshielu, mimmishkal chazak: yihyu meshaalim al happetachim:
targum: Veitaltela yetaltelun benoy veshaalun vetivun midhavat tzarathon:

rashi: Ki yikkare. perat limzumman (chullin 139):
Lo tikkach haem. beodah al baneha:
Lo tihye kedesha. mufkeret mekuddeshet umezummenet liznut:

Velo yihye kadesh. mezumman lemishkav zechur; veunkelos tirgem "la tehe itteta mibbenat yisrael ligvar aved", sheaf zo mufkeret livilat zenut hi, meachar sheen kiddushin tofsin lo bah, shehare hukkeshu lachamor, shenneemar "shevu lachem po im hachamor" – am haddome lachamor, vela yissav gavra mibbene yisrael itteta ama, sheaf hu naase kadesh al yadah, shekkol beilotav beilot zenut, sheen kiddushin tofsin lo bah (80 kiddushin 68):
Mimmaarot pelishtim. ketiv, rabbotenu darshu (sota 42 2): mea bene adam heeru bearpa immo, kesheppersha meachare rut venoomi chamotah:
targum: Vehu memalel imhon veha gavra mibbenehon selik galyat pelishtaa shemeh migat misidre felishtae umalel kefitgamaya hailen ushema david:

rashi: Umetzaah ish bair. lefichach shachav immah – pirtza kora laggannav, ha illu yashva bevetah, lo era lah (sifre):
Shimi vat urei. shimi keneset yisrael urei derech hattov (Shir HaShirim Rabba 1:3):
Vehatti aznech. lattora:
Veshichchi ammech. meever hannahar sheat gedela benehem:
Uvet avich. avoda zara sheavdu avotecha beever hannahar (Yehoshua 24:2):
targum: Shimi kenishta deyisrael orayat pumeh vachami ferishat ovadoy vetitzle udenach lefitgame orayyta vetitneshe ovadin bishin derashii amech uvet taavat diflacht vet avuyich:

rashi: Lo yachavol. im ba lemashkeno al chovo bevet din, lo yemashkenennu bidvarim sheosim bahen ochel nefesh (42 113):
Rechayim. hi hattachtona:
Varachev. hi haelyona:

Banim asher yivvaldu lahem dor shelishi vegomer. ushear ummot muttarim miyyad, ha lamadta shehammachati laadam kashe lo min hahorgo, shehahorgo horgo vaolam hazze vehammachatio motzio min haolam hazze umin haolam habba, lefichach edom shekkiddemam bacherev lo nitav, vechen mitzrayim shettibbeum, veellu shehechetium nitavu (sifre):
Bedor acher. sheyyavo achar korto, yimmach shemo vetivo, sheafillu zikkaron lo yippol alav befi haddor hannolad baolam leachar shennishchat shemo. 961 belaaz:
targum: Yehe sofeh leishtetzaya bedar ocharan yitmeche shimhon:

rashi: Hakem takim. zo teina – lehatein massooy shennafal mealav:
Immo. im bealav, aval im halach veyashav lo veamar lo hoil vealecha mitzva im ratzita liton teon, patur (sham 32):
Kimnor orgim. tirgem yonatan "keachsan degardain", 400 109:
Shesh meot shekalim. kol hashshekalim haamurim binviim, manim:
targum: Veaa demureniteh keachsan degardain veshinana demureniteh matkal shit mea tikle farzela venatal teresa azel kodamohi:

rashi: Nivrecha. leshon "vayyavrech et haggemallim" (Bereshit 24:11):
targum: Etun nisgod venigchan nachamot kodam Adonai daavid yatana:

rashi: Lo tacharosh beshor uvachamor. hu haddin lechol shene minim shebbaolam (bava kamma 54), hu haddin lehanehigam yachad keshurim zugim beholachat shum massa (kilayim 88 42):
Motza sefatecha tishmor. litten ase al lo taase (sham 6):
ohc: Motza sefatecha tishmor vegomer, perush, tamtin millehotzi hanneder mippicha ad shettuchal laasot, perush lekayyem hanneder, az tiddor utekayyem hanneder samuch lenidrecha, vehu amro veasita kaasher nadarta, vechen haya hillel ose shehaya mevi karbano laazara veamar (fesachim 66:) vechulei.

O shiur hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: motza sefatecha tishmor milledabber, vetaase keillu nadarta laAdonai elohecha hagam sheeno ella nedava, vehu amro kaasher nadarta nedava asher nadva ruchacha, ki mashmaut nedava hi ballev, keamro (Shemot 25:2) "asher yiddevennu libbo", "nadva rucho" (Shemot 35:21).

Veamro asher dibbarta beficha yitbaer al derech amram bazzohar (11 294.) befasuk (Kohelet 10:20) "ki of hashshamayim yolich et hakkol", ki kesheadam choshev bedato machshava, siftotav dovvot meatzman belo yediato, vehu amro asher dibbarta beficha, ki hagam shello asa ella machshava, picha dibber ma shechashav. velaze dikdek lomar beficha, sheim lo chen lamma hutzrach lomar "beficha", vechi en anu yodim ki haddibbur hu bappe? velidvarenu yavo al nachon. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (rosh hashshana 6.) darshu hakkatuv beofen acher, veshivim panim lattora.

rashi: Ki yeshvu achim yachdav. shehayta lahem yeshiva achat baolam, perat leeshet achiv shello haya veolamo (sifre; yevamot 17):
Yachdav. hameyuchadim bannachala, perat leachiv min haem (sham):
Uven en lo. ayyen alav, ben o vat o ven habben o vat habben o ven habbat o vat habbat (80 yevamot 22):
ohc: Lo tihye eshet hammet vegomer. azhara lah ulevaeha, vechayyevet malkut hi vehabba aleha, veamro yevamah yavo aleha ramaz sheen chiyyuv al hayyavam ella bia achat, uchemaamar rabbi yose (shabbat 118:) chamesh beilot baalti vechamesh netiot natati, veamru bayyerushalmi (yevamot 81 hei) shennaflu lo chamesh yevamot mechamishsha achim venizkak paam achat lechol achat. veamro ulekachah shello tomar sheosrah alav mikkan veelach, talmud lomar "ulekachah lo leishsha", sheharshut beyado im yirtze lekayyemah olamit. veamro veyibbemah shello tomar shello neemru kol haddevarim haamurim ella reshut, lefi sheasarah hakkatuv laolam hittira layyavam, aval hattora lo chiyyavto baddavar, talmud lomar "veyibbemah".

rashi: Lo tashshich. azhara lallove shello yitten ribbit lammalve (80 sifre) (veachar kach azhara lammalve et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech):
Veyitav hammelech yafyech. veim taasi ken, yitavve hammelech hakkadosh baruch hu lenoye maasayich:
targum: Uvechen yerageg malka shuferach arum hu ribbonech vetisgedun leh:

rashi: Lo tatte mishpat ger yatom. veal heashir kevar huzhar (Devarim 16) "lo tatte mishpat", veshana veani laavor alav bishne lavyn, lefi shennakel lehattot mishpat ani yoter mishshel ashir, lechach hizhir veshana alav (sifre):
Velo tachavol. shello vishat halevaa:
ohc: Lo tatte mishpat ger vegomer. perush, shemma tomar kevan shetztzivvani Adonai al hagger atte dino lizchuto, talmud lomar "lo tatte" vegomer. vegamar omer velo tachavol beged almana, perush, rak baddavar hazze ani metzavvecha lehattot lizchut, shello tachavol beged shel almana shello bishat halevaa, hagam shekkol chutz mimmenna yachavol bigdehem.

rashi: Lo tachsom shor. dibber hakkatuv bahove, vehu haddin lechol behema chayya veof haosim bimlacha shehi bidvar maachol; im ken lamma neemar shor? lehotzi et haadam (sifre; bava metzia 88):

Bedisho. yachol yachsemennu mibbachutz? talmud lomar "lo tachsom shor" — mikkol makom; velamma neemar dayish? lomar lecha ma dayish meyuchad davar shello nigmera melachto vegiddulo min haaretz, af kol kayyotze vo, yatza hacholev vehamegabben vehamechabbetz sheen giddulo min haaretz, yatza hallash vehamekattef shennigmera melachto lechalla, yatza habbodel bitmarim uvigrogrot shennigmera melachtan lammaaser (sifre; 42 89):
Velo yire vecha. hakkabba ervat davar:
Vehesira et simlat shivyah. lefi shehem naim, shehaggoyim benotehem mitkashshetot bammilchama bishvil lehazenot acherim immahem (sifre):
Veyashva bevetecha. babbayit shemmishtammesh bo, nichnas venitkal bah, yotze venitkal ba, roe bivchiyyatah, roe beniuulah, kede shettitganne alav (sifre):
Uvachta et aviha. kol kach lamma? kede shettehe bat yisrael semecha vezo atzeva, bat yisrael mitkashshetet vezo mitnavvelet (sham):
Even shelema vatzedek yihye lach. im asita ken, yihye lecha harebe:
Hishshamer benega hatztzaraat. shello titlosh simane tuma velo takotz et habbaheret (makkot 22):
Kechol asher yoru etchem. im lehasegir im lehachalit im letaher:
ohc: Hishshamer benega vegomer zachor vegomer. ledivrehem zichronam livracha (shabbat 132:) sheamru shebba lehazehir leval yakotz bahareto, nitkavven behasemachat zachor et asher asa Adonai lemiryam lehodia shoresh shemmimmennu yihye hannega veoto yetzav Adonai lakotz verafa.

rashi: Yaase chafshi. middevarim haamurim bemishpete hammelucha:
targum: Vaamar enash yisrael hachazetun gavra desalik haden are lechasada yat yisrael selik vihe gavra deyiktelineh yaatterineh malka otar sagi veyat beratteh yitten leh veyat bet avuhi yaabbed chorin ravrevin beyisrael:

rashi: Vetoafot. leshon gova, keof hammeofef:
targum: Di videh talyan pishpushin deara vetukefe rum turaya di leh:

rashi: Lo teacher leshallemo. shelosha regalim, ulemaduhu rabbotenu min hammikra (rosh hashshana 4):
ohc: Vehaya vecha chet vegomer. perush, al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat lev:) baavon nedarim metim ishto uvanav shel adam, ad kan, vehu amro vehaya vecha chet leshon chissaron, sheal yede ichur hanneder yechsar mimmennu ishto shehi kegufo o zaro shehu gam ken chelek mimmennu.

rashi: Ki tivne bayit chadash. im kiyyamta mitzvat shilluach hakken, sofcha livnot bayit chadash, utekayyem mitzvat maake, shemmitzva goreret mitzva, vetaggia lecherem vesade velivgadim naim, lechach nismechu parashiyyot hallalu (tanchuma):
Maake. gader saviv laggag, veunkelos tirgem "teyaka", kegon tik shemmeshammer ma shebbetocho:
Ki yippol hannofel. rauy ze lippol, veaappi chen lo titgalgel mitato al yadcha, shemmegalgelin zechut al yede zakkay vechova al yede chayyav (sifre):
Hashshara. ketargumo — litra bet dina:
Veyisseru oto. malkut (sham):
Beefes dammim. kach shem hammakom:
targum: Uchenashu felishtae yat mashritehon leagacha kerava veitkanashu leshocho di leshevet yehuda ushero ben shocho uven azeka beefes damim:

rashi: Veamar avi hannaara. melammed sheen reshut laishsha ledabber bifne haish (sham):
Lamma tetzu. kullechem laaroch milchama, yillachem echad kenegdi bishvil kullechem, uvitnay shehu meforash: im yuchal lehillachem itti vegomer:

Halo anochi happelishti. eni lo sar mea velo sar elef, ella felishti keechad min haacherim, veaf al pi shennilchamti lahem kamma milchamot, ani haragti chafni ufinchas, veshaviti et haaron, veattem naasetem avadim leshaul, velo hoshia etchem miyyamav bigvurato:
Beru lachem. barru lachem:
Ish. et shaul, veyered elay:
targum: Vekam veachrez al sidre yisrael vaamar lehon lema tifkun lesadra kerava hala ana felishtaa veattun avdin leshaul (ana hu galyat pelishtea demin gat diktalit teren bene eli kahane chafni ufinchas usheveti yat aron koyama dayya veovelit yateh levet dagon taavati vahava taman bekirve felishtae shava yarchin af kol kerav ukerav dahavo lehon liflishtae ana nafek beresh chela unetzachna vikrava uremina ketilin keafra deara vead kean la achsharu yati pelishtae lemeheve rav alfa ilavehon veattun bene yisrael ma gevura avad lechon shaul bar kish demin givata demanitun yateh malka ilavechon im gevar gibbar hu yechot veyabed kerava imi veim gevar chalash hu) becharu lechon gavra veyechot levati:

rashi: Lo teolel. im matzata vo olelot, lo tikkachenna. vee zo hi olelot? kol sheen lah lo katef velo natef. yesh lah echad mehem — hare hi levaal habbayit (sifra); veraiti vetalmud yerushalmi e zo hi katef? pesigin ze al gav ze, natef — ellu hatteluyot bashshidra veyordot:
Yattu. lemerachok
Metarayich. hem chavalim dakkim hatteluyim beshule ohalim, vekoshrim bitedot, shekkorin 442 109, vetokin baaretz:
targum: Afti atar bet meshrach umikirve arich yatve la timnein asga am mashiryatich veshiltonayich takifi:

rashi: Lo yikkach. en lo bah likkuchin veen kiddushin tofsin bah (80 kiddushin 67):

Velo yegalle kenaf aviv. shomeret yavam shel aviv haruya leaviv, vahare kevar huzhar aleha mishshum ervat achi avicha (Vayikra 18) ella laavor al zo bishne lavin, velismoch lah lo yavo mamzer, lelammed sheen mamzer ella mechayyave karetot, vekal vachomer mechayyave mitot bet din, sheen baarayot mitat bet din sheen bah karet (yevamot 49):
Lo tefaer. lo tittol tifarto mimmennu (chullin 131), mikkan shemmannichin pea lailan:
Acharecha. zo shichcha:
Hayyom. baolam hazze im bekolo tishmau:
targum: Arum hu elahana vaanachna ameh veaan raayat aydeh yoma den im bememreh tekabbelun:

rashi: Ufarsu hassimla. hare ze mashal, mechuvvarin haddevarim kassimla (sam; ketuvot sam):
Lo yihye cheli gever al ishsha. shettehe doma leish, kede shettelech ben haanashim, sheen zo ella leshem niuf (80 sifre):
Velo yilbash gever simlat ishsha. lelech leshev ben hannashim. davar acher — shello yashshir sear haerva vesear shel bet hashshechi (nazir 59):
Ki toavat. lo asra tora ella levush hammevi lide toeva (80 sifre):
Alumayich. neurayich:
targum: La tidchalin are la tivhatin vela titkanin are la titkalmin are vahatat ulemutich titneshin vechisude armelutich la tidkerin od:

rashi: Vehitallamta. kovesh ayin keillu eno roehu:
Lo tire … vehitallamta. lo tire oto shettitallem mimmennu, zehu peshuto. verabbotenu amru peamim sheatta mitallem vechulei (sifre; bava metzia 30):
ohc: Lo tire et shor vegomer. parasha zo baa lirmoz bifratut chiyyuv hattochachot shetztzerichin bene el chay tzaddike olam laasot leam Adonai, vehen elle tzaddikim yikkaru letzad maalatam achim, kemo sheheiroticha shekkinnuy ze hu madrega hayyoter meulla shebbechol kinnuyim asher yittachnu bahem yechide am (Shemot Rabba 52,5), veotam tzivva Adonai ki tire et shor, elle hem bene adam shennimshelu kabbehemot vehem tzon kadashim, velaze keraam shor vase, achicha shehu hakkadosh baruch hu, veyiches lo shem ze lehair el mi mikkedoshav hu metzavve, shehem hatztzaddikim kemo shekkatavnu.

Veamro niddachim – al derech amro (Devarim 4:19) "veniddachta vehishtachavita lahem" vegomer, shehaover pi Adonai yikkare niddach, vitzav Adonai leval yitallem ella yeshivem leachiv, hu elohe olam. vechafal lomar "hashev teshivem", nitkavven ki mittechilla yeshivem lederech hattov uvaze yitkarvu el avihem shebbashshamayim, vehu amro "teshivem leachicha".

Veamro veim lo karov achicha vegomer. baze heir ki hu medabber al zeman galut haacharon, ki lo karov, kederech amro (Bamidbar 24:17) "ashurennu velo karov", od lo "velo yedato", shennistam hakketz veen yodea matay ketz happelaot, veze yesovev harechakat hallevavot mehaemuna unetuye regel kaasher enenu root baddorot hallalu. im kol ze yetzav Adonai vaasafto el toch betecha – ze bet hammidrash, vilammedehu archot chayyim vederech yishkon or, leval yitte minni orach velo yimtzaehu oyvo bemachshavot vetaanot kozvot, ki or tora tatztzilehu. veze yihye ad sheyyitratztze Adonai veyidreshehu, vehu amro ad derosh achicha oto. vahashevoto lo – perush, maale alav hakkatuv keillu hu meshivo minni oved.

O yirtze, shetztzarich hechacham lehishtaddel im bene yisrael bechoach hattora vehammusar ad yom pekudda sheyyidrosh Adonai nishmato, veaz haruach tashuv el haelohim, vedikdek lomar vahashevoto lo, sheim yimadu karsullav lo tashuv hannefesh el haelohim vetelech lacharafot.

Veamro vechen taase. lefi sheyyesh beemtzaut haadam shelosha devarim: ha harekavat hagguf, 2 chelek haruchani shebbaadam, 3 chelek hattora hameoreset lechol echad miyyisrael. keneged harekavat hagguf amar ken taase lachamoro, keneged chelek haruchani amar ken taase lesimlato, ki bechina zo tikkare simla, keamram bemassechet shabbat (152:) mashal lemelech shechillek bigde malchut, ucheneged chelek hattora amar vechen taase lechol avedat achicha, ukeraah hakkatuv aveda kemo sheramaz rashbi (kiddushin 2:) mashal lemi shenneevda lo aveda mi mechazzer al mi vechulei, ki chelek haole leish ze hinne hu avud mehaolam, kevan sheen zulato yachol lehassigo kaamur bedivre hammekubbalim, uveemtzaut hashavato bitshuva hinne hu motze otah.

Veamar od lo tire chamor achicha vegomer. nitkavven baze shello yomar hatztzaddik shello nitztavva ella al ish shenniddach baaverot aval yeshno behashev, aval im nafal vehirba lehareshia – halannoflim tekuma veavda tikva mimmennu, lo chen hu, ella lo tirehu vetitallem vetzarich lehakim immo. dikdek lomar immo davka im hu mesayyea baddavar sherotze lashuv, aval im hu nofel veeno chafetz bahakamatcha patur atta, shezze nichnas begeder letz, uchetiv (Mishlei 9:8) "al tochach letz pen yisnaekka".

rashi: Vedavid hu hakkatan. shehaya bevet shaul mikkodem lachen lenaggen lefanav:
targum: Vedavid hu zeera utelata ravrevaya azalu batar shaul:

rashi: Veshiryon kaskassim. kemin kaskassot dagim asuyin mibbarzel, noflim al gav hashshiryon [sefarim acherim nikve hashshiryon], kaskeset lechol nekev:
targum: Vekulas dinchash al resheh veshiryan galbin hu lavesh umatkal shiryona chamsha alfin tikle nechasha:

rashi: Al devar. al haetza sheyyaatzu etchem lehachatiachem:
Badderech. kesheheyitem beteruf (sifre):
Beshetzef ketzef. menachem patar: 'chori af, vedonash amar: 'bimat ketzef, kemo berega katon azavtich, vechen tirgem yonatan:
Uvechesed olam. sheyyitkayyem ad olam:
targum: Birgaz zeer salkit afe shechinti zeman zeera minich uvetavvat alam dela fesakan arachem alach amar parkich Adonai:

ohc: Veamro vechi techdal lindor lo yihye vecha chet, yitbaer gam ken al derech amram zichronam livracha (gittin 7.) im roe adam shennechasav metzumtzamim yaase mehem tzedaka. veod amru (ketuvot 66:) melach mamon chasar. vehinne lefi shechaviv al haadam mamono en noach lehotzio, velaze tavo hassevara laadam lehitchakkem lindor neder laAdonai shebbaze yihye lo noach haratzon latet minnechasav, laze ba devar melech vehodio hayyotze mechashash bittul hanneder, vehayyotze mechashash meniat netinat tzedaka kefi hammitchayyev.

Veamar keneged ichur hanneder shezze yesovev sheyyihye hachesron bo, ucheneged meniat netinat tzedaka amar "vechi techdal lindor", hagam sheatta ba lide meniat netinat hatztzedaka ze yesovev chesron bammamon, aval becha bevadday shello yihye chet, vehu amro "lo yihye vecha chet":

rashi: Ki tetze vegomer … venishmarta. shehassatan mekatreg bishat hassakkana (talmud yerushalmi shabbat 2):
ohc: Ki tetze machane vegomer. perush, hagam sheyyesh dikduke averot she lo yaanish alehem, veim yaanish yihye onesh kal, modia hakkatuv shebbishat hassakkana, shehu bizman sheyyotzim al oyvehem, tzerichin shemira mikkol dikduke averot, keamro mikkol davar ra vegomer. vechalal betevat davar gam sibbot shemmimmennu yesubbav hara. veheir bema shetzivva samuch laze "ki yihye vecha ish asher lo yihye tahor" vegomer, veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (ketuvot 46.) shehirhure avera bayyom meviin lide keri ballayla, venitkavven hakkatuv bismichut ze lomar sheal kayyotze baze yetzav bemaamar "venishmarta mikkol" vegomer.

rashi: Hashekem vehaarev. amru rabbotenu (sota 42 2): kede levattelam mikkeriat shema:
targum: Vekarev pelishtaa umakdim umachashich veitattad arbein yomin:

rashi: Timche et zecher amalek. meish ad ishsha meolel vead yonek mishshor vead se (Shmuel 1 15), shello yehe shem amalek nizkar afillu al habbehema, lomar behema zo mishshel amalek hayta (250 222):
Umetu gam shenehem. lehotzi maase chiddudim sheen haishsha nehenet mehem (sifre; sanhedrin 66):
Gam. lerabbot habbaim acharehem (sifre); davar acher, gam shenehem lerabbot et havvalad, sheim hayta meubberet en mamtinin lah ad shetteled (arachin 7):
ohc: Veamro od ki yimmatze ish shochev vegomer, yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 59.) sheamru: goy haosek battora chayyav mita, ad kan. vehu amro ki yimmatze ish shochev im ishsha shehi meoreset levalah, shehi hattora kallat yisrael, umetu gam shenehem perush: haggoy haosek vegam hattora hahi lo yihye lah aliyya ella tidach nerah veen lah chayyut kederech imre tora dichtiv (Mishlei 4:22) "ki chayyim hem".

rashi: Lo tasgir eved. ketargumo; davar acher — afillu eved kenaani shel yisrael shebbarach michutza laaretz leeretz yisrael (gittin 45):
Shaatnez. leshon eruv. verabbotenu pershu — shua tavuy venuz (sifre):
Mikkere layla. dibber hakkatuv bahove (sifre):
Veyatza el michutz lammachane. zo mitzvat ase:
Lo yavo el toch hammachane. zo mitzvat lo taase (sham), veasur likkanes lemachane leviyya, vechol shekken lemachane shechina (80 fesachim 68):

Kevo hashshemesh. im kesut layla hu, veim kesut yom — hachazirehu vabboker, uchevar katuv bivelle hammishpatim (22) "ad bo hashshemesh teshivennu lo" — kol hayyom teshivennu lo, uchevo hashshemesh tikkachennu:
Uverchekka. veim eno mevarechcha, mikkol makom ulecha tihye tzedaka (sifre):
Kilayim. chitta useora vechartzan bemappolet yad (berachot 22):
Pen tikdash. ketargumo "tistaav", kol davar hannitav al haadam, ben leshevach kegon hekdesh, ben lignay kegon issur, nofel bo leshon kiddush, kemo "al tiggash bi ki kiddashticha" (Yeshayahu 65):
(Hamelea. ze milluy vetosefet shehazzera mosif):
Tifrotzi. tigberu:
targum: Are ledaroma uletzippuna titkefin uvenach ammin yertun vekirvin detzadyan yetvun:

rashi: Vehippilo hashshofet. melammed sheen malkin oto lo omed velo yoshev ella mutte (makkot 22):
Lefanav kede rishato. uleacharav kede shetayim, mikkan amru malkin oto shete yadot milleacharav ushelish millefanav (sifre; makkot 22):
Bemispar. veeno nakud bammispar, limmed shehi devuka, lomar bemispar arbaim velo arbaim shelemim, ella minyan shehu sochem umashlim learbaim vehem arbaim chaser achat (sham):
ohc: Im bin hakkot vegomer. amar bin bechirik, remez shetztzarich lehitbonen bo ladaat im yachol lisbol haarbaim, aval im amaduhu lefachot mikken eno loke ella lefi ma sheamaduhu (makkot 22:).

rashi: Vattechasserehu meat meelohim vegomer. meelohim leshon malachim, shennatatta koach bihoshua lehademim hachamma uleyabbesh et hayyarden, bemoshe likroa me yam suf velaalot lammarom, uveeliyyahu lehachayot et hammet:
targum: Vechisarta yateh kalil mimalachaya veaykara veshivhora techlelineh:

rashi: Venikra shemo vegomer. mitzva al kol haomdim sham lomar "chalutz hannaal" (sifre; yevamot 106):
Veim emet haya haddavar. beedim vehateraa, shezzinneta leachar erusin (ketuvot 44):
Ki heharim yamushu. af im tichle zechut avot veimmahot, chasdi meittech lo yamush (yerushalmi sanhedrin 10 1):
targum: Are turaya yedun veramata yitparkun vetuvi minich yerushelem la yede ukeyam shelami la yitrechak amar deatid lerachama alach Adonai:

rashi: Haggittit. keli zemer shebba miggat, sham metzuyim ummanim laasotam. verabbotenu amru (Bereshit Rabba 16,4): al edom sheatida liddarech kegat, kemo shenneemar "pura darachti levaddi" (yeshaya 63:3); ach inyan hammizmor eno mochiach:
targum: Leshabbacha al kinora deayte migat tushebachta ledavid:

rashi: Vechol yisrael yishmeu veyirau. mikkan shetztzarich hacheraza bevet din; "peloni niskal al shehaya ven sorer umore":
Uva eleha useneah. sofo,
ohc: Ki yikkach ish ishsha vegomer. dibbera tora keneged bene adam gam bene ish asher chozrim penehem min hattora, keamram ki hayyom katzar lema shetztzarich lehishtaddel al hammichya. vaalehem amar hakkatuv ki yikkach ish ishsha – zot hattora hammeorasa, uva eleha – shekkevar zarcha alehem orah shel tora behar sinay vekibbelu halluchot, useneah – perush sheen libbam chafetz latet lah onatah bammishpat. ucheshebba mochiach ledabber elav lamma timas eshet neurim, meshiv ki en hattora zana umefarneset vehu tzarich lemichya, gam eno roe siman beracha meemtzaut limmudah, hagam ki yaasok bah en niftachin lo shaare parnasa tova. veadrabba, roe ki chol haanashim sherichakuha veenam choshvim bah kol ikkar – battehem meleim kol tuv. vehu amro vesam lah alilot devarim vehotzi aleha shem ra beamro et haishsha hazzot lakachti – perush sheeno kofer belikkucheha, ella sheomer "vaekrav eleha velo matzati lah betulim" – perush leshon chozek, ki oskeha saviv yachanu lidpok al dalte acherim limtzo teref.

Modia hakkatuv ki hakkadosh baruch hu, shehu hannikra avi hannaara, ucheneset yisrael yitbeu elbonah shel tora lifne bet din haggadol, vehu amro velakach avi hannaara veimmah vehotziu et betule hannaara remez chozek vaaliyya vehassagot ramot yussegu beemtzautah veyitbeu elbonah bevet din, keamro hashshara, vehu ma sheamru bazzohar (chelek 3 80) ki atid hakkadosh baruch hu litboa elbonah shel tora, ucheamram bammishna (avot 6:2) oy lahem labberiyyot meelbonah shel tora:

Vehinne taanat haomed litboa elbonah ketuva lefanenu, keamro veamar avi hannaara el hazzekenim et bitti natatti laish hazze leishsha, perush, lo netattiha leaggenah bekeren zaviyyot ella lehitnaheg immah beminhag ishsha, leval yigra sheerah kesutah veonatah, kemo shemmeforashim sheloshet haddevarim besefer hazzohar (Tikkunim 6) shekkullam tzerichin lattora. vayyisnaeha – kan ramaz sibbat haharchaka mimmenna shebbaa meotah bechina hannikret sina, venoten taam haharchaka mippene shello matza bah tokef vechozek. vehu amro vehinne hu sam alilot vegomer, dikdek lomar "vehinne hu" lehair ki en ze emet, shello garam lo ella hassone hashshochen bekirbo. veelle betule vitti vegomer, vehayu haddevarim berurim kassimla kamma maalot vechozek hattora, shettechillat kol davar kol haolam kullo bah nivra, bishvilah nivra, uvah mitkayyem, vechol tova hatztzefuna laolam habba veotzrot hachayyim vehattov niknet bah.

Veamar hakkatuv ki ze yihye mishpat haish hahu al pi bet din, rishona "veyisseru oto", al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot 5.): im roe adam sheyyissurin baim alav vechulei yitle bevittul tora, perush al ma shebbittel hattora. venidchaku haacharonim beferush davar ze betaanat halo bittul avon gadol hu, velamma lo tala bo ad shello matza, veyishshuv haddavar hu lefi sheen shiur lema shetztzarich beesek hattora, keamram (avot 2,16): veen atta ven chorin lehibbatel mimmenna, vahagam sheyyerae beene adam sheasak, kesheyyire yissurin baim alav been avon yeda ki kemo sherauy lo laasot lo asa veal ze anashuhu.

Veamro veanshu oto mea kesef, remez lemea berachot shechayyav levarech bechol yom, kemo sheddarshu (menachot mag:) meamro "veatta yisrael ma Adonai elohecha shoel" – al tikre "ma" ella "mea", ufasuk ze bevaal teshuva neemar, keamram baggemara (Bereshit Rabba 21) "veatta" – en "veatta" ella teshuva, dichtiv "veatta yisrael ma Adonai elohecha shoel" vegomer, ad kan, shechayyav lehishtaddel lehashelimam.

Veamro venatnu laavi hannaara, shekkullan hem berachot laAdonai shehu avi hannaara. veamro ki hotzi shem ra al betulat yisrael shehi hashshechina shehi kelalut yisrael vehi midda haasirit shekkolelet mea, vehi nikret tora shebbeal pe kayyadua leyode chen.

Veamro velo tihye vegomer, perush, hagam sheen chiyyuv betalmud tora ella keviut ittim, adam kaze shehotzi shem ra aleha tzarich lishkod al daltoteha kol hayyom vechol hallayla, "lo yuchal leshallechah kol yamav". vechaze matzinu lahem lerabbotenu zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 25:1) sheamru shebbaal teshuva im haya ragil lilmod daf echad yilmod shenayim, vechen al ze hadderech. veze baal teshuva mishshear haaverot, aval motzi shem ra al hattora – mishpato kol yamav immah yeshev, torato ummanuto.

Veamro "veim emet haya haddavar" vegomer, perush: im era ki tora shellamad ze haish uvachan bah sheen lah betulim, shehayta torat minut shellimmedu tzadok uvaytos, vetora kazo en bah chozek vehi chelek ra, letora kazo yetzav Adonai lirmot bah even lesaklah uleabbedah, keamro "vameta". hagam ki hen henna haddevarim sheyyatzu mippi hakkadosh baruch hu, af al pi chen hakkavvana lo kach hi. uchevar amru zichronam livracha (gittin ma:) al sefer tora shekketavo min yissaref. "ki asta nevala liznot" vegomer "uviarta hara", ki zo tikkare chelek ra vetzarich biur.

Kol ose elle kol ose avel. perush "kol ose elle" – even vaeven, efa veefa, "kol ose avel" haddome leelle, shello tomar sheggezerat hakkatuv hu al shene devarim ellu velo al domehem, talmud lomar "kol" vegomer:

rashi: Eshet. afillu eshet ish:

Velakachta lecha leishsha. lo dibbera tora ella keneged yetzer hara, sheim en hakkabba mattirah yissaenna veissur, aval im nesaah sofo lihyot sonah, shenneemar acharav "ki tihyena leish vegomer", vesofo leholid mimmenna ben sorer umore, lechach nismechu parashiyyot hallalu (tanchuma):
ohc: Veraita bashshivya eshet yefat toar. hinne meamro yefat toar mashma davka yefat toar, umeamro vechashakta vah darshu besifre afillu keura, veze min hattema lamma yomar yefat toar veyitztarech lerabbot keura? haya lo lomar "veraita eshet" velo yichtov lo "yefat toar" velo "vechashakta".

Uleyashshev hakkatuv tzarich lehair bainyan, lamma yetzav Adonai kaddevarim haelle letamme adam atzmo bevat el nechar, uvifrat beet maase hannes bemakom shetztzarich lehosif tahara udevekut baAdonai, yattir laasot maase kiur hassanouy etzlo yitbarach, veze yafil harechakat devekutenu bo yitbarach. bishlama hetter achilat issur matzinu larambam zichrono livracha (hilchot Melachim perek 8) shennatan taam im yirav, vehu taam nachon, aval maase ze yetaavennu osenu. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (kiddushin ka:) lo dibbera tora ella keneged yetzer hara, umin harauy hu lehachenio uleabbedo millev am kadosh bazzeman hahu asher malkam berosham lehillachem lahem.

Achen yesod haddavar vesodo hu al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (zohar chodesh balak 53) sheamru shebbechet adam harishon nishbu kamma neshamot yekarot beyad sitra ochora, vehem nishmot haggerim, vetze ulemad kamma vechamma gedole olam baim mehaummot, verut hammoaviyya tochiach, vechamma gedole olam shemaya veavtalyon veuneklos hagger vechaelle rabbot:

Od agalle lecha sod echad: timtza neshama tehora devuka binshama temea, veen koach battehora lehattot hattemea lehetiv, vehi munnachat sham ad et deror. vetze ulemad kayyotze baze minnishmat rabbi chanina ben teradyon shehayta devuka bishchem ben chamor, karamuz betevat "rachavat yadayim" (Bereshit 34,21) kaamur bedivre hammekubbalim (Likkutei tora vayyishlach). umatzinu shehannefesh hallazo lo asta mifal tov bishchem, veyatzta kesheddavak bedina, matza hannefesh minah venidbeka bo, keamro (Bereshit 34,3) "vattidbak nafsho bedina". ushemor lecha kelal ze. veyesh nefesh kedosha ben hakkelippa shebbimkom shechunatah tatte lev hashshochenet betocho lehetiv, vigarshu chelek hara o yemattekuhu. vehem haggerim hammitgayyerim min haummot meatzman kerut hammoaviyya uchenaama, uchemo sherainu beenenu gerim shemmeatzmam baim umitgayyerim.

Vehinne kevar katavti kamma peamim ki beemtzaut maase hammitzva yitlabbesh baadam or hashshechina vigaresh mimmennu chelek hara, keamro (Kohelet 8:5) "shomer mitzva lo yeda davar ra", uvifrat sheluche mitzva. veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat shelach lecha sheshsheluche mitzva bishat shelichutam afillu miyyetzer hara mitzvatam matztzilatam, uchemo chen haosek baavera mitlabbeshet bo ruach hattuma umeavvetet darko.

Veachare hodia Adonai otanu et kol zot, yairu maamre el elyon kashshemesh batztzohorayim bemitzva zo, vehu lefi shehikdim ki tetze lammilchama vegomer, sheyyetziato hi lidvar mitzva kemo shepperashnu lemala. amar od, im raa bashshivya, perush bishat shivya, uchemo shekken dikdek rambam beferek 8 mehilchot melachim ki beotah shaa odennu osek bammitzva. im yire eshet yefat toar, perush eshet samuch, verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (kiddushin ka:) eshet ish, vedivrehem emet, ella sheim ledivrehem levad yechavven haya lo lomar eshet ish lo eshet yefat toar. ella baa lehair shebbeemtzaut heyoto osek bammitzva yegalle Adonai et enav lehakkir baggoya sheyyesh bah yefat toar shehi neshama hakkedosha hannikret yefat toar, ki zohar neshamot hakkedoshot mufla veatzum hu, vezot haishsha kanta bah chelek ze hattov, velaze keraah hakkatuv "eshet yefat toar". vehakkaratah hu al yede sheatta roe sheatta choshek bah bizman sheatta davuk bashshechina beemtzaut heyotcha asuk bishlichut mitzva kaamur, ze yeircha shelledavar tov chashakta.

Vedikdek lomar vah velo amar otah, lehair ki lo laishsha atta choshek ella lema shebbah, shehi yefat toar, shehu chelek hattov haddome lannefesh hattehora. uchefi ze, hagam shekkeura haishsha bichlal hahetter, ki eno chozer yefat toar laggolem hannigle, ki elav lo yimmashech taavat yisrael bematztzav ze kemo sheamarnu.

Veamar velakachta lecha leishsha, hinne bechol maamar hammitkanne lah amar hakkatuv bilshon kinnuy "vahavetah" vegomer, "uvealtah" vegomer, "veshillachtah", vechan amar velakachta, shinna hakkatuv lahaircha shehallekicha hi bannelam shehi nefesh hakkedosha, shebbeemtzaut hainyan yihye lo bah lekicha acheret sheyyizke bifat toar, ki kesheyyidbak ish yisrael beishsha shebbah chelek mehattov, techef yikne mekomo chelek hattov beyisrael veyizke bo, kemo shezzachta dina bat yaakov benefesh kedosha bifgoa bah shechem ben chamor.

Vehinne lefi sheyyesh shete bechinot bidvekut hakkedushsha bakkelippa kemo shezzacharnu lemala, vezot haishsha en yadua im chelek haddavuk bah hu davar hayyotze bidvika rishona kannizkar venishara haishsha chaluta bechelek hara venitrokna mechelek hattov, o efshar shekkullah nechletet bechelek hattov kerut uchenaama. laze yetzav Adonai vahavetah el toch betecha vegomer veyarchik mimmennu chelek devekut bechinat hara, veaz tibbadek haishsha achar sheloshim yom im nitgayyera ishto zo vahare hi kerut uchenaama, vehu amro vehayta lecha leishsha im yachpotz, veim lo yachpotz vegomer ze lecha haot ki chelek hattov shehaya bah yatza al yede maase harishon venechlak hara.

Uletzad sheyyesh makom sheyyitavve haadam leishsha nachriyya bederech zenut, ki lo amarnu shello yitavve lenachrit ella im yesh bah nefesh kedosha davka bizman shehu bidvar mitzva kemo shekkatavnu, ma sheen ken achare chen, laze tzivva Adonai vegillecha et roshah veasta et tzipparneha vegomer vechol haddevarim hamenavvelim et haishsha lehasir taava hattivit, veim nitgayyera vechafetz bah ze lecha haot ki nitmatteka venechlat mimmenna chelek hara velaze vehayta lo leishsha, veim lo yachpotz bah, dikdek lomar bah lehair ki hachefetz hu bema shebbah shehu chelek hattov.

Veraita bashshivya eshet yefat toar. dikdek lomar lenafshah, latet taam lamma yeshallechenna velo yimkerenna veyehane middameha, kevan shehi mikkelal hashshivya shennatan lo Adonai. veamar hattaam hu "lenafshah", perush bishvil nafshah shehi yefat toar sheramaz battechilla achar shennehena mimmenna. o al ze hadderech lenafshah, perush hattemea shel haggoya, lishlol ki nefesh yefat toar hattehora kevar zachita bah velo nishar bah ella nefesh haggoya.

Veamro umachor lo timkerenna, ki Adonai chafetz shello yinhagu yisrael im bechinat hara bederech ze, al derech amro (tehillim 69:27) "asher hikkita radafu", sheruach hakkodesh mitraemet al haummot sheachar sheroim yisrael mukkim rodfim otam, vezo kayyotze bah sheachar shehotzi balah mippiha lo yehane od mikkaspah.

Vegamar omer tachat asher innitah, perush asher hotzeta mimmenna ashrah vetuvah shehi yefat toar, veasita otah aniyya, asita otah meunna, asita otah achura. veze yaid od al devarenu, ki hayittachen baolam sheyyisrael habba al ishsha haggoya hu meanne otah, vahalo amru zichronam livracha (avoda zara 22:) chaviva alehem behemtan shel yisrael yoter minneshotehen uneshotehen yoter mehem, uma innuy hu ze laggoya? ella hakkavvana hu innuy hannelam shehu shalal kodesh mimmenna.

Uvederech remez titbaer happarasha al ze hadderech: hinne kol binyan haolam vekiyyumo taluy bemaase am bene yisrael, im yetivu darchehem – haolam kayyam veyismechu hashshamayim vetagel haaretz, gam Adonai elohenu yismach veyagel banu. veyosher darkam shel yisrael taluy benitzchon yetzer hara. uva hakkatuv lehair haadam ki bitziato meolam haelyon lavo laolam hazze yihye muchan lammilchama, ki lo yachshov sheen tzarich tigboret lenitztzachon ze, ella adrabba lazo yikkare milchama, al derech amram (avot 4:1) ezehu gibbor hakkovesh et yitzro, sheen gevura gedola mizzo. velaze amar lammilchama befattach tachat hallamed.

Veraita bashshivya eshet yefat toar, ba lehair ki lo milchama zo kegibbor hallochem lilkod ir, uchesheyyakutz bammilchama yifne veyelech leatzmo, ella keadam hallochem im oyvo sheim yitrashshel yakum alav vehikkahu. kemo chen im yitrashshel haadam millilchom et haoyev yakum alav viabbedehu min haolam, umavticho hakkatuv shehagam shettakkif hu hayyetzer mikkoach haenoshi, af al pi chen yittenehu Adonai beyado. veomer veshavita shivyo, dikdek lomar "shivyo" velo "oto", sheen bo mammash beatzmo vehedero hu hammekuvve, ella "shivyo" – perush ma sheshshava hu mibbechinat hattov mimmecha umikkayyotze becha befittuyo uvenitzchono, shekkamma neshamot meam bene yisrael shevuyot beyado.

Veamro veraita bashshivya eshet yefat toar, amar "eshet" samuch, perush nishmat adam, ki en hasm sholet bannefesh ad shettered matta vetikkanes baadam mimmennu hu lokchah bashshevi, vehannefesh tikkare ishsha, vekara lazo yefat toar ki hannefesh yafa ad meod ella shemmitnavvelet bemaaseha haraim, uchesheyyenutztzach hayyetzer az yaskil haadam benafsho ma yafa uma neima hi.
Veraita bashshivya eshet yefat toar vechashakta vah – perush, az hacheshek shehaya lo bedivre hayyetzer uvefittuyo, yalbishem bah letakken lah hammuskalot veolam hakkayyam shekkullo tov.

Veamro vahavetah el toch betecha, lefi sheal yede pittuy hara mitracheket hannefesh mehagguf veshochen chelek ra bimkomah, kederech amro (Iyov 18:4) "toref nafsho beappo", vehagguf yikkare bayit al derech amram (taanit 11.) mi meid baadam – korot beto, shehu hagguf. ucheshennotzeach yitzro yavi nafsho letoch beto veyikkare baal nefesh. veleheyot shehannefesh shekkana mimmakom tame tzarich lenakkotah mittachalue hara hannidbak bah shehu bechinat sear harosh, vehu amro vegillecha et roshah, gam bechinat hakkelippa harmuza batztzipparnayim amar kenegdah veasta et tzipparneha leshon tikkun, vetasir masve hattuma hammitkassa bah hannefesh meruach hattuma, vehu amro vehesira et simlat shivyah mealeha, perush shekkanta mishshevita bemakom tame, veze yihye al yede meruk hachataim vedarche hatteshuva vahachanat haddaat mul elohe yisrael baruch hu, veyivchar mekom moshav lah bayit meyuchad leyisrael shehu bet hammidrash, vehu amro veyashva bevetecha, vetitvadde bivchi al asher maala beaviha veimmah veal peredatah mehem, aviha ze hakkadosh baruch hu, immah hi keneset yisrael (berachot la.), yerach yamim ze shiur hammaspik leshav, o yirmoz lechodesh hammeyuchad litshuva shehu chodesh elul.

Veachar ken tavo eleha. perush, atta tikkanes lehanot meorah besod amro "nefesh amel amla lo" (Mishlei 16:26), utesayyeehu laamod bederech hannaot, vetikkare atta bealeha shekkanita otah bechoach maasecha, vehu amro uvealtah. gam leyom hattechiyya tihye meyuchedet lecha lachazor legufecha vetaamod bah, vehu amro vehayta lecha leishsha.

Vechazar hakkatuv letzauot al hannefesh, sheim haish lo nata libbo lekauot lehetiv lenafsho ulehitatztzem lehair lah baolam haelyon, al kol panim yizzaher shello yarea lah, kederech sheamar shelomo (Kohelet 12:7) "veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah", vedarshu bemassechet shabbat (152:) tenah lo kemo shennetanah lecha, vehu amro im lo chafatzta bah veshillachtah lenafshah, perush shello timserenna beyad shabbay ella bat chorin veen aleha yad moshel.

O yirtze al derech ma sheamru bazzohar (11 67.) befasuk "nafshi ivviticha ballayla" (Yeshayahu 26:9) sheal hashshechina hu omer "nafshi", vehu ma sheramaz beamro veshillachtah lenafshah shehu hashshechina shettachzor lemakom sheyyatzta mimmennu. veamro umachor lo timkerenna vegomer al derech ma sheddarshu besefer hazzohar (10 97.) befasuk "leam nachri lo yimshol lemachrah" (Shemot 21:8). veamro bakkasef lefi sheyyomar adam ech yimshol adam benafsho lemachrah, laze amar "bakkasef", leshon kosef, ki beemtzaut taavat vechosef livvot bene adam yimkeru et nafsham beyad oyev. veramaznu mizze befasuk "et kaspecha lo titten lo beneshech" vegomer (Vayikra 25:37). veamro lo titammer kemo shettirgem uneklus "la tittagar", perush lo tegare bah mechabbelim hammitgarim bannefesh hachotet, tachat asher innitah ki hachet yikkare beerech hannefesh innuy.

rashi: Fetzua dakeh. shenniftzeu o shennidkeu vetzim shello:
Ucherut shofcha. shennichrat haggid veshuv eno yore killuach zera ella shofech veshotet veeno molid (sifre; yevamot 70):
Lo yihye lecha. im asita ken, lo yihye lecha kelum (80 sham):
Lemaan yitav lach vegomer. im mitzva kalla sheen bah chesron kis amra tora "lemaan yitav lach vehaarachta yamim", kal vachomer lemattan secharan shel mitzvot chamurot (sham 142):
Pi shenayim. keneged shene achim:
Bechol asher yimmatze lo. mikkan sheen habbechor notel pi shenayim barauy lavo leachar mitat haav kevammuchzak (sifre; bechorot nusach acher):
Hammagala. sevivot hammachane osim magal, vehayyotze chutz, lefanim o leachor, mitchayyev. lefanim, shemma yarutzu alav bene maarchot haoyvim, leachor, mevakkesh hu lanus:
targum: Veakdem david betzafra ushevak yat ana al natra unesiv vaazal kema depakdeh yishay veata lecharkuma umashiryat avde kerava nefaku lesidra veyabbivu bikrava:

rashi: Sorer. sar min hadderech:
Umore. mesarev vedivre aviv, leshon mamrim (Devarim 9):

Veyisseru oto. matrin bo bifne shelosha umalkin oto (sifre; sanhedrin amud alef); ben sorer umore eno chayyav ad sheyyignov veyochal tartemar basar veyishte chatzi log yayin, shenneemar "zolel vesove", veneemar (Mishlei 23) "al tehi besove yayin bezolle vasar lamo"; uven sorer umore neherag al shem sofo, higgia tora lesof dato, sof shemmechalle mamon aviv umevakkesh limmudo veeno motze, veomed befarashat derachim umelastem et habberiyyot, amra tora yamut zakkay veal yamut chayyav (sifre; sanhedrin amud alef):
ohc: Ki yihye leish vegomer enennu shomea. tzarich ladaat amro enennu shehaya lo lomar "eno shomea", veulay shebba lehair ki kesheadam mamlich betocho yetzer hara nishlelet mimmennu hayyedia vehashshemia mehanneemar elav, ki hayyetzer omed al miftach hallev umonea haddevarim mehaggia el hannefesh ki hem yechayyevuhu latzet mishsham. vehimshalti haddavar lemelech shehayu shoarav gannavim velistim, vehabbaim likbol lifne hammelech mehem hayittachen shehashshoarim hahem yotziu lahem reshut likkanes lechayyevam lammelech, kemo chen haddavar hazze. vehu amro ki yihye leish vegomer enennu shomea vegomer, perush, mushelal hu beerech hashshemia, ki lo yaggiuhu haddevarim mitztzad hammonea hayyoshev al mifteche hallev keamram zichronam livracha (berachot 61.).

Bekol aviv uvekol immo. taam shehutzrach lehazekir aviv velo hispik lomar bekolo vechozer leaviv sheamar besamuch, heir hakkatuv ki ben sorer umore leyoldav yesovvehu ken heyoto mored beaviv veimmo, shehem hakkadosh baruch hu ucheneset yisrael (Zohar 10 85.), al derech amro (Mishlei 1:8) "shema beni musar avicha veal tittosh torat immecha", ki lefi sheyyoldav choschim shivtam mibbenehem umannichim otam laasot hattov vehayyashar beenehem, ze yesovev sheggam bahem yimrod. veze shiur hakkatuv ki yihye leish vegomer, da sheenennu shomea bekol hakkadosh baruch hu ucheneset yisrael, velaze hagam sheyyisseruhu lo yishma alehem, perush millevad shello yekabbel lachzor meaverot shebbeno uven hammakom od lo shello yishma alehem.

rashi: Vattaaroch yisrael. maarechet yisrael:
targum: Vesadaru yisrael ufelishtae sidra likodamut sidra:

rashi: Lo yumatu avot al banim. beedut banim, veim tomar baavon banim, kevar neemar ish becheto yumatu (sifre; sanhedrin 27):
Ish becheto yumatu. aval mi sheeno ish met baavon aviv, vehakketannim metim baavon avotam bide shamayim (sifre):
Ki tavo bekamat reecha. af zo befoel hakkatuv medabber:
Veasta et tzipporneha. tegaddelem kede shettitnavvel (sifre; yevamot 48):

Yissadta oz mippi ollim veyonkim. hishreta shechinatcha bammikdash, vetikkanta lehodot lecha oz mippi haleviyyim vehakkohanim, shehem bene adam gedelim belichluch, keollim veyonke shadayim. ollim leshon "veolalti veafar karni" (Iyov 16:15), veal shem hallichluch nikreu kol tinokot ollim:
Lemaan tzorrecha. lehodiam ki ammecha anachnu:
Lehashebit. cherpat oyev umitnakkem, haomer: lo tovim attem mehaummot. vaani, kesheani roe shamecha vegomer, ani tameah belibbi: ma enosh ki tizkerennu:
targum: Mippum ulemaya veyonkaya ishtesta oshana min biglal meikayich levatala beel devava vegazoma:

rashi: Charitze hechalav. (targum:) "guvenin dechalba":

Lesar haalef. ani omer: lesar shel oto elef sheechav (sefarim acherim sheani) mimmennu, shellechol hashshevatim hayu sare alafim lefi alfehem, vaani shamati: lesar haalef ze yehonatan, sheamar alav (Shmuel 1 13:2): veelef hayu im yonatan begivat binyamin:
Veet arubbatam tikkach. veet aruvat hatztzalatam ushelomam, tikkach beaznecha uvilvavcha, vetagged li vechen tirgem yonatan: "veyat tivehon tayti":
Arubbatam. leshon hatztzala, kemo "arov avdecha letov" (tehillim 119:122), 572 109 verabbotenu amru (shabbat 56 1): get keritut yikkach meittam veyavi linshotehem, lehaferid eruv shebbeno levenah:
targum: Veyat asar guvenin dachalava hailen tovel lerav alfa veyat achaych tasar lishlam veyat tivehon tayte:

rashi: Achare asher huttammaa. lerabbot sota shennistera (sifre; yevamot 11):
Shomer hakkelim. shel bene hatztzava:
targum: Ushevak david yat manaya di alohi al yad natir manaya urehat lesidra veata veshael laachohi bishlam:

rashi: Vesam lah alilot devarim – avera goreret avera, avar al lo tisna, sofo lavo lide lashon hara (80 sifre):
Et haishsha hazzot. mikkan sheen omer davar ella bifne vaal din (shem):
Etnan zona. natan lah tale beetnannah pasul lehakerava:
Umechir kelev. hechelif se vechelev (sifre; temura 29):
Gam shenehem. lerabbot shinnuyehem, kegon chittim vaasaan solet (sham 30):

Lo taashok sachir. vahalo chevar katuv? ella laavor al haevyon bishne lavyn, "lo taashok sechar sachir" shehu ani veevyon, veal heashir kevar huzhar (Vayikra 19) "lo taashok et reacha" (42 sefer acher):
Evyon. hattaev lechol davar:
Miggercha. ze ger tzedek:
Bisharecha. ze ger toshav haochel nevelot:
Asher beartzecha. lerabbot sechar behema vechelim (bava metzia 111):
Lo yosif. mikkan azhara lammakke et chavero (80 ketuvot 33):
Venikla achicha. kol hayyom koro rasha, umishshellaka kerao achicha:
Ki tavo becherem reecha. befoel hakkatuv medabber:
Kenafshecha. kamma shettirtze:
Sovecha. velo achila gassa (bava metzia 87):
Veel kelyecha lo titten. mikkan shello dibbera tora ella bishat habbatzir, bizman sheatta noten lechelyo shel baal habbayit (sifre; bava metzia 89), aval im ba laador ulekashkesh eno ochel (sham 87):
ohc: Veel kelyecha lo titten. amro veel kelyecha betosefet vav lehair, shekkadma mitzva acheret vehu shello yochal achila gassa, vehu ma sheddiyyek beamro savecha vedarshu zichronam livracha (bava metzia paz:) lo achila gassa, vehosif od lomar "veel kelyecha lo titten".

rashi: Ki me noach zot li. shevua beyadi, veholech umefaresh devaro: kaasher nishbati meavor me noach vegomer:
targum: Keyome noach da kodamay dekaymet bememri dela yedun me tufana dahavo beyome noach od al ara ken kaymit bememri dela yechol rugezi alach vela ezof bich:

rashi: Vehaya im lo chafatzta bah. hakkatuv mevassercha shessofcha lisnotah (sham):
Lo titammer bah. lo tishtammesh bah, bilshon parsi korin leavdut veshimmush "imraa", misodo shel Rabbi moshe haddarshan lamadti chen:
Efrati. bet lechem yoshevet beeretz efrat:
Velo shemona vanim. uma shekkatuv (bedivre hayamim 1 2:15): "otzem hashshishshi david hashshevii" velo chatav yoter, yesh lomar sheechad met belo banim, ulefichach lo ketavo sham:
Baanashim. nimne bichnesiyyot hachashuvim:
targum: Vedavid bar gevar efrati haden mibbet lechem devet yehuda ushemeh yishay veleh temanya venin vegavra beyome shaul siv meni bivchiraya:

rashi: Veyarka befanav. al gabbe karka (sham):
Asher lo yivne. mikkan lemi shechalatz shello yachazor viyabbem, dela chetiv "asher lo vana", ella "asher lo yivne", kevan shello vana — shuv lo yivne (yevamot 10; 80 sifre):
ohc: Veanta vegomer. amar leshon aniyya, perush, teshuva ledivre hayyavam sheamar "lo chafatzti lekachtah", taane hi vetomar "kacha yease laish" vegomer:

rashi: Vechi yihye veish chet mishpat mavet. semichut happarashiyyot maggid sheim chasim alav aviv veimmo, sof sheyyetze letarbut raa veyaavor averot veyitchayyev mita bevet din (80 tanchuma):
Vetalita oto al etz. rabbotenu amru, kol hanniskalin nitlin, shenneemar "ki killat elohim taluy", vehamevarech Adonai biskila (sanhedrin 45):
ohc: Vechi yihye veish chet vegomer. samach parasha zo leshellefaneha, lefi shehaya mesalsel seder tikkun haadam. battechilla heiro al atzmo kemo shepperashti beremez parashat ki tetze, achar kach heir haav al habben kemo sheramaznu befasuk "ki yihye ben sorer" vegomer, vechan heir al chachme haddor lifkoach ayin al ose avel, vehu amro ki yihye veish chet mishpat mavet venishar omed bemirdo velo chazar bitshuva ad shemmet becheto, vehu amro vehumat, vetala Adonai chesrono al hechacham keamro vetalita oto al etz ze hechacham etz ose peri shehu yittol ansho, ki Adonai tzivvahu lehochiach velachzor ulehochiach ad hakkaa (arachin 16:), uchemo shekkatavnu befarashat kedoshim, ucheshehu helim eno meish ze ad shemmet mitchayyev bo:

Veamro lo talin vegomer. ba letzauot lehamon am shello yeharharu achar hechacham, al derech amram (451 deve eliyyahu perek 3) im raita talmid chacham sheavar avera bayyom al teharher acharav ballayla shemma asa teshuva, veheemiduha bevadday asa teshuva, vehu amro lo talin nivlato ki hachet yikkare gam ken nevela, lo teharher acharav ballayla shehu zeman lina achat al haetz shehu talmid chacham, ki kavor tikberennu leoto chet meal haetz bayyom hahu atzmo, vehattaam ki killat elohim, sheim encha ose chen atta mechallel shem shamayim ucheillu atta nogea bichvodo yitbarach:

Vegamar omer velo tetamme et admatcha, yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat kayit:) lo charva yerushalayim ella al shehayu mevazzim bah talmide chachamim, shenneemar (divrei hayamim 2 36:16) "vayyihyu malivim" vegomer, velaze tzivva Adonai shello yesovvu bevizzuy talmid chacham tumat haaretz beviat goyim benachalat Adonai vitammeuha.

rashi: Vekatztzota et kappah. mamon deme vashto, hakkol lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh; o eno ella yadah mammash? neemar kan "lo tachos", veneemar lehallan beedim zommim (Devarim 19) "lo tachos", ma lehalan mamon af kan mamon (sifre; 80 bava kamma 28):
El petach bet aviha. reu giddulim sheggiddaltem (sham 45):
Anshe irah. bemaamad kol anshe irah (sifre):
Liznot bet aviha. kemo bevet aviha:
Ranni akara. yerushalayim, asher hayta kelo yalada:
Lo chala. leshon leda hu, shehayyoledet al yede chil vachavalim yoledet:
Mibbene veula. bat edom:
targum: Shabbachi yerushelem dahavat keitta akara dela yeledat bui tushebachta vedutzi dahavat keitta dela adiat are sagiin yehon bene yerushelem tzedita mibbene cherakka yetivta amar Adonai:

rashi: Ki matza vah ervat davar. mitzva alav legarshah, shello timtza chen beenav (22 90):
Lo tishkav baavoto. lo tishkav vaavoto etzlecha (sifre; bava metzia 114):
Vehaya habbechor. gedol haachim hu meyabbem otah (sifre; yevamot 24):
Asher teled. perat leaylonit sheenah yoledet:
Yakum al shem achiv. ze sheyyibbem et ishto yittol nachalat hammet benichse aviv:
Velo yimmache shemo. perat leeshet saris sheshshemo machuy (yevamot 24):
Veyad tihye lecha. ketargumo, kemo ish al yado (Bamidbar 2):
Michutz lammachane. chutz leanan:

ohc: Velo ava vegomer. amro velo ava perush, hagam shehaya makom lishmoa mitztzad anfe hachet shehaya bilam neechaz bahem, af al pi chen nitratztza Adonai belo taam velo shama vegomer, venatan hattaam "ki ahevcha Adonai", perush, lo letzad shehayita rauy ledavar ze. veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk "velo ava sichon" (Devarim 2:30).

rashi: Ishsha chadasha. shehi chadasha lo vaafillu almana, perat lemachazir gerushato (sifre; sota 44):
Velo yaavor alav. devar hatztzava:

Lechol davar shehu tzorech hatztzava, lo lesappek mayim umazon velo letakken hadderachim, aval hachozrim meorche hammilchama al pi chohen, kegon bana vayit velo chanacho o eras ishsha velo lekachah, maspikin mayim umazon umetakkenin et hadderachim (sham):
Yihye leveto. af bishvil beto, im bana vayit vachanacho veim nata kerem vechillelo eno zaz mibbeto bishvil tzarche hammilchama:
Yihye. lerabbot et karmo:
Leveto. ze veto:
Vesimmach. yesammeach et ishto, vetargumo "veyachde yat ittete", vehametargem veyechde im ittete toe hu, sheen ze targum shel vesimmach ella shel vesamach:
Lo tuchal lehitallem. lichbosh encha keillu encha roe oto:
Shamma shibbar rishfe kashet. shel sancheriv veuchelusav (Melachim 2 19:35):

Rishfe kashet. en rishfe keshet leshon "rishpe esh" (Shir HaShirim 8:6) sheen leshon rishpe esh noflim bekeshet, veze rafe verishpe esh dagush. verishfe keshet leshon "ulechume reshef" (Devarim 32:24) dimtargeminan "of", "uvene reshef yagbihu uf" (Iyov 5:7). vechen "umiknehem larshafim" (tehillim 78:48) letzipporim, vechen uvene reshef bene afifa hem shedim yagbihu lauf. af ze leshon chitztzim hameoffim keinyan shenneemar "umechetz yauf yomam" (tehillim 91:5), shamma shibbar rishfe kashet chitztzim shehakkeshet meofef. vechol hammizmor hazze medabber bemappelet sancheriv shello matzinu oyev nofel birushalayim ella hu:
targum: Kad avadu vet yisrael reuteh ashre shechinteh benehon taman tevar girrin vekashtin deamaya megiche kerava terisa vesidre kerava batel lealmin:

ohc: Hanechilo et banav et asher vegomer. velo amar "beyom hanechilo et asher yihye lo et banav", lehasemich tevat hanechilo lemaamar et banav, lirmoz sevarat chachamim sheamru (bava batra kal.) sheyyachol haav lehanechil leven echad mibbanav yoter mimma shennogea lo kefi hachalukka.
Lo yuchal levakker vegomer. veim bikker over belav, uvaze yityashshev ma shehikshu hattosafot (bava batra kal.) sham bedibbur hammatchil talmud lomar lisvarat rabbanan.

rashi: Veelav hu nose et nafsho. el hassachar hazze hu nose et nafsho lamut, ala vakkevesh venitla veilan (sifre; 42 112):
Vehaya vecha chet. mikkol makom, ella shemmemaharin lipparea al yede hakkore (sifre):
ohc: Veelav hu nose vegomer vehaya vecha chet. hakkavvana shehagam sheoshek sechar sachir eno ella gozel mamon, af al pi chen en ansho mamon ella nefashot, vehu amro "yihye vecha", perush "becha" benafshecha, "chet", al derech (Melachim 1 1:21) "vehayiti ani uveni shelomo chattaim". vehikdim taam haonesh beamro "veelav hu nose et nafsho", umeatta yihye hammishpat nefesh tachat nefesh.

rashi: Veshachachta omer. velo gadish, mikkan amru, omer sheyyesh bo satayim ushechacho eno shichcha (pea 6 42):
Bassade. lerabbot shichchat kama sheshshachach miktzatah milliktzor:
Lo tashuv lekachto. mikkan amru, shelleacharav shichcha, shellefanav eno shichcha, sheeno beval tashuv (pea 44; bava metzia 11):
Lemaan yevarechcha. veaappi shebbat leyado shello vemitkavven, kava laose vemitkavven. emor meatta nafla sela miyyado umetzaah ani venitparnes bah — hare hu mitbarech aleha (sifre):
Avi hannaara veimmah. mi sheggiddelu giddulim haraim yitbazzu aleha (80 sham):
Lo yavo mamzer bikhal Adonai. lo yissa yisreelit:
Umitzchat nechoshet. kemin yad barzel hayyotze min hakkova keneged hachotem, shekkorin 380 109, vehayta maggaat lo ad raglav:

Vechidon nechoshet. tirgem yonatan: "umesachafa dinchasha nafek min kolsa umetal ben katfohi". perush: kemin chanit nechoshet boletet min hakkova, venimshechet ben ketefav, lehagen al tzavvaro min hacherev:
targum: Uteraklilin dinchash al riglohi umesachafa dinchasha nafik min kulesa umetal ben ketefohi:

rashi: Ma addir shimcha. yoter mikkede koach middat hattachtonim, lo hayu hattachtonim keday shettishre shechinatcha benehem:
Asher tena hodcha al hashshamayim. rauy shettittenehu al hashshamayim, veatta baanavatcha haggedola yissadta oz vegomer:
targum: Adonai elaha ribbonana kema telil shemach umeshabbach bechola ara dihavta zivach el min shemaya:

rashi: Lo tetaev adomi. legamre, veaappi sherauy lecha letaavo sheyyatza bacherev likratecha:
Lo tetaev mitzri. mikkol vachol, af al pi shezzarku zechurechem layor. ma taam? shehayu lachem achsanya bishat haddechak. lefichach —

Naor atta addir. leshon "nier mikdasho" (Eicha 2:7), "nearta verit avdecha" (tehillim 89:40) – menaer et oyvecha vekamecha umetatan min haolam. naor al shem maasav nikra, kemo "channun" (Shemot 22:26), verachum" (tehillim 111:4), vekanno" (Yehoshua 24:19) – al shem shehu chonen, shehu merachem, shehu mekanne:
Addir meharere taref. chazak meanakim torfim haggevohim keharim, ulenegdecha en gevuratam nodaat:
targum: Nehir dechil at elaha meshabbach min bet makdeshach yezuun min kodamach malchaya deyatvin bichrakke turaya atar vet kenishut bizathon:

rashi: Zachor et asher asa Adonai elohecha lemiryam. im bata lehizzaher shello tilke betzaraat al tesapper lashon hara, zechor heasuy lemiryam sheddibbera veachiha velakta vingaim (80 sifre):
Mor vaahalot ketziot. "kidda" (Shemot 30:24) metargeminan "ketziata":
Kol bigdotecha. kol begadecha merichim kereach besamim, umidrasho (yerushalmi pea 1, 1): kol begidotecha vesirchonecha mitkapperim umerichim reach arev:
Min hechle shen minni simmechucha. yoter mehechle shen meshubbachim hahechalot hammetukkanim lecha began eden lesammechacha bahem. shen ivoyyr belaaz:
Minni simmechucha. hechalot asher minni, hem simmechucha, hannotnim secharcha:
targum: Mera dachya veaksil aloin uketziata mitgamrin kol levushayich min hechlaya dimchabbeshin beshin defil meara mini yachdunach:

rashi: Nirdam verechev vasus. vav shel verechev tefela hi, kemo "elle vene tzivon veayya vaana" (Bereshit 36:24) – vav shel veayya tefela hi:
targum: Mimzufetach elaha deyaakov demachun artichin uferashin itakaru:

rashi: Zachor et asher asa lecha. im shikkarta vemiddot uvemishkalot heve doeg miggeruy haoyev, shenneemar (Mishlei 11) "mozne mirma toavat Adonai", uchetiv batreh "ba zadon vayyavo kalon" (tanchuma):
ohc: Zachor vegomer. sheen kayyotze bahem sheyyatza al yisrael belo kedimut yediatam mimmennu, ella kaasher yide hannesher, vehu karcha badderech.

rashi: Vehaya lifnot erev. samuch leheerev shimsho yitbol, sheeno tahor belo heerev hashshemesh (80 sifre):

Yenakkesh noshe lechol asher lo. adam hattoreach mechazzer velahut laasot davar, nofel bo lashon mitnakkesh, kelomar: mutraf umitlabbet, kemo "vearkubbate da leda nakshan" (Daniel 5:6), vechen "pen tinnakesh acharehem" (Devarim 12:30). af kan yihye hannoshe beesav et avodato shenneemar "verav yaavod tzair" (Bereshit 25:23). lashon acher: yihye hannoshe nogea venikrav lechol asher lo, yenakkesh 606 belaaz. yehi mishpat hannoshe nokesh venishan al kol mamono, vezehu yaakov hannoshe beesav et avodato shenneemar "verav yaavod tzair" (Bereshit 25:23) matzati:
targum: Yegabbev mezofa lechol dileh veyivzun nuchrain leuteh:

rashi: Asher karcha badderech. leshon mikre; davar acher — leshon keri vetuma shehaya metammean bemishkav zechur; davar acher — leshon kor vechom, tzinnencha vehifshircha mertichatcha, shehayu chol haummot yereim lehillachem bachem uva ze vehitchil vehera makom laacherim; mashal leambati rotachat sheen kol beriyya yechola lered betochah, ba ven beliyyaal echad kafatz veyarad letochah, aappi shennichva hekerah otah bifne acherim (tanchuma):
Vayzannev becha. makkat zanav, chotech milot vezorek kelappe mala (tanchuma):
Kol hannecheshalim acharecha. chasre choach mechamat chetam, shehaya heanan poltan (tanchuma):
Veatta ayef veyagea. ayef batztzama, dichtiv "vayyitzma sham haam lammayim" (Shemot 17) uchetiv acharav "vayyavo amalek":
Veyagea. badderech:
Velo yare. amalek elohim millehara lecha:
ohc: Asher karcha. yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (rosh hashshana 3.) sheamru sheheanan haya mechasse al yisrael velo haya mekomam yadua laolam, ella keshemmet aharon nistalleku anne chavod uva hakkenaani vayyillachem im yisrael. veim ken tikshe minnayin yada amalek mekom chaniyyat yisrael lavo etzlam lehillachem immam? laze amar asher karcha, perush yiker mikrehu veyada machanehem badderech. veamro vayzannev becha vegomer, perush lo sheheanan hinnicho likkanes lifnim lemachane yisrael, ella beotan shehaya heanan poltan, vehu amro "vayzannev becha" otam hannecheshalim acharecha.
Veatta ayef veyagea vegomer. ayef adayin mishshibud mitzrayim, veyagea mittorach hadderech.

Veamro velo yare elohim, perush, uvaze ba hammorech bilvavcha yoter mimmifal ayefut vigiut, al derech amro (yeshaya log,yad) "pachadu vetziyyon chattaim", aval im hayu tzaddikim lo yifchadu velo yiru bemilchamto. veheir hakkatuv batteamim shemmasniim oto belibbenu, ki hetzar leyisrael tzara gedola, shebba alehem kaasher yide hannesher belo yedia, kemo sheramaz gam ken bemaamar "karcha", vehem yegeim vaayefim, vedavar hammaamid hakkoach bayyecholet hannelam en immam, ma shello haya ken bishar kol hammilchamot, shemmillevad shello yiafu velo yigau bammilchamot, od lahem kullam tzaddikim yire elohim nemuche lev.
Chassalat parashat ki tetze

rashi: Ki killat elohim taluy. zilzulo shel melech hu, sheadam asuy bidmut deyokano, veyisrael hem banav; mashal lishne achim teomim shehayu domim ze laze, echad naasa melech veechad nitpas lelistiyyut venitla, kol haroe oto omer hammelech taluy. kol kelala shebbammikra leshon hakel vezilzul, kemo (Melachim 1 2) "vehu killani kelala nimretzet":
Ish habbenayim. gibbor letze mimmaarcheto, laamod ben shete hammaarachot:
targum: Unefak gavra mibbenehon mimashiryat felishtae galyat shemeh migat rumeh shitta amin vezerta:

rashi: Ki tashshe vereacha. tachov bachavercha:
Mashshat meuma. chov shel kelum:
Lo tidrosh shelomam. mikkelal shenneemar immecha yeshev bekirbecha yachol af ze ken, talo lo tidrosh shelomam (80 sifre):
Useneah haish haacharon. hakkatuv mevassero shessofo lisnotah, veim lav kovarto, shenneemar o chi yamut (sifre):
Ki yihye riv. sofam lihyot niggashim el hammishpat. emor meatta en shalom yotze mittoch meriva, mi garam lelot lifrosh min hatztzaddik? heve omer zo meriva:

Vehirshiu et harasha. yachol kol hammitchayyevin baddin lokin, talmud lomar — vehaya im ben hakkot harasha. peamim loke ufeamim eno loke. umi hu halloke? lemod min hainyan, "lo tachsom shor bedisho" — lav shello nittak laase (80 sifre; makkot 13):
Vezacharta. al menat ken pediticha, lishmor chukkotay afillu yesh chesron kis baddavar:
Even vaaven. mishkalot:
Gedola uketanna. gedola shemmachcheshet et hakketanna, shello yehe notel baggedola umachazir bakketanna (sifre):
Gedilim taase lach. af min hakkilayim, lechach semachan hakkatuv (yevamot 4):
Ki yinnatzu anashim. sofo lavo lide makkot, kemo shenneemar miyyad makkehu, en shalom yotze mittoch yede matztzut (sifre):
ohc: Lehatztzil vegomer veshalcha yadah vegomer. velo amar hakkatuv "veshalcha yadah vegomer lehatztzil et ishah", heir baze sheim lo haya lah metziut lehatztzil balah miyyad makkehu ella al yede ze, lefi sheen koach bah lehatztzil ella bederech ze – petura. vedavka shehaya chavero makkehu makkat nefesh, laze hikdim maamar "lehatztzil" kodem maamar "veshalcha", lomar sheim yadanu shello shalcha ella lehatztzil – petura.

rashi: Al azenecha. levad mishshear kele tashmishcha:
Azenecha. kemo keli zayin:

Eshtollu. kemo hishtollu; kemo "veachare chen etchabbar achazya vegomer" (divrei hayamim 2 20:35) – kemo hitchabber. venigzar eshtollu miggizrat "molich yoatzim sholal" (Iyov 12:17), vehu leshon mishge veshalu" (Daniel 3:29), keshotim shogim; vehattav nofelet bilshon hammitpael beemtza hatteva, bechol teva shettechillatah shin:
Namu shenatam. nirdemu beshena, leshon "tenuma" (tehillim 132:4):
Velo matzu yedehem. vechocham, keshebbata lippara mehem:
targum: Ashlichun meilavehon zeyane kerava gibbare libba itnamnamu beshintehon vela sappiku kol gavre chela lemechad zeyanehon bidehon:

rashi: Benot melachim. yihyu mevakkerot otcha, keinyan shenneemar: "vesarotehem menikotayich" (Yeshayahu 49:23):

Beyikkerotecha. kof dagush, lefi shehu leshon bikkur, veaf al pi shekkatuv yod lefaneha. raiti benikkud rav seadya teva zo sedura im "mi natan limshissa yaakov" (Yeshayahu 42:24), shekkatuv bo yod vehassamech mudgeshet. umenachem chibbero leshon yoker, kemo "yekar mikkeli faz" (Iyov 28:17) (sefer acher eno):
Shegal. malka, kemo "vehashshegal yoshevet etzlo" (Nechemya 2:6), "veyishton behon malka ravrevanohi sheglateh ulechenateh" (Daniel 5:2). ishtecha tityatztzev limincha:
Bechetem ofir. bikvutzat adi zahav habba meofir:
targum: Palche malkevata atin lemikbel appach uleyakrutach bizman dimattad sefar orayyta bistar yeminach umitkatteva beovarizin demin ofir:

rashi: Lannochri tashshich. velo leachicha, lav habba mikkelal ase, ase, laavor alav bishne lavyn vaase:
ohc: Lannachri tashshich uleachicha lo tashshich. kashe lamma kafal lomar uleachicha lo tashshich achar shetztzivva besamuch "lo tashshich leachicha" vegomer. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (bava metzia 75:) laavor alav bishne lavin. veulay shennitkavven lomar shehagam shehanneshicha hi legoy, im haddavar al yede yisrael asur, kol od sheyyisrael eno makkir haggoy bead halevaato o im en beyado mashkon haggoy, vechach hu haddin.

Od yirmoz lema shechilleku haachronim (yore dea siman 159), sheafillu legoy asur lehatemid baze mishshum shemma yavo litteno gam leyisrael, vehu amro lannachri tashshich, utenay hu haddavar shello taase beofen sheyyetze mizze kilkul shettashshich leachicha.

targum: La yehe leh naged chisda vela yehe leh chayes al yatmoy:
Vaazalu telata bene yishay ravrevaya azalu batar shaul likrava veshum telata venohi daazalu likrava eliav buchera vetinyaneh avinadav utelitaa shama:
Veshaul veenash yisrael itkenishu ushero bemeshar butema vesadaru kerava lokodamut pelishtae:
Ma bar nasha mitul tidkar ovadoy uvar nasha metul tisar aloy:
Vechol enash yisrael bemechezehon yat gavra veappichu min kodamohi udechilu lachada:
Yehon benoy yatme veitteteh armalta:
Vaamar yishay ledavid bereh sav kean laachayich mechilta dekalya haden veasra tulemin delachma haden veovil lemashrita laachaych:
Di leh yama vehu avad yateh veyabbeshta aydo veriu:
Vaamar pelishtaa ana chasadit yat sidre yisrael yoma den lememar ayto li gavra venagiach kerava kachada:
Beshaa zeera rechaktich uverachamin sagiin akarev galvatach:
Arum elaha rabba Adonai umalka rabba al kol elaha:
Im yikkul laagacha kerava imi veyiktelinani unehe lechon leavdin veim ana ikkul leh veaktilineh utehon lana leavdin vetiflechun yatana:
Are marich deavdich Adonai tzevaot sheme ufarkich kadisha deyisrael elah kol ara yitkere:
Veshaul veinun vechol enash yisrael bemeshar butema megichin kerava im pelishtae:

Vaamar david legavraya dekaymin imeh lememar ma yitaved legavra deyiktol yat felishtaa dechi veyadi chisuda meal yisrael are man felishtaa arela haden are chasad sidre avde kerava deameh dayya kayama:
Metul deechme shemayich ovadi etzbeatach sihara vechochvaya di atkenta:
Nekadem appoy betodata betushebachaya neyabbev kodamoy:
Ushema shaul vechol yisrael yat pitgame pelishtaa hailen veitbaru udechilu lachada:
Ufelishtae kaymin al tura mikka veyisrael kaymin al tura mikka vechelta benehon:

bart: Yatza achad mehen lachutz. chutz laazara:
Happenimi kasher. venoten mimmennu mattenotav vehakkarban kasher:
Vachachamim poslin. dichtiv (Vayikra 6) asher yuva middamah, vaafillu miktzat damah, pasul, middelo chetiv et damah:
Uma im bemakom shehammachashava foselet bachutz. kelomar, uma chutz, shehu makom shehammachashava foselet bo, sheim chashav bashshechita al menat lizrok damah lachutz, pesula:
Lo asa. etzel motzi miktzat damah lachutz et hameshuyyar bifnim kayyotze, kidamritu happenimi kasher:

Mekom sheen hammachashava foselet bifnim. kelomar hechol shehu makom sheen machashava foselet bo, sheim shachat al menat litten et hannittanim bachutz bifnim, kasher, eno din kulei. veen halacha kerabbi yose haggelili. vedavka bedam hu deamrinan deim yatza chutz laazara o nichnas bifnim lehazzot mimmennu bahechol nifsal. aval besar kadashim nehi deim yatza lachutz nifsal veasur baachila, dichtiv (Shemot 22) uvasar bassade terefa, basar sheyyatza chutz limchitztzato, dehaynu kadshe kadashim chutz laazara vekadashim kallim michutz lair, naasa cheillu hu basar bassade vahare hu terefa velo tochlu. mikkol makom im nichnas lifnim el toch hahechol lo nifsal bishvil ken umuttar baachila, deamar kera asher yuva middamah lo tochal, middamah velo mibbesara:
Ad sheyyechapper. bahechol:
Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Veen hatztzitz meratztze al hayyotze. veaf al gav difsulim shealu lo yerdu, artzoye miha lo artzo, dichtiv batztzitz (sham 28) venasa aharon et avon hakkodashim, uvefarashat emor ketiv kol ish asher yikrav mikkol zarachem el hakkodashim vegomer‏ vetumato alav, ma kadashim haamurim lehallan betuma hakkatuv medabber, af avon kadashim haamurim batztzitz betuma hakkatuv medabber:
Shabbat shechal tisha veav. shavua shechal tisha veav lihyot betochah:
Asur lesapper ulechabbes. kol oto shavua ad sheyyaavor hattaanit:
Uvachamishi muttarim. keshehayu mekaddeshim al pi hariyya vechal tisha veav lihyot beerev shabbat, muttarim lechabbes bachamishi shellifne hattaanit mippene chevod hashshabbat:

Shene tavshilin. en asur mishshum shene tavshilin ella davar sheeno neechol kemot shehu chay, aval davar hanneechol kemot shehu chay kegon chalav ugevina vekitniyyot bizman shehi lacha, af al pi shebbishshelan en bahen mishshum shene tavshilin:

Velo yochal basar velo yishte yayin. hanne mile leachar chatzi hayyom, uvasseudda hammafseket sheen dato leechol achareha seuddat keva. aval kodem chatzi hayyom afillu bisudda hammafseket, o visudda sheenah mafseket afillu leachar chatzi hayyom, share leechol shene tavshilin, uvevasar veyayin:
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer yeshanne. im haya ragil bishne tavshilin ochel tavshil echad. haya ragil bishne chosot shel yayin shote kos echad. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Bichfiyyat hammitta. shekkofe hammitta al paneha velo yishkav aleha ella bakkarka. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Dam temimim shennitarev bedam baale mumin yishshafech laamma. uveha lo faleg rabbi eliezer, deavar bizrikatan mishshum lo takrivu:
Nitarev kos bechosot. kos dam shel baal mum bechosot shel dam kasher, veen yadua ezehu kos shel dam baal mum:

Rabbi eliezer omer im karav echad mehem kulei. kederech shennechleku beevarim veevre vaale mumin, kach nechleku bechosot, vechidfarishna leel. utzericha leafluge betarvayhu, dei ashmeinan beevarim, beha kaamar rabbi eliezer yikrevu mishshum deitavida chapparatan behechsher, dehaynu zerikat daman shehi ikkar kappara, aval gabbe chos bechosot deikkar kappara bekilkul, ema lo, tzericha:

Hannittanin bifnim kulei‏ yishshafchu laamma. delo amrinan roim, veasur leshannot et ellu mippene hechsheran shel ellu. verabbi eliezer desavar amrinan roin, lo faleg hacha. dehechi laavid, netiv lachutz vahadar lifnim, keshem shemmitzva lehakedim elyonim letachtonim kach mitzva lehakedim penimi lechitzon, difnimi chashuv. netiv bifnim vahadar netiv bachutz, kevan deikka chattat veasham sheim nitarev damam baddamim happenimim lo matze lememar yitten bifnim veachar kach yitten bachutz mishshum demippasle chitzonim, lo fesika leh. veim tomar lifselinhu lachitzonim kede lehacheshir penimim. lemifselinhu beyadayim lo kaamar rabbi eliezer, umutav lehametin ad shekiat hachamma veyippaslu mealehen veyishshafchu laamma:
Natan bachutz. kohen shello nimlach venatan mittaarovet zo bachutz, kasher:
Rabbi akiva fosel. hachitzon. shekkol damim hachitzonim shennichnesu lifnim nifselu:
Vachachamim machshirim. bechol hakkarbanot, chutz mechattat hachitzona demippasla mishshum vechol chattat asher yuva kulei. vahalacha kachachamim:
Min bemino. chattat bechattat, ola beola, shelamim bishlamim, ella shehen shel bealim harebe:

Yakriv kol echad leshem mi shehu. velo yazkir shem adam. vehane mille bekarbanot shel nashim delo vae semicha, dichtiv bene yisrael vesamach, bene yisrael somchim veen benot yisrael somchot. aval bekarban anashim devae semicha, lo:
Min besheeno mino yiru. shei efshar behakerava, shechalukin bemattan damim o vehaketaratan o vaachilatan:

Veyafsid hammotar mibbeto. sheim machar echad mehen bishnayim vehaacher beechad, tzarich lehavi mikkol min bishnayim, kevan sheen yadua meeze min hu oto shennimkar bishnayim, venimtza mafsid echad mibbeto:
Nitarvu vivchor uvemaaser. behema. sheen lahem pidyon shettachul kedushshato al demehen veyetzu hen lechullin, ella neechalin bemuman, habbechor neechol lakkohanim vehammaaser labbealim:

Kullan yiru ad sheyyistaavu. sheyyippol bahen mum. veyomar, kol makom shehu hazzevach yitchallel al hammaot hallalu. umuttarim leachlan, uvilvad sheyyeachlu betorat bechor umaaser, shello yimkerem baitliz velo yishkelem ballitra. umiddeme hazzevach yakriv mino shel zevach:
Hakkol yecholim lehitarev. kelomar im nitarvu yesh safek betaaravtan:

Chutz min hachattat im haasham. shehachattat enah leolam ayil, veasham eno ella ayil. vei asham metzora vaasham nazir hu shehen baim kevasim, mikkol makom hen zecharim, vehachattat enah baa ella nekeva. aval chattat veola mitarvim, kegon seir nasi bisir olat nedava. vechol shekken chattat ushelamim, shehakkol karev shelamim ben zecharim ben nekevot. vechen ayil shel olat nedava beasham:
Hakkevesh mekaddesh. dichtiv (Shemot 40) umashachta et hammizbeach vegomer, et, lerabbot et hakkevesh:
Hakkelim mekaddeshim. divchelim nammi chetiv (sham 30) kol hannogea bahem yikdash:
Kele hallach. kearot umizrakot ledam uleyayin uleshemen:
Middot hayyavesh. shete middot shel yavesh hayu sham, issaron, vachatzi issaron:

Shehayu osin vehen shelemim. shehayu osim keshehen shelemim. umihu kol kele sharet shennikkevu o shennishberu en metakkenin shivrehen ella osim otan chadashim. vechen sakkin shennifgam en mashchizin oto lehasir happegam. uvigde chehunna shennitlachlechu en mechabbesin otan ella osim chadashim umannichin ellu letzorech petilot shel menora vesimchat bet hashshoeva. vechol kach lamma, lefi sheen aniyyut bimkom ashirut. umizbeach shennifgam pasul. vechol pegima happoselet besakkin shel shechita, poselet bammizbeach. vechol zeman shehammizbeach pagum kol kadashim hannishchatin baazara kullam pesulin, dichtiv (sham 20) vezavachta alav et olotecha veet shelamecha, vei efshar lomar mikra kemashmao shehare shechitat kadashim baazara hi velo al hammizbeach, ella alav, kelomar kol zeman shehu shalem atta zoveach, veen atta zoveach keshehu fagum. vechol kadashim hannimtzaim baazara beshaa shehammizbeach pagum af al pi shennishchatu vechashrut, kullam pesulim. vaafillu sheyare menachot enam neechalim, dichtiv (Vayikra 10) veichluha matztzot etzel hammizbeach, mippi hashshemua lamdu bizman shehammizbeach shalem velo bizman shehu fagum:

En ben yom tov leshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad. matnitin bet shammay hi deamre [betza 12.] en motziin et hakkatan velo et hallulav velo et hassefer tora lirshut harabbim kevan sheen bahem tzorech ochel nefesh. veen ken halacha, ella kedivre bet hillel deamre mittoch shehuttera hotzaa letzorech achila huttera nammi shello letzorech achila. veikka nammi mille acharina sheasurim beshabbat umuttarim beyom tov af al pi sheenam tzorech ochel nefesh, kegon mashshilin perot derech arubba beyom tov, aval lo beshabbat:
Shezze zedono bide adam. shabbat yesh bah mitat bet din:
Hammorid et haggalgallim. ofan markevotav, metargeminan galgele retichehon:

Bishat hakkadim. bishat hachom ruach hakkadim noshev. vederech kele etz shehem mitbakkeim mippene hachom, umoridin otan lammayim vehabbekaim mitchabberim. vehayenu sheyyachutzu, kemo sheyyautzu, kelomar kede sheyyehadku veyiddachaku habbekaim ze vaze:
Hare ze vechi yuttan. hammayim hannitlim bahem machshirin hazzeraim lekabbel tuma, mishshum denicha leh sheyyihyu otam hammayim nitlim bakkeli lehaddek habbekaim:

Bishat hayyachaf. shehabbehema yegea vaayefa mittorach hadderech, vechen beshaa shehi dasha vattevua, hammayim shehi maala veragleha leolam machshirim hazzeraim lekabbel tuma, lefi shehem leratzon, shehammayim yafim lah letzannenah ulekarrah. perush acher, bishat hayyachaf vehaddayish, bishat hakkatzir rotze hu shehabbehema tirchatz ragleha bishvil sheyyihyu nekiyyot ladush hattevua:
Shete reiyyot. ben beyom echad ben bishne yamim retzufim. vechen shalosh reiyyot ben beyom echad ben bishlosha yamim retzufim, o shetayim beyom echad veachat lemachar:

Ella karban. shezzav haroe shete reiyyot eno taun karban. aval leinyan laasot mishkav umoshav av hattuma vaafillu lo naga bahen, usefirat shiva mishsheyyifsok mizzovo, shetztzarich limnot shiva nekiyyim kodem sheyitbol, ze vaze shavim:
En ben metzora musgar. shettaun hesger kedichtiv (Vayikra 13) vehisgiro hakkohen shivat yamim:
Limtzora muchlat. shettimmeo hakkohen legamre:
Ella feria uferima. ha leinyan shilluach vetuma ze vaze shavin:
