En ben tahor mittoch hesger letahor mittoch hechlet ella tiglachat vetzipporim. degabbe tiglachat vetzipporim ketiv (sham 14) vehinne nirpa nega hatztzaraat min hatztzarua, yatza musgar shetztzarato teluya bayyamim, sheafillu nirpa tzarich lihyot musgar shiva yamim. aval leinyan tohora bemikve ze vaze shavin, divtahor mittoch hesger nammi ketiv (sham 13) vechibbes begadav vetaher. veaf al gav deikka nammi karbenot asham velog shemen, mihu hacha beyom tohorato urefuato hu dekatane, velo ayre bakkarbanot shehen bashshemini:

Kol hattadir mechavero kodem et chavero. dichtiv millevad olat habboker asher leolat hattamid. mikkedi chetiv millevad olat habboker, haasuya chevar mashma, minna shaminan ditmidin kodmin lemusafin, asher leolat hattamid lamma li, peshita deolat habboker olat hattamid hi, ella tala lecha taam hakedamatah betadirut kede shettilmod lishar tedirin sheyyakdimu. demishshum hi gufah lo hava tzarich lefaroshe:
Ellu hen maamadot. ma taam kaamar, ma taam tikkenu maamadot, lefi shenneemar tzav et bene yisrael vegomer:
Al kol mishmar umishmar haya maamad. miktzat shivte yisrael chalukim leesrim vearbaa chalakim, sheluchim mikkol yisrael laamod al hakkarban im hakkohanim vehaleviyyim shebbeoto mishmar:

Veyisrael shebbeoto mishmar mitkannesin learehem. otam shehayu rechokim mirushalayim velo hayu yecholim laalot laamod al hakkarban bammishmar shellahen, mitkannesim bevatte chenesiyyot bearehen umitannim umitpallelim vekorin battora bechol yom bemaase vereshit, lehodia shehaolam omed al haavoda sheosim bammikdash:
Megilla nikret beachad asar, bishnem asar. peamim baze ufeamim baze, kedimfaresh veazel:

Mimot yehoshua bin nun korin bachamishsha asar. dichtiv (Ester 9) al ken hayyehudim happerazim osim et yom arbaa asar, umiddifrazim bearbaa asar shema minna demukkafin bachamishsha asar. umimot yehoshua, nafka lan gezera shava mipperazi perazi, ketiv hacha hayyehudim happerazim uchetiv hatam (Devarim 3) levad meare happerazi, ma lehallan mimot yehoshua af kan mimot yehoshua. vetikkenu shehakkerakkim hammukkafim choma mimot yehoshua af al pi sheen lahem choma achshav yikreu bachamishsha asar kemo shushan, kede lachalok kavod leeretz yisrael shehayta chareva bime mardechay veester, kede sheyyihyu korin kivne shushan veyechashvu keillu hem kerakkim hammukkafim af al pi shehem atta charevin, veyihye zikkaron leeretz yisrael benes ze. ulefi sheyyehoshua hitchil lehillachem baamalek techilla uchetiv (Shemot 17) ketov zot zikkaron bassefer vesim beazne yehoshua, lefichach hizkiru mimot yehoshua:

Ella shehakkefarim makdimin. kelomar meachar shemmukkafin korin bachamishsha asar vesheen mukkafin bearbaa asar, hakkol bichlal, vehechi mashkachat tu achad asar shenem asar ushelosha asar, ella shehakkefarim natnu lahem reshut lehakedim keriatan leyom hakkenisa, yom sheni beshabbat shellifne arbaa asar, o chamishi beshabbat, shehen yom hakkenisa shehakkefarim mitkannesim baayarot lemishpat, lefi shebbet din yoshvim besheni vachamishi betakkanat ezra, i nammi mitkannesin hakkefarim laayarot bashsheni vachamishi lishmoa keriat hattora, vehakkefarim enam bekiim kol kach likrot utzerichim sheyyikraenna lahem echad mibbene hair, velo hitrichum chachamim lachazor velavo beyom arbaa asar, kede sheyyihyu penuyim beyom purim lehasepik tzarche seuddat purim livne haayarot. umatzu ledavar ze remez min hammikra, dichtiv (Ester 9) lekayyem et yeme happurim haelle bizmannehem, vei lo takkun mardechay veester ella arbaa asar vachamishsha asar hakketuvim bammikra, lema kera bizmannam, may zemannehem, shema minnah od shene zemannim acherim chutz meotan hakketuvim bammegilla. ushelosha asar lo tzarich kera leribbuye sheyyehe rauy likria, sheikkar hannes bo haya, shebbo nikhalu lehinnakem meoyvehem ben beshushan ben bishar medinot, al karchacha lo rabbe kera ella achad asar ushenem asar. veen lomar derabbe shishsha asar veshiva asar shelleachar arbaa asar vachamishsha asar hakketuvim bammegilla, deamar kera (sham) velo yaavor:
Barzel tame. shebba mishshivre chelim temein:
Shebbelalo. shetterafo veervo im barzel tahor shebba min haeshet:

Im rov min hattame tame. chachamim gazru al kele mattachot shennitmeu ushevaran vehittichan veasa mehen kelim, sheyyachzeru letumatan hayeshana ad sheyyazze alehen shelishi ushevii veyatbilem veyaariv shimshan:
Gisterayot. kemin kederot asuyot lehashetin bahen. uvelashon aravi korin lahen 573:
Sheyyisrael venachrim mattilin letochan. mashtinim letochan. vesheten shel nachri tame, degazru alehen sheyyihyu chezavin lechol divrehen:
Me shefichut. mayim sherachatzu vahen veshofchin otan lachutz, uvechezkat temein hen:
Ematay. mitbattelin me hashshefichut berov:
Bizman shekkadmu. hen, veachar kach rabbu alehen me geshamim vetiharum:
Aval im kadmu me geshamim. afillu naflu alehen mashshehu me shefichut, temeim:
Nichtavin bechol lashon. bichtav shel kol umma uvelashon shel kol umma:

En nichtavin ella yevanit. vetama desharu sefarim bivanit yoter mishshear leshonot, deamar kera (Bereshit 9) yaft elohim leyefet veyishkon beohole shem, yefefuto shel yefet, kelomar hallashon hayyafa shebbechol bene yefet, yishkon beohole shem, veen lecha lashon yafa bechol bene yefet kilshon yevani. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. mihu bazzeman hazze kevar avad oto leshon yevani venishtabbesh, lefichach en kotvin sefarim bazzeman hazze ella bichtav hakkodesh uvilshon hakkodesh:

Limrubbe vivgadim. kohanim sheshshimmeshu bevayit sheni, veaf bevayit rishon min yoshiyyahu veelach shennigneza tzelochit shel shemen hammishcha beyamav, velo hayu kohanim gedolim ella bilvishat habbegadim bilvad:
Par habba al kol hammitzvot. kohen mashuach shehora hetter bedavar shezzedono karet, veasa kehoraato, mevi par, kedichtiv (Vayikra 4) veim hakkohen hammashiach:
Kohen hameshammesh. kohen gadol sheera bo fesul uminnu acher tachtav veavar pesulo vechazar laavodato, veheeviru habba tachtav, harishon karuy meshammesh, vehashsheni avar:

Ella par yom hakkippurim. shei efshar lehavi shenayim. vechen asirit haefa chavite kohen gadol shebbechol yom shei efshar lehavi shetayim. ha lechol shear devarim ze vaze shavin, im ba lehaketir o laavod shum avoda meshammesh bishmona begadim, ushenehem metzuvvin al habbetula, umuzharim al haalmana, umakrivin onnin:
Hamerabbetz et beto. mezallef bo mayim kede shello yaale haavak:
Vetannu. nitlachlechu. leshon im hayta sade metunnenet, shepperusho sade lacha, beferek kamma demoed katan [daf 6]:
Im mechamat hassela. tzur shemmishsheshshet yeme vereshit, vehu ritzpat habbayit, umittoch kach nitlachlechu hachittim:
Hametannen bechol. matmin happerot bechol kede sheyyittannenu, kelomar sheyyitlachlechu, sheyyekabbelu millachluchit hachol:
Hare ze vechi yuttan. deen chol belo mayim:

Bishlosha ferakim bashshana vechulei. hachi kaamar, bishlosha ferakim, shehem taaniyyot umaamadot veyom hakkippurim demassik batar hachi, kohanim nosin et kappehem bechol tefilla, dehaynu shacharit mincha uneila. veyesh yom echad beellu happerakim shennosim kappehem arbaa feamim bayyom, vehu yom hakkippurim, sheyyesh bo tefillat musaf. umatnitin rabbi meir hi, deamar yesh nesiut kappayim bemincha battaaniyyot uvammaamadot, dechol yoma taama may en nesiut kappayim bemincha, mishshum shichrut, vehaidna lekka shichrut. verabbi yose paleg aleha veamar degazrinan mincha shel taanit attu mincha dechol yoma. vahalacha kerabbi yose battaaniyyot uvammaamadot uveyom hakkippurim deit behu tefillat neila, aval battaaniyyot sheen mitpallelin bahen neila parse kohane yedayhu beminchata detaanita, kevan desamuch lishkiat hachamma matzle la, kitfillat neila damya, uminchata kehay leta bechol yoma, hilkach lo gazru vah:
Battaaniyyot uvammaamadot. hachi kaamar, veellu hen shelosha ferakim, taaniyyot umaamadot veyom hakkippurim:
Umaamadot. anshe maamad hayu mitannim arbaa yamim bashshavua:
Hannittazin. mimmenna lachutz:
Vehatztzafin. lemala veyatzu lachutz. kullehu enan bechi yuttan, lefi shehen shello leratzon, vechen hammayim shebbetochah:
Netalah leshafchan. shello shefachan bimkoman, ella natal haareva lishpoch hammayim bemakom acher, hare hen bechi yuttan, dilratzon hen hoil velo shefachan miyyad sham bimkoman:
Uvet hillel omrim. kevan shello hinnichan sham ella netalah leshafchan, enan bechi yuttan:
Hinnichah. im hinniach et haareva mittechilla kede sheyyered haddelef letochah:
Ellu vaellu. bet shammay uvet hillel modim sheaf al pi shennetalah achar kach ushefachah, hare hen bechi yuttan, hoil uchevar chishshav alehen:
Mayim haolim beyadav. shemmechabbes bahen, nicha leh:
Beraglav. lo nicha leh:

Ella im ken nittannefu raglav. havu bechi yuttan. midi dahava ammalle vechavit dilel, demayim haolim achareha bechi yuttan, kidfarishna leel, lefi shei efshar lammayim likkanes letochah ad sheyyiggeu laachoreha:
Veellu im alu yerdu. vaafillu hen kesherim utehorim. mishshum delo shayyach behu mizbeach kelal:
Besar kadshe kadashim kulei. delaachila kayme velo lemizbeach:
Vehakketoret. lo reuya hi lammizbeach hachitzon:

Hatztzemer shebberashe chevasim. garsinan. veresha devava acharita hi, uvahade atzamot vegidin katane la umishpat echad lahem. hatztzemer shebberashe chevasim, shel ola. sheharosh eno vichlal hefshet vekarev im oro, vehachi amrinan bishchitat chullin [daf 27:], minnayin lerabbot et harosh shekkevar huttaz bishchita sheaf al pi sheeno bichlal hefshet yeshno vichlal haketara, talmud lomar et harosh. veyesh tzemer begova rosho shel keves etzel arpo, vechen hassear shebbizkan hatteyashim bizman shehen mechubbarim, kullan olim:
Rov nachtomim. im rov nachtomim nachrim, happat asura, defat shel nachrim hu mishshemona asar davar sheggazru bo vayyom:
Pat issa. pat nekiyya:
Pat kibbar. pat sheenah nekiyya:

Achar rov ochle fat kibbar. im rubban nachrim, happat asura. i nammi yesh lefaresh, achar rov nachtomin, achar rov ochle fat issa vechulei, im rubban chaverim, happat tehora veen tzarich leasser. veim rubban amme haaretz, happat temea vetzarich leasser:
Keshem sheim alu lo yerdu. akkol hanach pesulin ditnan behu lo yerdu kae:
Kach im yardu. leachar shealu, lo yaalu od:
Vechullan shealu chayyim berosh hammizbeach. rabbi akiva kaamar la, demachshir bevaale mumin. umode sheim alu chayyim berosh hammizbeach yerdu, sheen hammizbeach mekaddesh baale mumin chayyim:

Ola shealta chayya lerosh hammizbeach tered. beola cheshera mayre, vedivre hakkol. velo nakat la ella mishshum sefa, lelammedcha sherosh hammizbeach makom rauy lehefshet venittuach hecha deavar ushechatah berosh hammizbeach:
Im hafach hassakkim. letzad acher, kede sheyyishru vammayim mishshene tzedadin, az huchsheru:
Im amad vehediach. im amad bammayim lehadiach ragle vehemto, az machshirim mayim haolin beraglehem im naflu al happerot:
Beadam uvivhema temea. machshirin hammayim haolim beraglehen ben hediach ben lo hediach. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Im yesh bo mare dam kasher. vehane mille keshennaflu hammayim letoch dam shel kadashim. aval im nafal dam shel kadashim letoch mayim, amrinan kamma kamma batil, vaafillu yesh bo mare dam pasul:
Nitarev beyayin. shehu adom:
Roin oto keillu hu mayim. veim haya dam ze nikkar beotan hammayim, kasher:
Bedam behema. shel chullin:
Roin oto. dam shel chullin keillu hu mayim, veim haya mare admumit shel dam hakkasher nikkar bahem, kasher, veaf al pi shehaddam happasul merubba alav harebe:

En dam mevattel dam. demin bemino lerabbi yehuda lo vatil, vaafillu tippa letoch keli gadol, af al pi sheillu haya haddam mayim en haddam hakkasher nikkar bahem, afillu hachi kasher lizrika. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Beshiva asar betammuz nishtabberu halluchot. shehare beshishshi besivan nittenu aseret haddibberot, uvashshevii behashekama ala lekabbel et shear hattora, veshaha sham arbaim yom, nimtzeu kalim beshiva asar betammuz, uchesheyyarad shibber et halluchot:
Uvatal hattamid. shello haya sham kevasim lehakeriv, shebbaa hair bammatzor:
Veheemid tzelem bahechol. pelige vah amorae bayrushalmi, chad amar tzelem shel menashshe, uvevayit rishon mayre. vechad amar tzelem shel appostomos shehaya missare hayyevanim, uvevayit sheni haya:
Asham shennitarev bishlamim. shemattan damo shel asham ushelamim shave:
Shenehem yishshachatu vatztzafon. dishlamim shechitatan bechol makom vicholim nammi leshachatan batztzafon bemakom sheshshochatim haasham:

Kechamur shebbahen. lifnim min hakkelaim lezichre chehunna leyom velayla. velo kashshelamim hakkallim shenneechalim bechol hair lechol adam lishne yamim velayla echad. uvaal hashshelamim yatza yede nidro, deha shelamim lishman hen kerevin, shemmakriv kol echad leshem mi shehu:

En meviin kadashim levet happesul. shemmemaet et achilat shelamim ben beochlehen ben bizman achilatan umevian lide notar. ella yiru veyistaavu veyimmachru kidamrinan gabbe kadashim bekadashim min besheeno mino, veyavi vidme hayyafe shebbahen kulei. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Chatichot bachatichot. im nitarvu chatichot kadshe kadashim bachatichot shel kadashim kallim, o chatichot shel kadashim kallim hanneechalim leyom echad kegon shalme toda im chatichot shel kadashim kallim hanneechalim lishne yamim velayla echad dehaynu shear shelamim, beha modu rabbanan lerabbi shimon deyeachlu kechamur shebbahen, demay it leh lemebad:

En ben adar rishon laadar sheni vechulei. hachi kaamar, en ben arbaa asar vachamishsha asar shel adar rishon learbaa asar vachamishsha asar shel adar sheni, ella mikra megilla umattanot laevyonim, ha leinyan hesped vetaanit ze vaze shavin:
Kol hazzevachim shennitarvu vechattaot hammetot. hachi kaamar, kol hazzevachim shennitarvu vahem chattaot hammetot, o shor hanniskal:

Afillu achat beribbo yamutu chullan. dechevan denitarvu beissure hanaa en takkana lifdotam denema yiru ad sheyyistaavu. velo vatle berubba, devaale chayyim chashive velo vatle. vechattaot hammetot hen chamishsha, veellu hen, velad chattat, utemurat chattat, vechattat shemmetu vealeha, veshekkipperu vealeha beacheret, vesheavra shenatah. ellu chamesh chattaot mannichin otan bemakom sagur ad sheyyamutu mealehen, vehen nikrain chattaot hammetot:
Beshor shenneevda vo avera. shehu nifsal bah lehakerava. kegon shehemit et haadam al pi ed echad sheeno asur lehedyot, lefi sheeno niskal ella al pi shene edim:
O al pi habbealim. shebbau vealim levet din vehodu shehemit, deiftar leh missekila, demode biknas patur, aval legavoah neesar, dekayma lan, umin hatztzon, lehotzi et hannogeach:
Verovea venirba. al pi ed echad, o al pi habbealim, o kodem shennigmar dino, o shehaya oto shehemit veharovea vehannirba [shel] nachri. shenneesar legavoah velo lehedyot:
Muktze. shehifrishuhu lekarban laavoda zara, veneevad nammi, shenehem muttarim lehedyot:

Uveetnan uvimchir. kol hane chullin ninhu, vezevach echad meorav bahen, kullan yiru. shei efshar lishchot echad mehem belo mum, shemma zehu hazzevach, vehashshochet kadashim bachutz chayyav karet. ulemachran letzarche olot i efshar, shehare pesulim:
Veyavi vidme hayyafe shebbahen meoto hammin. im chattat chattat veim ola ola. veyikkach maot keshiur deme hayyafe shebbechullan veyomar, kol makom shehu hazzevach yehe mechullal al hammaot hallalu:
Nitarev. zevach echad bechullin kesherim harebe:
Yimmachru hachullin. kullan:

Letzarche oto hammin shehaya hazzevach shennitarev bahen. venimtzeu kullan kadashim mimmin echad ella sheen yadua mi bealav shel kol echad veechad, shehare hazzevach harishon shem bealav alav veen yadua ezehu. vetakkanato, sheyyakriv kol echad leshem mi shehu veyomar kesheyyakriv kol echad, hare hu leshem bealim shello:
Hannittanin lematta. michut hassikra. kegon dam ola veasham ushelamim uvechor ufesach umaaser, shennitarvu bedam chattat shehu nittan lemala:

Rabbi eliezer omer yitten lemala. mattenot chattat. veaf al pi sheddam hattachtonim meorav bo. hoil veeno mitkavven latet hattachtonim lemala roe ani otam keillu hem mayim. umippene shemmitzva lehakedim elyonim letachtonim, shekkol hachattaot kodmot laolot, hilkach noten lemala techilla veachar kach lematta, unetinat matta taale lo lishfichat shirayim shel chattat ulehatchalat mattenot ola:
Yishshafchu laamma. delet lehu roim:
Veim lo nimlach venatan kasher. deha nittan mimmennu lemala. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Vehem tehorin. af al pi sheppashat adam tame et yado venatal, lefi shello huchsheru vammayim shebbammikve, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) bechol keli yitma, ma keli meyuchad shehu talush umachshir, af kol shehu talush machshir, laafoke mayim shebbevorot shichin umearot sheenan telushim min hakkarka sheenan machshirim kol zeman shello nitleshu:
Heelam min hammayim. huchsheru hatturmosin lekabbel tuma bammayim hattelushim:
Hannogim bakkuppa temeim. shehakkuppa naaset rishon keshennaga bah adam tame, vehatturmosim hannogim bakkuppa havu sheni:
Ushear kol hatturmosim. sheen nogim bakkuppa:
Tehorim. deen sheni ose shelishi bechullin:
Nidda medichato vehu tahor. delo huchshar lekabbel tuma bammayim shemmechubbarim bammeara:
Kodmot laashamot. im haya mechuyyav chattat veasham umevian, chattat kodemet. keditnan sheddamah nittan al arba keranot veal hayesod:
Mippene shehu va lehacheshir. et hammetzora lekadashim uleviat mikdash. hilkach chashivuta hu legabbeh, shehattohora teluya vo:
Uvaim bechesef shekalim. dichtiv (Vayikra 5) beerkecha kesef shekalim, baasham meilot, veate asham taluy vaasham gezelot bigzera shava beerkecha beerkecha, vaasham shifcha charufa gamar beayil ayil:
Chutz measham nazir vaasham metzora. dichtiv behu (Bamidbar 6) keves ben shenato. umiddeayil ben shete shanim bishte selaim, keves ben shana lav bishte selaim hu:
Machshir bevaale mumin. deim alu lo yerdu. vedavka vedokin shebbaayin vechayyotze vahen hichshir rabbi akiva, hoil vehen kesherim lechattechilla beofot. aval bimchussar evar defasul beofot, lo:
Doche haya abba et baale mumin. sheim alu doche haya otan kilachar yad velo haya moridan derech bizzayon befarhesya, uveha faleg attanna kamma deamar yerdu. vahalacha kerabbi chanina ven antignos:
Malak bismol. dimlikato fesula. shekkol makom shenneemar etzba uchehunna eno ella shel yamin:
O vallayla. deen melika vallayla, derachamana amar beyom tzavvoto:
Enan metammein. hoil ufesulan bakkodesh veahane melika didhu sheim alu lo yerdu:
Shachat chullin bifnim vekadashim bachutz en metammein bevet habbelia. veaf al pi sheasurim baachila:
Malak besakkin. lav melika hi velav shechita hi, deha melika betzipporen hi beatzmo shel kohen:
Malak chullin bifnim. delo shayyach melika bechullin ella bekadashim bifnim, vehammolek chullin bechol makom o kadashim bachutz have keillu nocher o meakker, veen otah melika motzia mide nevela:
Torin shello higgia zemannan. torim gedolim kesherim, ketannim pesulim. bene yona, ketannim kesherim, gedolim pesulim:

Vesheyyavash gappa. dimchussar evar pasul af baofot. deha dekayma lan en tammut vezichrut beofot, hane mille kegon dokin shebbaayin sheen muman nikkar, aval mechussar evar, hakerivehu na lefechatecha:
Metamme vevet habbelia. delo mahane melika didhu lemidi, sheafillu alu yerdu:

Kol sheen pesulan bakkodesh. shennifselu kodem shebbau laazara. vechol sheen pesulan bakkodesh amrinan lekamman beferek hammizbeach mekaddesh, deim ala yered. aval otan sheppesulan bakkodesh kegon hakkodashim haruyin ella shennifselu baavodotehen, en metammein, deha ahane lehu melika deim alu lo yerdu:
Kol happesulim. kegon zar veonen utevul yom umechussar kippurim vechol otan hashshenuyin beresh perek 2:
Veenan metammeot bevet habbelia. sheaf al pi sheen melikatan matteret kadashim baachila, mikkol makom motziatan mide nevela:
Nitarev bedam happesulim. kegon bedam shennishchat lechutz lizmanno:

Yishshafech laamma. leammat hammayim haoveret baazara veyoredet lenachal kidron. velo amrinan roim oto keillu hu mayim veim dam hakkasher nikkar bahem yizzarek, degazrinan dilma ate leachshore dam pesulim beenayhu. vechen dam hattamtzit. demiddeorayta dam hattamtzit lo chazi lechappara, dichtiv (Vayikra 17) ki nefesh habbasar baddam hiv vaani netattiv lachem al hammizbeach lechapper. dam shehannefesh yotza vo mechapper, vesheen hannefesh yotza vo eno mechapper. vegazrinan al dam hannefesh shennitarev bedam hattamtzit, dilma ate leachshore bazzerika dam hattamtzit beeneh:

Rabbi eliezer machshir. lechattechilla bedam hattamtzit shennitarev im dam hannefesh. desavar en dam hattamtzit shel behema matzuy lihyot rabbe al dam hannefesh, hilkach ammay nigzor, hava leh kenitarev dam hachullin bedam hakkodashim delo gazrinan beh mide. ucheshennitarev bedam pesulin demilleta dishchicha, lo paleg rabbi eliezer. vetanna kamma savar peamim sheddam hattamtzit rabbe al dam hannefesh, hilkach gazar hecha delo rabba attu hecha derabbe. umihu hecha delo nimlach hakkohen bevet din im yitten mitaarovet zo im lav venatan meelav, mode tanna kamma dechasher, digzera vealma hi uvediavad kasher. vechi ate leimmeloche, amrinan leh leshofcho laamma mishshum gezera. vahalacha kachachamim:
En ben bama gedola. bishat hetter habbamot mayre. bama gedola hi bamat tzibbur shehayta benov vegivon:
Levama ketanna. shel kol yachid veyachid, shekkol echad haya ose bama leatzmo:

Ella fesachim. vechol shehu keen pesachim, dehaynu hachovot shekkavua lahen zeman kappesach, kegon temidim umusafim. aval chovot sheen kavua lahem zeman, kegon par helem davar shel tzibbur useire avoda zara, af bevama gedola lo hayu kerevin:
Mappolet. shechomoteha habberiot noflot. aval reuot en zo mappolet:
Dam chattat kodem ledam ola. im shenehem shechutin veomdin lizzarek:
Shehu meratztze. mechapper al chayyave cheretot shetztzerichim ritztzuy gadol:
Evre ola kodmin. behaketaratan:
Leemure chattat. im nizreku deme shenehem:
Mippene shehen kalil. vetzad ribbuy hu ze lammizbeach:
Al arba keranot. veasham shete mattanot shehen arba velo al hakkeranot:
Veal hayesod. shefichat shirayim uveasham lo matzinu shenneemar bo:
Mattan arba. shete mattanot shehen arba, uvechor eno taun ella mattana achat, veeno taun semicha unesachim velo tenufat chaze veshok:
Naguv. yavesh:
Eno choshesh shemma natan bah chittim vetannu. hachi kaamar, im natan bah chittim, eno choshesh shemma tannu:
Keshehattal alehem. kegon shehaya maskir limlachto velikket asavim im hattal shealehem, aval hu lo nitkavven bishvil hattal:
Lehaten bahem chittim. lehatemin bahem chittim kede sheyyittannenu:
Im nitkavven lechach. lattal shealehen:
I efshar shello lismoach. shehare haya tzarich lelattan:
Ella im amad. nitakkav sham kede sheyyerdu alehem geshamim:
Evre chattat. shebbesarah neechol lakkohanim:
Shennitarvu veevre ola. shekkullah kalil:

Yitten lemalan. yitten evre hattaarovot kullan al haetzim. vetaama derabbi eliezer, deamar kera (Vayikra 2) ki chol seor vechol devash lo taktiru mimmennu ishshe laAdonai, vehachi mashmauta dikra, ki chol seor vechol devash lo taktiru, velo taktiru kol shemmimmennu ishshe laAdonai, dehaynu hashshirayim shel karban. karban reshit takrivu min hasseor vehaddevash laAdonai, shete lechem min hasseor udevash min habbikkurim mipperi haetz shehem teenim utemarim. veel hammizbeach darshinan leh ben asseor udevash ben ashshirayim, lereach nichoach i atta maale aval atta maale leshem etzim. vehayenu dekaamar veroe ani et besar chattat keillu hen etzim:

Vachachamim omrim teubbar tzuratan. kelomar yanniach otan ad sheyyippaslu veyetzu levet hasserefa kishar pesule hammukdashim, veeno maalan lammizbeach, deha avar mishshum kol shemmimmennu laishshim hare hu beval taktiru, vechattat deemurav kerevim laishshim hare habbasar beval taktiru. vahalacha kachachamim:

Yom sheyyesh bo hallel. kegon yeme chanukka sheyyesh bahem hallel veen bahem musaf, otan shebbirushalayim lo hayu korin shum parasha bashshacharit, lefi sheen lahem penay laasot maamadam, shehahallel doche otah:

Karban musaf. rosh chodesh sheyyesh bo karban musaf lo hayu korin shum parasha banneila. vechol shekken shello hayu korin parasha bammusaf atzmo velo vammincha shehi kodem neila, shekkarban musaf haya doche otam:
Karban etzim en bo vammincha. kelomar yom sheyyesh bo karban etzim kedilkamman veen bo karban musaf, doche maamad shel mincha, aval lo shel neila:

Kach haya rabbi yehoshua shone. karban etzim doche maamad dinila, vechol shekken sheddoche maamad demincha, dekarban atze chohanim haya karev kodem tamid shel ben haarbayim, veim doche maamad shel neila kol shekken sheddoche maamad shel mincha hassamuch lo:

Chazar rabbi akiva lihyot shone chedivre ven azzay. dekasavar karban musaf middivre tora, vedin hu shello yidche ella maamad demincha, delekka lemechash dilma madche karban, dedivre tora lo bae chizzuk. aval karban etzim kedivre sofrim dami, vedin hu delidche maamad demincha uneila devae chizzuk ki hechi delo ledachye lekarban etzim. velo yaradti lesof divre rambam beferush mishna zo, ki middevarav nire shehayu anshe maamad mitpallelin tefilla yetera bechol yom ben shacharit lemincha, vehi nikret tefillat musaf, vedavar ze lo metzatihu lo vabbavli velo vayrushalmi:

Velo hayu mitannin beerev shabbat mippene chevod hashshabbat. veen tzarich lomar bashshabbat atzmah, velo veyom rishon mippene shehu shelishi laytzira, shebbeerev shabbat nivra adam, veyom shelishi litzirato chalush tefe dichtiv (Bereshit 34) vayhi vayyom hashshelishi bihyotam koavim. i nammi mippene shebbashshabbat nittena vo neshama yetera ulemotzae shabbat nittelet mimmennu, veim hayu mitannim beyom rishon hayu mistakkenim. uvechol yom hayu anshe maamad mitpallelin tefillat neila:

Parasha gedola korin otah bishnayim. befarashat bereshit, leachar shekkara harishon shelosha fesukim chozer hashsheni vekore pasuk shelishi shekkara harishon umashlim parashat bereshit, vehashshelishi kore yehi rakia. bashsheni rishon kore yehi rakia, ushenayim korim yikkavu hammayim, vechen kullam:

Bashshacharit uvammusaf kulei. hacha mayre bechol shear maamadot shehayu chutz lirushalayim, shehen hayu korin bemaase vereshit kemishpatan afillu beyom sheyyesh bo karban musaf, deha inhu lo teride. aval hammaamadot shebbirushalayim, beyom sheyyesh bo karban musaf lo hayu korin bammusaf bemaase vereshit, keditnan lekamman karban musaf en bo vammincha, vehasheta karban musaf maamad demincha delav dideh dache, maamad dideh lo chol shekken.

Bashshacharit uvammusaf uvammincha kulei. hachi kaamar, bashshacharit uvammusaf hu dimviin sefer tora vekorin parasha gedola bishnayim uketanna beyachid, aval bammincha en meviin sefer tora mippene torach hattaanit ella korin al pe:
Erev shabbat bammincha lo hayu nichnasim. levet hakkeneset velo hayu korin kelal, lefi shehayu terudim letakken tzarche shabbat:
Haya vah yarak nimkar. yarak shennitlash beshabbat, nimkar lemotzae shabbat:
Im rov nachrim lokeach miyyad. dechevan derov nachrim, addata denachrim nitlash:

Kede sheyyavou mimmakom karov. sheyyesh sham yarak. veaf al gav deshemma huva mimmakom rachok, en tzarich lehametin ella chede sheyyilketu yarak mimmakom karov sheyyesh bo yarak viviuhu mishsham. shello amru chachamim velaerev yamtin bichde sheyyaasu, ella gezera shemma yomar lenachri beshabbat lech vehave, uchesheroe shetztzarich lehametin laerev kede sheyyavo haddavar hahu vaafillu mimmakom karov, lo yomar lannachri lahavio beshabbat:
Veim yesh sham rashut lokeach miyyad. deaddata deadam chashuv regilin tamid lehavi, velo addata deyisrael hevio:

Evarim beevare vaale mumim. evarim kesherim shennitarav bahen evar echad shel baale mumin, uva chohen sheeno yodea betaaravtan vehikriv echad min harashin, yakrivu chol harashin lechattechilla, detalinan issura behahu dekarev, vehanach kullehu kesherim ninhu. uvaggemara mefaresh delo share rabbi eliezer ella lehakerivan shenayim shenayim, devadday chad mehanach zug dehettera hu venittena hakerava zo likkarev mishshum hahu dehetter. vei mishshum hahu disfek issur ikka lemitleye beoto shekkarav techilla kodem shennimlach. aval echad echad shemma lo nittena hakerava zo likkarev afillu lerabbi eliezer dilma hay deissura hu:
Chutz meachad. chutz mizzug echad. hachi mefaresh leh baggemara. divchad gereda mode rabbi eliezer delo nittena hakerava zo likkarev, kedaamaran:
Hammizbeach mekaddesh et harauy lo. ufelige tannae beferusha dematnitin may nihu harauy lo:

Rabbi yehoshua omer kol harauy laishshim. lehissaref al gabbe haesh, af al pi shennifsal, im ala lammizbeach kiddesho hammizbeach venaasa lachmo, veim ala lo yered. aval davar sheen rauy laesh, kegon dam pasul unesachim pesulim, afillu im alu yerdu:
Hi haola al mokda. davar shehu lammoked veala, hare hu bahavayato velo yered. hi, mashma bahavayatah tehe:

Rabban gamliel omer kol harauy lammizbeach. vaafillu dam unesachim shennifselu, im alu lo yerdu. veen lecha lemaet ella davar shello huverar lechelko shel mizbeach meolam, kegon kematzim shello kadshu bichli achar kemitza, deaf al gav dehammincha chullah kadsha bichli en ze chelek gavoah barur, sheen hammincha kereva chullah. uvikmitza velo mattan keli, en ze mevorar lammizbeach, veeno mitkaddesh afillu ala al gabbe hammizbeach:
Ella haddam vehannesachim. shehem reuyim lammizbeach veenam reuyim laishshim:

Rabbi shimon omer hazzevach kasher vehannesachim pesulim. rabbi shimon sevira leh binsachim shel zevach kerabbi yehoshua uvedam uvinsachim habbaim bifne atzman kerabban gamliel. velo mimmokda yalef, ella mikkera dichtiv (Shemot 29) kol hannogea bammizbeach yikdash, uchetiv batreh veze asher taase al hammizbeach kevasim bene shana temimim shenayim layyom ola, en hammizbeach mekaddesh ella dumeya deola, ma ola habbaa biglal atzmah, af kol habbaim biglal atzman, yatzu nesachim habbaim biglal hazzevach. hilkach ben shehazzevach kasher vehannesachim pesulim kegon sheyyatzu o nitmeu, ben shehazzevach pasul vehannesachim kesherim, dehoil vehen baim biglalo nifsalim immo uvetela torat hekdesh mehen:
Vaafillu ze veze pesulim hazzevach lo yered. shehammizbeach mekaddesho:
Vehannesachim yeredu. kevan sheen baim biglal atzman enan dumeya deola veen mizbeach mekaddeshan. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:

Chal lihyot arbaa asar beerev shabbat. ayarot umukkafin korin bo bayyom, sheen keriat megilla beshabbat, gezera shemma yittelenna beyado veyaavirenna arba ammot birshut harabbim, veim yeacharenna ad echad beshabbat hava leh shishsha asar, veamar kera velo yaavor. veaf al pi shebbene hakkerakkim korin hammegilla bearbaa asar keshechal chamishsha asar lihyot beshabbat, mikkol makom en korin vayyavo amalek ella beshabbat shehu yom chamishsha asar umaftirim pakadti, veshoalin vedorshin behilchot purim kol otah shabbat. useuddat purim it deamre deavdi la beyom arbaa asar shebbo korin et hammegilla, veit deamre dimacharin otah leachar hashshabbat. vehachi mashma bayyerushalmi disuddat purim shechal lihyot beshabbat meacharin velo makdimin. ulechulle alma en osim otah beshabbat:

Chal lihyot. arbaa asar: beechad beshabbat kefarim makdimin leyom hakkenisa. dahava leh achad asar. vehane mille shehekellu chachamim livne hakkefarim lehakedim leyom hakkenisa, bizman sheyyisrael sheruyin al admatan usheluche bet din yotzim lehodia matay kiddeshu bet din hachodesh umatay happesach nikba. aval bazzeman hazze shehaam mistakkelin bikriat hammegilla umonim mimmenna sheloshim yom lefesach, im yakdimu hakkefarim keriatan hare yaasu happesach lesof sheloshim yom shel keria, venimtzeu ochlin chametz beyamim acharonim shel pesach, lefichach en korin otah ella bizmannah:
Sak shehu male. maalot hammeara. hamelea mayim:
Kol sheshshaavu. happerot millachluchit hammayim, hare ze bechi yuttan. denicha leh sheyyishavu happerot min hammayim, shemmittoch kach hen nirin gassim unefuchim:
Rabbi yehuda omer kol shehu cheneged hammayim kulei. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Bechol makom. vaafillu hearim harchokot mimmenna harebe, kedimfaresh taama besefa mippene shehi makka mehallechet:
Shiddafon. ruach shemmafsid et hattevua umitrokenet min hazzera:
Yerakon. tevua shehichsifu faneha. veyesh mefarshim yerakon choli shehofech pene adam kemare yerek hassade:
Veal chayya raa. shenniret bayyom bayyishshuv:
Veal hacherev. chelot haovrot mimmakom lemakom, veaf al pi sheenam baim lehillachem im otah hair:
Bechol haroe. bechol makom sheyyachol lirot mishsham et shilo:
Yesh achareha hetter. keshecharva shilo hutteru habbamot:
Yadav tehorot. delo vainan kavvana lechullin. aval im hayu ferot maaser vechol shekken shel teruma, yadav temeot keshehayu, ad sheyyechavven lehatebil yadav:
Vehapperot tehorim. velo huchsheru, delo achsheva lehach nefila:

Veim bishvil sheyyudechu yadav. nitkavven littol et happerot min hammayim, happerot hare hen bechi yuttan umuchsharim lekabbel tuma mikkan ulehabba. deachsheva lehach nefilat perot littol yadav behagebahatan, vehave leh mashke shessofo leratzon, deaf al pi sheen techillato leratzon hare ze bechi yuttan:
Learehen. leeretz yisrael:
Kimlo fi tannur. shellakta beshiddafon kol kach tevua shehaya rauy laasot mimmenna pat lemallot [pi] hattannur:
Beashkelon. beeretz pelishtim:
Veal sheachlu zeevim. dehi chayya raa umakka mehallechet hi:
Al shennira. bau vair:
Im rov nachrim nachri. umuttar lehaachilo nevelot uterefot shekatzim uremasim bayyadayim:

Veim rov yisrael yisrael. vechayyavim lehachazir lo avedato keyisrael. urevuta ka mashma lan, demotziin mamon miyyad yisrael shezzacha vo, velo amrinan oke mamona achazkateh shezzacha vo ad demayte hiach reaya shehu yisrael:

Mechetza al mechetza yisrael. leinyan nezakin, sheim shoro nagach shor shel yisrael, meshallem chatzi nezek bilvad. veeno meshallem nezek shalem kedin shor shel nachri shennagach shor shel yisrael, deven tam ben muad meshallem nezek shalem. dematze amar leh, ayte reaya delav yisrael ana ushekol. velishar kol haddevarim have safek, vedanin bo lehachemir. mi sheharago, eno neherag alav. kiddesh ishsha, tzericha get missafek. veeno cheyisrael gamur ad sheyyitbol leshem gerut:
Achar rov hammashlichin. hayenu achar hannachrim veaf al pi shehen muat. vaafillu lo hayta sham ella nachrit achat, hi chashuda lehashelich. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Enah metammea vevet habbelia. dimlikatah metahartah mide nevela:
Rabbi yehuda omer metammea vevet habbelia. disvira leh lerabbi yehuda dela ahane shechita beof shel chullin velo melika bekadashim bitrefa baof lehotziah mide nevela:

Eno din shettehe shechita kulei. vechevan deyalaft sheshshechita metaher et hatterefa baof bechullin mikkal vachomer yalfinan melikat kadashim minna bevinyan av, ma matzinu bishchita kulei‏ af melika hammachsheret baachila tetaher terefatah mittumatah:

Rabbi yose omer dayyah kulei. kevan delo ashkechan behedya dishchita motzia mide nevela baof, ella mikkal vachomer minnivlat behema atta va lilmod, dayyah shettehe kenivlat behema sheshshechitatah metahartah mide nevela velo melikatah, dedayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon. veshalosh machalokot baddavar, rabbi meir savar, echad shechita veechad melika motzia baof mide nevela. verabbi yehuda savar, ben shechita ben melika lo mahane bitrefa baof lehotziah mide nevela. verabbi yose savar, shechita mehanneya, melika lo mehanneya. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Kachamishsha asar beav. shebbo kalu mete midbar bishnat haarbaim. uvo nitbattelu otan hashshomrim shehoshiv yeravam ben nevat shehayu monim et yisrael shello yaalu laregel. uvo nittenu haruge vetar likvura. uvo hayu poskim millichrot etzim, lammaaracha, lefi shemmeaz tash kochah shel chamma, sheen bah koach leyabbesh haetzim millachutan:
Veyom hakkippurim. shebbo nittenu luchot haacharonot, vehu yom mechila uselicha:
Sheulim. shekkullan shoalin, afillu ashirot, shello levayyesh et mi sheen lo:
Teunim tevila. kodem sheyyilbeshum, lefi sheen kol achat bekia bachavertah shemma nidda hayta:
Yotzot vecholot. kemo az tismach betula vemachol (yirmeya lo):
Bammelech shelomo. hakkadosh baruch hu shehashshalom shello:
Immo. keneset yisrael:
Ze mattan tora. beyom hakkippurim shebbo nittenu luchot acharonot:
Ze binyan bet hammikdash. shennitchannech beyom hakkippurim:
Chavit. shel cheres, o shel kele even harakkim shehen kecheres. aval shear kelim lo vale kol kach ad sheyyihyu happerot shebbetochan shoavim:
Shaavu. nitlachlechu happerot umashke tofeach alehen:

Hachi garsinan, ushear kol hammashkim tehorim. shear shiva mashkim hammachshirim lekabbel tuma, tehorim happerot shebbetoch hechavit im nitlachlechu mehen. dedavka mayim veyayin vechometz shehen dakkim utzelulim, hen nivlain bechavit mippene dakkutan, vehapperot shoavim mehen. aval shemen devash chalav dam tal, hen avin, umippene avyan enan yecholin lehibbala betoch hakkeli kol kach ad sheyyihyu happerot shebbetoch hechavit shoavim mehen, hilkach enan bechi yuttan:
Sheen hakkitnit shoavet. kegon polim vaafunim vechayyotze vahen. veen halacha kerabbi nechemya:
Veneechol lakkohanim. vehammaaser en lakkohanim chelek bo ella kullo neechol labbealim:
Mippene shehu min zevach. zevichat sakkin. veof bimlika. uzevachim chashive:

Veyesh bo kadshe kadashim. veaf al gav dekarban of kullo kadshe kadashim, o chattat o ola, zevachim yesh lahen lechelek gavoah shene devarim, damo veemurav, ma sheen ken lechattat haof sheen lammizbeach ella damah, vechevan dekadma lechattat haof, kol shekken leolat haof, deha chattat haof kodemet leolat haof kedimfaresh veazel:
Rochetz bah miyyad. lemotzae shabbat, veen tzarich lehametin kede sheyyechammu. dechevan derov nachrim, addata denachrim huchamu:

Im yesh bah rashut. hammalchut keruya rashut, mippene sheharshut beyadah laasot kirtzonah. velav davka melech, ella im yesh sham adam chashuv sheyyesh lo asara avadim shemmechammemin lo asara kumkumiyyot mayim bevat achat, muttar lirchotz bah miyyad, veaf al pi sherov hair yisrael. deamrinan lishmo shel oto adam chashuv huchamu:
Harode fat chamma. shennillosha beme ferot velo huchshera lekabbel tuma:
Rabbi meir metamme. kelomar huchshar hallechem lekabbel tuma mechamat hayyayin shennivla bo. i nammi, im haya hayyayin tame, metamme rabbi meir mechamat hayyayin tame hannivla bah:
Rabbi yose metaher beshel chittim. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Pakak hatztzinnor. satam hatztzinnor kede shello yetzu hammayim:

O im chilchel letocho. shenniana venier hazzetim bammayim shebbetoch hatztzinnor. disvira leh lerabbi yehuda, sheen hammachashava moelet lehacheshir ad sheyyaase maase legallot hammachashava shebbelibbo. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Afillu av hattuma. afillu haya haadam hazze av hattuma venitmeu hammashkin sheyyardu alav, vaanan amrinan leel demashkin temeim metammeim leratzon veshello leratzon, afillu hachi enan machshirin, kevan sheyyeridat haggeshamim alav hayta shello leratzon:
Veim nier. kemo hamenaer tallito [shabbat 147]. shennier gufo lehasir haggeshamim mealav:
Bechi yuttan. hammayim hannoflim mimmennu machshirin hen:
Lehaker. lekarer atzmo:
O liddoach. lirchotz gufo, kegon shehaya meluchlach betit o vetzoa:
Betame. im haya haadam tame:
Temeim. hammayim. veim naflu al happerot, hichshirum vetimmeum keachat:
Uvetahor bechi yuttan. umachshirin:

Zeman atze hakkohanim vehaam. keshealu bene haggola lo matzu etzim ballishka, veamdu ellu vehitnaddevu mishshellahem, vehitnu neviim shebbenehem sheafillu lishka melea etzim yihyu ellu mitnaddevim mishshellahem. uvayyom shemmeviim haetzim meviim immahem karban nedava, veosim oto hayyom yom tov, vechen katuv besefer ezra (Nechemya 6) vehaggoralot hippalnu al karban haetzim vegomer‏ lehavi levet elohenu beittim mezummanim lashshana:
Vechol mi shettaa veshivto. velo haya yodea im mi yelech, yelech im bene zattu:

Uvene gonve eli. mefaresh baggemara sheppaam achat gazru haoyvim shemad al yisrael shello yaviu bikkurim lammikdash vehoshivu shomrim badderachim al kach, veamdu anashim kesherim shebbeoto haddor veheviu salle vikkurim vechippu otam biktziot, dehaynu teenim yeveshim, venosim al ketefam eli, hu etz gadol asuy keen buchena shekkotshim bo haddaysa, vehayu regilin lichtosh bo hakketziot laasot mehem iggule devela, ucheshehayu fogim bashshomrim omrim lahem anu holchim laasot shene iggule devela bammachteshet shellefanenu beeli ze sheal ketefenu, vechach hayu meviin bikkurim lirushalayim. veal shem kach nikreu bene gonve eli, kelomar gonve lev hashshomrim baeli sheal ketefam, uvene kotze ketziot al shem shechotchin iggule haddevela bammiktzoot. veellu haanashim hakkesherim atzman amdu paam acheret sheggazru shemad shello lehavi etzim lammaaracha, vetikkenu sulamot vehayu omrim lashshomrim littol shene gozalot mishshovach ze shellefanenu besulam ze sheal ketefenu anu holchim, veal shem chach nikreu bene salmay hannetutzati, shehayu nottzim hassulamot achar sheavru min hashshomrim, umeviin mehen etzim lammaaracha. vechol ellu meviin etzim im bene zattu:
Shavu vene farosh sheniyya. shelleachar shessiyyemu metilin peyasot eze baacharona, kedichtiv vehaggoralot hippalnu al karban haetzim:

Shehaya vo hallel. lefi sheechad betevet chal bachanukka leolam, uvachanukka gomrim et hahallel. aval hallel derosh chodesh sheen keriat hahallel bo ella minhag bealma, lo dache maamad. umehay taama lo chashev rosh chodesh nisan deit beh nammi hallel vekarban musaf vekarban etzim:
Rabbi eliezer omer kodem chatzot lo yashlimu. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:
Tzeu ichlu ushetu. velo amar lahen kiru hallel haggadol techilla, sheen korin hallel haggadol ella becheres melea venefesh sevea:

Holchin achar rov tabbachim. im rov tabbache yisrael, habbasar muttar. deen halacha kerav deamar basar shennitallem min haayin asur. verav moke matnitin beomed veroe mishshaa shennishchat ad shennafla, aval lo yada mi hashshochet:
Im rov machnisin levattehen patur. milleasser:

Limkor bashshuk chayyav. sherov meviin limkor bashshuk, min habbayit meviin oto, uchevar nitchayyev. perush acher, im rov machnisin levattehen, patur, lefi shergilin leasser kodem sheyyachnis labbayit kede sheyyuchelu leechol mehen. dilachar shehichnisum labbayit, miyyad hukbeu lemaaser. hilkach ma shennofel mehem badderech patur min hammaaser, lefi shehu vechezkat meussar. aval keshemmachnisin limkor, darko lehachenisan tevel, lefi sheyyachol leechol mehen aray, hilkach hannofel mehen eno vechezkat meussar:

Im rov nachrim vadday. rabbi meir letameh, disvira leh en kinyan lenachri beeretz yisrael lehafekia min hammaaser, uferot sheggadlu bekarkaot shel nachri, chayyavim bemaaser, vehannachri peshita dela isser, hilkach vadday tevel hen:
Veim rov yisrael demay. kedin perot hannimtzaim beyad am haaretz, shetztzarich lehaferish mehen terumat maaser umaaser sheni:

Vachachamim omrim vechulei. chachamim sevira lehu yesh kinyan lenachri beeretz yisrael lehafekia min hammaaser. veim lo haya yisrael mattil letocho, haya hakkol patur min hammaaser. aval kesheyyesh afillu yisrael echad shemmattil letocho, hakkol demay, bishvil perotav shel oto yisrael, shehen chayyavin. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hashshoche lishtot. befiv uvisfamo hare hen bechi yuttan. dehaynu taama, lefi sheen hammayim nichnasim lefiv ella im ken nogim bisfamo techilla, hilkach achshevinhu:

Hamemalle bechavit hammayim haolim achareha. hare hen bechi yuttan, dei efshar sheyyikkanes ad sheyyiggeu laachoreha. aval hinnichah tachat hatztzinnor, en shelleachareha bechi yuttan, deefshar lakkilluach sheyyered letochah velo yigga laachoreha:
Mechunnan al tzavvarah. mesubbav kemin tabbaat makkif letzavvar hechavit. mechunnan leshon hu ascha vaychonanecha (Devarim 32):
Netanah. lechavit:
Tachat hatztzinnor. lekabbel hammayim:
Enan bechi yuttan. hammayim shelleachareha veshebbachevel. delo nicha leh ella sheyyippelu hammayim letochah bilvad:
Hallan. ben dam ben emurim shellanu layla chutz lammizbeach:

Rabbi yehuda omer shennishchata vallayla kulei‏ im alta tered. dichtiv zot torat haola hi haola, zot hi haola, hare chan shelosha miutim, miet nishchata vallayla veshennishpach damah vesheyyatza damah chutz lakkelaim, sheim alta tered:
Rabbi shimon omer lo tered. dedarish zot torat haola, tora achat lechol haolim, sheim alu lo yerdu. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Perot sheniyya sherabbu al shel shelishit. shana rishona usheniyya shel shemitta noheg bahen maaser rishon umaaser sheni, vechen reviit vachamishit. aval shana shelishit veshishshit, maaser rishon umaasar ani:
Veshel sheviit. yesh bo kedushshat sheviit ufatur min hammaaser. uleinyan kol hanach dine katane deholchim achar harov:

Mechetza lemechetza lehachamir. uleinyan sefeka demaaser sheni umaasar ani, yafrish maaser echad, vichallel happerot al hammaot, vichallek happerot laaniyyim, vehammaot yochal birushalayim. uleinyan sefeka dishviit, chayyavin bemaaser vechayyavin bikdushshat sheviit shello laasot bahen sechora umelugema, vechayyavin beviur:
Hannittanin bemattana achat. baggemara mefaresh kegon kos dam bechor shennitarev bechos dam maaser:
Yinnatnu mattana echat. mikkol kos vechos yitten mattana achat mikkos ze umattana achat mikkos ze:
Mattan arba bemattan arba. kegon dam ola bedam shelamim o bedam asham, sheshshenehem teunim shete mattanot shehen arba ushenehem tachtonim:
Mattan arba bemattan echad. kegon ola bivchor sheshshenehem tachtonim:
Rabbi eliezer omer yinnatnu vemattan arba. veroe ani et mattanot hayeterot hannittanot middam habbechor keillu hem mayim. veen ze bal tosif:
Bemattana echat. shello yaavor al bal tosif. vide ola yatza, dechol hannittanim al mizbeach hachitzon shennetanan bemattana achat kipper:
Velo asita maase veyadecha. veeno dome ose maase, leyoshev veeno ose veissur ba meelav. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:
Hammittarefet. mitchabbetet umishtabberet, kemo betza hatterufa bikara:

Leezra. lekabbetz et haam sheyyavou laazor ulehoshia. vahalacha sheen tokim alehem bashshofar o vachatzotzrot bashshabbat ella im ken hutzrechu litkoa lekabbetz et haam, aval mitannim vezoakim umitchannenim alehem bashshabbat:
Shimon hattimni. mittimnat haya:
Af al haddever. matriin beshabbat:
Velo hodu lo chachamim. lehateria al haddever beshabbat. aval bechol matriin:
Chavit sheyyarad haddelef letochah. shello leratzon, uvetochah perot veeno rotze sheyyuchsheru lekabbel tuma:
Yeshabber. sheim meare, hare maavir hammayim mizze laze leratzon venimtzeu happerot muchsharin:
Umodim. bet shammay levet hillel:
Shehu moshit et yado vechulei‏ vehen tehorin. kelomar lo huchsheru vechach:
En ben hammuddar hanaa. en muddar hanaa chamur mimmuddar maachol ella derisat haregel, shemmuddar hanaa asur lo likkanes betoch shello umuddar maachol muttar:

Vechelim sheen osin bahen ochel nefesh. muttar lehasheilan lemuddar maachol. vedavka bemakom sheen maskirin kayyotze vahem, aval bemakom shemmaskirin kayyotze vahem, asur, dechol hanaa hammevia lide maachol sheim lo hehenahu ze mechussar bah sheve peruta, hanaat maachol hu, shehare reuya otah peruta liknot bah maachol:
Neder. haomer hare alay ola, uleachar zeman hifrishah veneevda, chayyav beacharayutah:

Nedava. haomer hare zo ola, veneevda, eno chayyav beacharayutah, shehare lo kibbelah alav. aval leinyan bal teacher ze vaze shavin, dichtiv (Devarim 23) kaasher nadarta laAdonai‏ elohecha nedava asher dibbarta beficha, hare neder unedava amurim bainyan:

Hametaher et gaggo. garsinan. veit degaras hattoref et gaggo, perush shettach gaggo tit o sid lehashevoto. vehammayim shennotnin alav keshemmetaharo o cheshettacho vetit, setaman shofchin hen umetammein. vechen hammayim shemmechabbes bahen et kesuto:
Veyardu alehen geshamin. shehen mayim tehorim. vehaggag o hakkesut menattefim mayim:
Im rov min hattahor tahor. kegon shebbattechilla haya menattef tippim dakkot uleachar ken menattef tippim avot, beyadua sherov min hattahor:

Im hosifu lenattef. shemmemaharim hattippim lered zo achar zo yoter mibbattechilla, tahor, devadday rabbu. veaf al pi sheen hattippot atzman yoter gedolot mimma shehayu vattechilla. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Merchatz temea. shel mayim sheuvin:
Zeatah temea. machsheret et happerot umetammetan:
Utehora. kelomar, vezeat merchatz tehora, kegon merchatz shel me mayan delav mayim sheuvim ninhu, hare hu bechi yuttan, shehazzea machsheret et happerot:
Im temea. habberecha. kol zea sheyyazia habbayit mechamatah, machsheret umetammea. aval shello mechamatah, haveya la zeat habbayit utehora:
Zeat battim tehora. enah machsheret hazzeraim lekabbel tuma:
Zeato temea. demechamat hammayim hi. vedavka va bemayim sheuvin. aval ba bemayim mechubbarim delo machshere, lo, deaf al gav dehashta miha telushim ninhu, lo leratzon nitleshu:
Chutz merov geshamim. lo sheyyardu harebe kol kach shemmekalkelin et hattevua, ella shekkevar yardu harebe sheen tzerichin lahen od vehen letorach al bene adam:
Tannure fesachim. shel cheres hem umittaltelin mimmakom lemakom:
Shello yimmoku. baggeshamim:
Ag uga. rasham bakkarka roshem agol keen uga:
Gishme vorot. geshamim beshefa lemallot borot:
Im nimchet. im kullah mechussa bemayim:

Even toim. even hayta birushalayim shekkol mi shemmotze metzia haya omed aleha umachriz metzia matzati, uvain bealeha venotnin simaneha venotlin otah. veotah even nikret even toim. umatzati katuv shehayta gevoha meod velo haya efshar shettitkasse vigshamim ella im ken ba mabbul laolam:
Nidduy. shemmenaddin al kevod harav:
Mitchatte. mitgagea:
Shehen mine damim. umine damim kapparatan merubba:
Chattat haof kodemet leolat haof. dichtiv (Vayikra 5) vehikriv et asher lachattat rishona, bana binyan av lechol hachattaot shekkodmot laola, ben bivhema ben beof:
Vechen behekdeshah. keshehu mafrish kinno, dehaynu shete torim o shene vene yona, kore shem lachattat techilla:
Vechullam. ben pesulim shealu ditnan behu lo yerdu, ben atzamot vegidin sheheelan mechubbarim vaachalatam haesh:
Ufaku meal hammizbeach. laaretz. 410 belaaz:
Lo yachazir. en tzarich lehachazir:
Vechen gachelet sheppaka. en tzarich lehachazir:

Evarim sheppaku kulei. i deit behu mammash, shebbesaram nikkar, afillu leachar chatzot nammi yachazir, delo have ikkul. vei delet behu mammash, shennisrefu chullan venaasu gachelet, afillu kodem chatzot lo yachazir. ella hacha bemay askinan, kegon shennitkashshu mechamat haesh sheshshalta vechullan venisrefu velo naasu pecham aval keetzim yeveshim hem mittocham:

Kodem lachatzot uleachar chatzot. yalfinan mikkera dichtiv kol hallayla ad habboker, mimmashma shenneemar kol hallayla eni yodea shead habboker, ella ten boker levakro shel layla, sheen tzerichin lihyot od al hammoked, veeze voker nosaf al bakro shel layla sheen tzerichin lihyot od al hammoked, ze chatzot. devoker shel layla hu ammud hashshachar:
Umoalin bahen. deakkatti bene mizbeach ninhu:
Veen moalin bahen. dechevan dahavu meukkalim havu lehu davar shennaaset mitzvato veen moalim bo:
Asara vatlanin. shel bet hakkeneset, shebbetelim mimmelachtan venizzonim mishshel tzibbur, kede lihyot metzuyin tamid bishat hattefilla bevet hakkeneset:
Baellu amru. bizmannim shel megilla amru makdimin im chal zeman keriatah beshabbat:

Aval zeman atze hakkohanim vehaam. shehayu mishpachot leyisrael shekkevuim lahem yamim bechol shana lehavi etzim lammikdash letzorech hammaaracha, umeviin karban etzim immahem olot nedava, im chal lihyot beshabbat meacharim leyom machar:
Vetisha veav. vehu haddin shear taaniyyot im chal echad mehen lihyot beshabbat:

Vachagiga. im chal yom tov beshabbat dochin shalme chagiga lemachar, shehare yesh lah tashlumin kol shiva. vechen hakehel et haam, shehaya hammelech kore besefer mishne tora, vechol haam chayyavin lavo ulehavi et tappam, kedichtiv (Devarim lo) haanashim vehannashim vehattaf, uveshabbat i efshar vedochin oto lemachar:
Velo makdimin. deakkatti lo mate zeman chiyyuvayhu. vetisha beav, deakdome puranuta lo makdeminan:
